raw.title: Procurement Analyst III – HR, IT, General Labor & Benefits
raw.excerpt: Owens & Minor is a global healthcare solutions company providing essential products, services and technology solutions that support care delivery in leading hospitals, health systems and research centers around the world.
raw.description:
Owens & Minor is a global healthcare solutions company providing essential products, services and technology solutions that support care delivery in leading hospitals, health systems and research centers around the world. For over 140 years, Owens & Minor has delivered comfort and confidence behind the scenes, so healthcare stays at the forefront, helping to make each day better for the hospitals, healthcare partners, and communities we serve. Powered by more than 14,000 teammates worldwide, Owens & Minor exists because every day, everywhere, Life Takes Care™.

Global Reach with a Local Touch

  • 140+ years serving healthcare

  • Over 14,000 teammates worldwide

  • Serving healthcare partners in 80 countries

  • Manufacturing facilities in the U.S., Honduras, Mexico, Thailand and Ireland

  • 40+ distribution centers

  • Portfolio of 300 propriety and branded product offerings

  • 1,000 branded medical product suppliers

  • 4,000 healthcare partners served

Benefits

  • Comprehensive Healthcare Plan - Medical, dental, and vision plans start on day one of employment for full-time teammates.

  • Educational Assistance - We offer educational assistance to all eligible teammates enrolled in an approved, accredited collegiate program.

  • Employer-Paid Life Insurance and Disability - We offer employer-paid life insurance and disability coverage.

  • Voluntary Supplemental Programs – We offer additional options to secure your financial future including supplemental life, hospitalization, critical illness, and other insurance programs.

  • Support for your Growing Family – Adoption assistance, fertility benefits (in medical plan) and parental leave are available for teammates planning for a family.

  • Health Savings Account (HSA) and 401(k) - We offer these voluntary financial programs to help teammates prepare for their future, as well as other voluntary benefits.

  • Paid Leave - In addition to sick days and short-term leave, we offer holidays, vacation days, personal days, and additional types of leave – including parental leave.

  • Well-Being – Also included in our offering is a Teammate Assistance Program (TAP), Calm Health, Cancer Resources Services, and discount programs – all at no cost to you.

The compensation for this position will be $87,000 - $107,000 annually. The exact compensation will vary by experience, education and location.


SUMMARY

The Analyst III – Indirect Procurement provides direct analytical and operational support to the global HR/IT/General Labor & Benefits categories within a center-led hybrid procurement framework. The position delivers the spend analytics, and supplier performance reporting that underpin category strategy development and execution. Acting as the analytical engine for the category management team, the role converts market data, ERP transactions, and supplier inputs into actionable insight.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Spend & Cost Analytics:

Maintain and enhance category spend baselines, savings pipelines, and procurement performance metrics across indirect spend categories; validate reported savings and cost avoidance initiatives using Finance-approved methodologies; and translate results into measurable P&L impact and value creation for business stakeholders.
Contract & Price Administration:
Administer and manage contract pricing, commercial terms, and negotiated savings commitments across indirect spend categories; maintain accurate contract, supplier, and pricing data within ERP and procurement systems; and resolve pricing, invoicing, and payment discrepancies in partnership with suppliers, Accounts Payable, Finance, and internal stakeholders.
Supplier Performance Reporting:
Produce supplier scorecards and KPI dashboards covering quality, delivery, competitiveness, and sustainability metrics; support quarterly business reviews with data preparation and trend analysis.
Reporting & Visualization:
Develop and maintain visual reporting and analytics tools (e.g., Power BI) that give category managers and senior leadership a clear view of spend, market outlook, savings delivery, and risk posture.
Cross-Functional Support:
Partner with Category Managers, Finance, Legal, Compliance, and business stakeholders to ensure data integrity, support sourcing and contracting activities, and drive the effective implementation and adoption of enterprise-wide procurement strategies, supplier agreements, and governance standards across the organization.
Collaboration: Collaborate with Procurement COE team on analytics, eSourcing tools/ techniques.
EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

Required:

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Finance, Economics, Engineering,
or a related highly analytical discipline.
• 3–5 years of progressive experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, supply chain, or financial/commodity analysis, preferably supporting direct materials categories.
• Demonstrated experience in spend analysis, cost modeling, and data-driven reporting in support of sourcing or category management decisions.
Working knowledge of commodity-driven pricing mechanisms (index-linked and formula-based contracting) and market fundamentals for resins, polymers, or packaging materials.

Preferred:

• Exposure to indirect procurement categories such as IT, Professional Services, Facilities, HR, Marketing, Finance, Telecommunications, and Transportation, with experience leveraging market intelligence, supplier benchmarking, spend analytics, and industry research tools to inform category strategies, support sourcing initiatives, and identify cost savings and value creation opportunities.
• Experience operating within a center-led hybrid procurement organization.
• Strong analytical, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build credibility with stakeholders at all levels.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, & ABILITIES

• Advanced Microsoft Excel proficiency (including pivot modeling and Power Query) and demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills, with strong attention to data accuracy and integrity.
• Experience with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle) and e-procurement tools (e.g. Coupa, Ariba, Rosslyn, others).
• Proficiency with data visualization and reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) to build dashboards and executive-ready reporting.
• Experience with AI tools to leverage data and action plans.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex market and cost data into concise, decision-ready insights.
• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
• The ability to adapt to changing situations, new information, and unexpected challenges.

•

APICS or ISM certification (e.g., CPIM, CPSM) is a plus.
ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS
• No environmental hazards indicated for this classification.
• Remote/Hybrid flexibility offered. The role requires periodic alignment with global time zones to support the global supply base and regional stakeholders.

If you feel this opportunity could be the next step in your career, we encourage you to apply. This position will accept applications on an ongoing basis.

Owens & Minor is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, genetic information, religion, disability, age, status as a veteran, or any other status prohibited by applicable national, federal, state or local law.

raw.description:
The Care Manager l - Waiver assures that individuals and families with special health care needs receive integrated whole-person-person centered care management, including coordinating across physical health, behavioral health, pharmacy and unmet health-related resource needs to ensure they are linked to services and supports in an effort to maximize potential outcomes and decrease the unnecessary use of hospitals and emergency services by assuring that appropriate quality care is in place.

The Care Manager I focus on a specified population of members utilizing health care services while ensuring all member health needs and referrals are addressed. The Care Manager l will collaborate with other community systems to work in partnership to support the identified population.

This position is full time remote. Selected candidate must reside in North Carolina. Some travel for onsite meetings to the home office and within the communities served may be required.

Responsibilities & Duties

Complete Assessment/Planning

  • Complete comprehensive assessments or Care Needs Screening at enrollment, yearly or at changes in condition
  • Develop Plans of Care derived from the completed assessments
  • Demonstrate commitment to whole person/integrated care
  • Assign interventions/plans of care to applicable Alliance Care Management team member to meet identified member needs, for monitoring, and/or service engagement activities
  • Complete required Screening Tools
  • Retrieve and review historical data to better-understand member’s treatment history
  • Submit referrals to the Transition Coordinator when a physical health or behavioral health need indicates medical and/or pharmaceutical complexity
  • Assign Plan of Care activities to Community Health Worker if member has identified Social Determinants of Health (SDOH), disparities and/or complex payer issues
  • Assist individuals/legally responsible persons (LRP) in choosing service providers, ensuring objectivity in the process
  • Consistently evaluate appropriateness of services and ensure implementation of plan of care through information gathering and assessment at defined frequency of contact based on risk stratification
  • Utilize person centered planning, motivational interviewing and historical review of assessments in JIVA to gather information and to identify supports needed for the individual
  • Assist in collecting data to be used to identify and address barriers as well as determine the effectiveness of care management/care coordination in reducing lengths of stay and use of emergency services
  • Actively collaborates with members/legally responsible person, care team, service providers, and identified supports to ensure development of a plan that accurately reflects the individual’s needs and desired life goals including collaborating with residential placement search in conjunction with internal team members or external stakeholders as needed
  • Submits required documentation to UM to ensure timely delivery of services - and trouble shoot until authorization is obtained. Notify a member’s care team and providers of successful authorization (for residential or waiver related services)
  • For Medicaid C, enlist administrative support to send Level of Care (LOC) and initial Individual Service Plan (ISP) to Department of Social Services (DSS) to turn on special waiver program indicator. Verify that necessary Client, Employer, Group (CEG) enrollments are correct in JIVA, and that Medicaid eligibility is updated in Alliance Claims System

Provide Support and Monitoring to Members

  • Schedule initial contact with member for purpose of assessment and engagement
  • Verify accuracy of demographic information with member. Update inaccurate information from the Global Eligibility File following documented protocols
  • Schedule face to face, virtual, and telephonic meeting with member/guardian to provide education about Alliance Health Plan, care teams, resources, and services
  • Provide education and support, to individuals and LRP, in learning about and exercising rights, explanation of the grievance and appeals process, available service options, providers available to meet their needs, and payer requirements that may impact service connection and maintenance
  • Refer members who are in crisis/institutional setting and require assistance with returning to community based services to the Integrated Health Consultant or applicable care team member
  • Recognize and report critical incidents and provider quality concerns to supervisors and Quality Management Department
  • Complete activities in JIVA related to Plans of Care developed from the Care Management Comprehensive Assessment or other assessments as deemed necessary
  • Coordinate with other team members to ensure smooth transition to appropriate level of care when needed
  • Communicate with member to check on status, verify care needs are met and that no new clinical needs warrant a change in condition assessment
  • Provide follow up coordination with key stakeholders to promote engagement
  • Promote customer satisfaction through ongoing communication and timely follow-up on any concerns/issues
  • Verify that ongoing service adherence is maintained through monitoring meetings with member and/or guardian or provider
  • Identify barriers to treatment and assist individuals with arranging appointments or linking to treatment providers
  • Maintain required contacts with member/legally responsible person per state contractual requirements meeting minimum expectations
  • Attend community, provider, stakeholder meetings as needed for member and/or as directed to support the needs of the health plan
  • Coordinate and participate with SIS Team to ensure successful completion of SIS assessment within time frames allotted
  • For facility (ICF, Hospital, PRTF or SDC) discharges, inform SIS Supervisor that an assessment needs to be scheduled
  • Schedule and facilitate the ISP meeting, develop and update ISP
  • Submit requests for services and purchase orders for products, supplies, and services covered under the Innovations waiver
  • Complete check-in/contact with member and/or legally responsible person (LRP) via phone or email
  • Complete Home and Community Based Services (HCBS) Notice of Change Form when arranging new HCBS service placement (for Residential Supports, Day Supports, and Supported Employment) with a new provider and submit to Provider Network department to ensure successful transition to provider
  • Review service utilization and documentation as required by the member’s program enrollment to monitor progress toward individualized goals and fulfillment of the intent of the service authorized
  • Proactively respond to an individual’s planned movement outside the Alliance MCO geographic area to ensure a smooth transition without lapse in care

Engage with Providers

  • Engage with Providers to identify barriers to service delivery at the member level and work toward individualized resolution with both the member and provider
  • Ensure assessments, person-centered plans, discharge plans, and crisis plans are completed and shared with providers with whom the individuals are linked
  • Report changes in member’s health status to authorized providers

Service Monitoring

  • For Medicaid C services: conduct in-person, field-based observation of the member’s experience with service delivery per the frequency and requirements outlined in the Medicaid C waiver and Home and Community-based Services (HCBS) standards
  • For Non-Medicaid C services: complete (a) Provider Engagement Tool to assess provider support needs (to engage member in services) and (b) interventions to resolve administrative barriers to care;
  • Review service utilization and documentation as required by the member’s program enrollment to monitor progress toward individualized goals and fulfillment of the intent of the service authorized

Complete Documentation

  • Obtain and upload all supporting documentation, Legally Responsible Person (LRP) verification, and release of information that will improve care management activity on behalf of the member
  • Open new episodes in JIVA when needed and schedule initial contact with member to verify accuracy of demographic information and initiate the rapport building process
  • Document all applicable member updates and activities per organizational procedure
  • Escalate complex cases and cases of concern to immediate supervisor.
  • Ensure that service orders/doctor’s orders are obtained, as applicable
  • Share appropriate documentation with all involved stakeholders as consent to release is granted
  • Obtain releases/documentation and provide to all stakeholders involved
  • Maintains medical record compliance/quality
  • Proactively respond to an individual’s planned movement outside the Alliance geographic area, or other transition need, to ensure a smooth transition without lapse in care
  • Distribute surveys to members in service
  • Ensure clinical documentation (e.g. goals, plans, progress notes, etc.) meets state, agency documentation standards, and Medicaid requirements

Compliance with Alliance Policy and Procedure

  • Adheres to all Alliance Organizational Policies and Procedures and Care Management Desk Procedures

Travel

  • Travel between Alliance offices, attending meetings on behalf of Alliance, participating in Alliance sponsored events, etc. may be required
  • Travel to meet with members, providers, stakeholders, attend court hearings etc. is required

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in Human Services field and two (2) years of post-bachelor’s degree mh/dd/sa experience with the population served. Experience must include two (2) years LTSS and/or HCBS coordination, care delivery monitoring, and care management experience.

Or

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in Non-Human Services field and four (4) years of post-bachelor’s degree mh/dd/sa experience with the population served. Experience must include two (2) years LTSS and/or HCBS coordination, care delivery monitoring, and care management experience.

Or

Master’s Degree from an accredited college or university in Human Services field and one (1) year of post graduate degree mh/dd/sa experience with the population served. Experience must include two (2) years LTSS and/or HCBS coordination, care delivery monitoring, and care management experience.

Or

Fully or Provisionally Licensed in the State of North Carolina as a LCSW, LCMHC, LPA, or LMFT and two (2) years LTSS and/or HCBS coordination, care delivery monitoring, and care management experience.

Or

Licensed Registered Nurse (RN) in the State of North Carolina with four (4) years of mh/dd/sa experience with the population served. Experience must include two (2) years LTSS and/or HCBS coordination, care delivery monitoring, and care management experience.

Preferred: NACCM, NADD-Specialist and/or CBIS Certification

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

  • Person Centered Thinking/planning
  • Knowledge of using assessments to develop plans of care
  • Knowledge of LOC process, SIS for IDD and FASN assessment for TBI
  • Knowledge of Medicaid basic, enhanced MHSUD, and waiver benefits plans
  • Knowledge of and skilled in the use of Motivational Interviewing techniques
  • Strong interpersonal and written/verbal communication skills
  • Conflict management and resolution skills
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office products (such as Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.)
  • High level of diplomacy and discretion is required to effectively negotiate and resolve issues with minimal assistance.
  • Ability to make prompt, independent decisions based upon relevant facts

Salary Range

$28.96 - $37.65/hourly

Exact compensation will be determined based on the candidate's education, experience, external market data and consideration of internal equity.

An excellent fringe benefit package accompanies the salary, which includes:

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Long Term Disability
  • Generous retirement savings plan
  • Flexible work schedules including hybrid/remote options
  • Paid time off including vacation, sick leave, holiday, management leave
  • Dress flexibility

Want to learn more about what it's like work as part of the Care Management Team? Click on our video to learn more:

raw.excerpt: Se você tem paixão por inovação e busca trabalhar em um ambiente ágil, colaborativo e desafiador, esta pode ser a sua oportunidade!
raw.description:
Se você tem paixão por inovação e busca trabalhar em um ambiente ágil, colaborativo e desafiador, esta pode ser a sua oportunidade!

Para o nosso time de Tax Compliance, buscamos pessoas com experiência prática em atividades da área, com perfil hand-on e foco na execução de rotinas de apuração, incluindo o fechamento mensal e anual. Você atuará diretamente com foco na conformidade tributário-regulatória do Grupo Asaas, utilizando principalmente as habilidades de organização, gestão de prazos, rigor técnico, capacidade de resolver problemas, dinamismo e visão sistêmica sobre o impacto das apurações no Grupo Asaas.

Se interessou pela oportunidade mas não reside em Joinville? Não tem problema, possibilitamos otrabalho remoto/home office.

  • Apurar os tributos correntes e diferidos (IRPJ, CSLL, PIS, Cofins, ISS, IOF, CPRB, Simples/DAS) das empresas do Grupo Asaas, garantindo a aplicação correta das melhores práticas de mercado e redefinindo os critérios sempre que necessário;
  • Manter os controles extrafiscais do time, garantindo rastreabilidade e conformidade das apurações realizadas;
  • Conciliar as contas contábeis referentes aos tributos, identificando e corrigindo divergências na origem;
  • Entregar as declarações acessórias do Grupo Asaas (ECF, DCTFWeb, EFD-Contribuições, Reinf, e-Financeira, entre outras), garantindo a tempestividade das entregas;
  • Realizar os lançamentos de notas fiscais de entrada e saída, incluindo as emissões de NF-e para onboarding de novos colaboradores;
  • Realizar os atendimentos e consultorias internas conforme a demanda, apresentando as respectivas devolutivas técnicas;
  • Realizar as projeções tributárias das empresas do Grupo Asaas relacionadas à rotina de Compliance, justificando as variações apresentadas entre orçado x realizado e criando plano de ação para as inconsistências constatadas;
  • Construir os indicadores tributários do time (ex.: alíquota efetiva, aging de conciliações, SLA de obrigações acessórias) e consolidar os reportes gerenciais para as lideranças;
  • Executar a adequação operacional das empresas do Grupo Asaas à Reforma Tributária (Split Payment, IBS/CBS), garantindo a regularidade em todas as etapas da transição;
  • Analisar os impactos de novos produtos do Grupo Asaas na rotina de apuração e recolhimento de tributos;
  • Executar os projetos que envolvam temas tributários operacionais, garantindo a regularidade e conclusão das etapas necessárias;
  • Manter a governança tributária, cobrindo as atividades abrangidas pelo time de Tax Compliance;
  • Realizar contatos com os órgãos tributários sempre que necessário;
  • Atender às áreas internas, quando necessário, a respeito dos temas tributários operacionais;
  • Atender às demandas externas, incluindo auditorias externas e processos de Due Diligence, a respeito dos temas tributários;
  • Apoiar, revisar e acompanhar as entregas dos analistas mais juniores do time, quando aplicável.
  • Ensino Superior concluído em Ciências Contábeis, Direito, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Ensino Superior em andamento em Direito Tributário, Gestão Tributária ou áreas correlatas.
  • Inglês intermediário.

Informações adicionais

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com SAP e/ou Oracle;
  • Experiência em tributação de IP’s, IFs e FIDC’s;
  • Experiência na área tributária de 3 anos ou mais;

Modelo de Trabalho

  • Carga horária de 8h por dia (segunda a sexta-feira);
  • Contratação CLT.

raw.title: Staff Physician, Primary Care Telemedicine
raw.excerpt: Join the team leading the next evolution of virtual care.
raw.description:
Join the team leading the next evolution of virtual care.

At Teladoc Health, you are empowered to bring your true self to work while helping millions of people live their healthiest lives.

Here you will be part of a high-performance culture where colleagues embrace challenges, drive transformative solutions, and create opportunities for growth. Together, we’re transforming how better health happens.

Summary of Position

Working as part of a care team for Teladoc Health Medical Group, the Primary Care Physician provides best in class virtual patient care via video and telephonic appointments. This unique opportunity will contribute to shaping the evolution of virtual primary care as an industry standard to make primary care accessible, affordable and effective for all.

Teladoc will function as your primary employer, excluding the opportunity to work for competing telehealth companies. This is a full-time 40 hours per week role with shifts varying Monday – Saturday, including some evenings. Shifts will be scheduled based upon the needs of the business.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Work with a healthcare team to provide patients with exceptional primary care services virtually via video and phone communication channels, within the standard of care for primary care patients.
  • Order laboratory and radiology tests and refer patients to specialists when appropriate.
  • Be accessible to the Care Team to solve problems and keep the entire panel well cared for in a timely manner.
  • Analyze reports, test results, medical records and examinations to diagnose condition of patients and propose treatment options.
  • Prescribe pharmaceuticals, other medications and treatment regimens to treat identified and documented medical conditions, including discussing potential side effects and risks associated with allergies, interactions with other medications and/or health conditions as appropriate.
  • Provide advice to patients for lifestyle and diet changes that may improve their health or help to treat the health issue they are experiencing.
  • Consistently meet or exceed clinical quality and patient care standards, including adhering to department policies, procedures, and objectives.
  • Maintain patient confidentiality and comply with all federal and state health information privacy laws.
  • Record complete, timely and legible medical records.
  • Attendance at meetings, 1:1 provider assessments and other required meetings as deemed by leadership.
  • Demonstrate familiarity with and provide support as needed for the full range of Teladoc services including medical second opinion, treatment decision support, behavioral health, tele-dermatology and other service offerings.
  • Support the Medical Director and product team in the development of new products and services, as needed.
  • Collaborative oversight of advanced practice providers as required by business needs.
  • Maintain patient confidentiality and comply with all federal and state health information privacy laws.

Supervisory Responsibilities

No

Qualifications Expected for Position

  • Demonstrated passion regarding the delivery of high-quality virtual care.
  • History of strong clinical performance.
  • Proficiency with electronic medical records and computer-based applications.
  • Attention to detail and timely presentation to patient appointments imperative.
  • Mult-state licenses and willingness to become licensed in additional states as required and funded by the Company.
  • Active NY and/or TX physician licensure highly desired.
  • Letter of Qualification (LOQ) for obtaining additional state licenses is highly desired.
  • Ability to work independently and efficiently in a virtual setting, demonstrating strong clinical judgment and decision-making skills.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to effectively interact with patients and interdisciplinary teams remotely.
  • Strong commitment to patient-centered care, empathy, and cultural sensitivity.
  • Ability to adapt to rapidly evolving virtual care practices and embrace innovative technologies.
  • Dedication to ongoing professional development and lifelong learning.
  • Experience in Obesity Medicine is highly desired.
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) a plus.

The above qualifications, knowledge, experience, and/or background are expected but not required for this role.

The below qualifications, knowledge, experience and/or background are required for this role. License certifications must be actively maintained.

  • 5+ years post-residency experience as a Primary Care Physician in a clinical setting.
  • ABMS board certification in primary care or related field from successful completion of a residency at an accredited healthcare institution in Family Medicine or IM/Peds.
  • M.D. or D. O. degree from an accredited United States medical school.
  • Must hold a minimum of 3 active, unrestricted State Medical Practitioner licenses.
  • No disciplinary actions within the last 5 years.
  • Drug Enforcement Agency (DEA) eligible.
  • Must reside in the United States and not require sponsorship.

The base salary range for this position is $ 245,300. In addition to a base salary, this position is eligible for a performance bonus and benefits (subject to eligibility requirements) listed here Teladoc Health Benefits 2026. Total compensation is based on several factors including, but not limited to, type of position, location, education level, work experience, and certifications. This information is applicable for all full-time positions.

You will accrue 8 hours of PTO per semi-monthly pay period. You will also receive 80 hours of Paid Sick, Safe, and Caregiver Leave annually. This applies to full-time positions only. If you are applying for a part-time role, your recruiter can provide additional details.

As part of our hiring process, we verify identity and credentials, conduct interviews (live or video), and screen for fraud or misrepresentation. Applicants who falsify information will be disqualified.

Teladoc Health will not sponsor or transfer employment work visas for this position. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Why join Teladoc Health?

  • Teladoc Health is transforming how better health happens. Learn how when you join us in pursuit of our impactful mission.

  • Chart your career path with meaningful opportunities that empower you to grow, lead, and make a difference.

  • Join a multi-faceted community that celebrates each colleague’s unique perspective and is focused on continually improving, each and every day.

  • Contribute to an innovative culture where fresh ideas are valued as we increase access to care in new ways.

  • Enjoy an inclusive benefits program centered around you and your family, with tailored programs that address your unique needs.

  • Explore candidate resources with tips and tricks from Teladoc Health recruiters and learn more about our company culture by exploring #TeamTeladocHealth on LinkedIn.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we never have and never will discriminate against any job candidate or employee due to age, race, religion, color, ethnicity, national origin, gender, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, membership in an employee organization, medical condition, family history, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, parental status, or pregnancy). In our innovative and inclusive workplace, we prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind.

As a Bilingual Disability Case Analyst/Case Manager, you will support plan members across Canada guiding them through illness, injury, and recovery while helping them reclaim independence, dignity, and a path back to work. raw.excerpt: Sobre a Conheça nossa visão nas palavras doRonaldo, fundador e líder da empresa: [Clique para acessar o vídeo] AGIRO.
raw.description:
Sobre a

Conheça nossa visão nas palavras doRonaldo, fundador e líder da empresa:

[Clique para acessar o vídeo]

AGIRO.TECHé uma fintech que atua como uma plataforma de originação e distribuição de crédito para correspondentes bancários, combinando tecnologia de ponta e inteligência de mercado. Somos resolvedores de problemas complexos e o nosso combustível são os desafios trazidos por nossos parceiros. Com nossa expertise de negócios, simplificamos a jornada de crédito e habilitamos novas receitas financeiras para que empresas e varejistas ofereçam crédito de forma eficiente.

Aqui todos precisam ter o conhecimento dos instrumentos que viabilizam essa engrenagem. Portanto, prepare-se para aprender a fundo como funcionam FIDCs, Securitizadoras e soluções tecnológicas para a originação e distribuição de crédito.

Nossas soluções são integradas e invisíveis: por meio de APIs robustas, nossos parceiros acoplam nossa tecnologia de intermediação diretamente nos serviços que já prestam. É aí que reside um dos nossos maiores desafios: cada parceiro possui um ambiente de sistemas diferente, com cenários técnicos particulares. Cada desafio é único, e temos enorme satisfação em arquitetar e desenvolver a solução de integração ideal.

Como pensamos (Nosso DNA)

Valorizamos quem temBRIO!

Somos uma empresa formada por NERDS apaixonados por resolver problemas complexos do mercado financeiro. Atuamos com umamentalidade de jogo infinito: não focamos em ganhar uma partida isolada, mas em permanecer no jogo, buscando desafios cada vez maiores e manter um aprendizado contínuo para ser cada dia melhor.

Na GIRO.TECH temos um ambiente realmente meritocrático, quem entrega e colabora mais, será sempre recompensado. Nosso time sênior e lideranças é majoritariamente formado por pessoas que entraram na empresa em cargos Júnior e até mesmo como estagiários. Aqui, novas vagas importantes são prioritariamente preenchidas com pessoas da casa.

Nossos processos seletivos são uma busca de futuros sócios da empresa. Para ir rápido, melhor ir sozinho. Se queremos construir algo grande, precisamos nos juntar a mais gente boa que pense como a gente. Dedicamos muito tempo nos processos seletivos para achar essas pessoas e entregamos desafios constantes para promover crescimento. Temos hoje comosócios da empresa, muitas pessoas que começaram em posições de base e mostraram que têm vontade de ser mais.

Fundadores - nossa base

Uma empresa é a extensão dos valores e sonhos de seus sócios fundadores. A GIRO.TECH foi fundada por quatro sócios, que têm como primeira formação a tecnologia, e são apaixonados por servir os outros usando seu conhecimento e por resolver problemas complexos.


Isso é GIRO.TECH

  • Liderança e Mentoria:aqui não temos "chefes", mas líderes que caminham lado a lado, incentivam e ensinam.
  • Voz Ativa:a melhor ideia prevalece, não o maior cargo. Oferecemos espaço para testar, errar e aprender.
  • Liberdade e Responsabilidade:valorizamos o trabalho remoto e a autonomia. Você tem liberdade para trabalhar de onde preferir e vestir o que for mais confortável; em troca, esperamos responsabilidade total com as entregas.
  • Crescimento Interno:priorizamos nosso time para ocupar novas vagas e posições mais desafiadoras. Temos muitas pessoas que iniciaram como estagiários e hoje evoluíram para o nível sênior, alguns, inclusive, passaram a ser sócios da empresa.
  • Excelência Técnica:nossa principal estratégia comercial é possuir a melhor tecnologia e um produto de alta performance. O resultado é a satisfação dos nossos clientes, que nos avaliam constantemente com notas acima de 9.

Isso NÃO é GIRO.TECH

  • Não somos uma instituição financeira tradicional de "terno e colete puffer".
  • Não valorizamos hierarquias rígidas ou burocracias excessivas para tomada de decisão.
  • Não somos os donos da verdade; somosinquietos, curiosos e abertos a mudanças.

Perfil que buscamos

Buscamos pessoas capazes de se adaptar a cenários dinâmicos e com sede de conhecimento. Valorizamos ainquietude: a busca constante por evoluir processos e construir resultados melhores a cada dia.

Se você é apaixonado por solucionar problemas com excelência, busca desafios que te tirem da zona de conforto e nunca está satisfeito com o mediano, seu lugar é aqui.

Vem construir o futuro da tecnologia de crédito com a gente!



Sobre a vaga:

O crédito consignado é uma operação que só funciona quando os números fecham. Cada parcela precisa ser descontada, repassada e conciliada corretamente — e quando não é, alguém precisa perceber, entender por quê e resolver antes que vire prejuízo.

Esse alguém é você.

Estamos construindo a operação financeira do nosso produto de crédito e procuramos alguém que faça as duas coisas: rode a rotina com rigor e, ao mesmo tempo, transforme em processo documentado, controle e automação aquilo que vem sendo construído. É uma vaga para quem gosta de conciliar, mas se incomoda de conciliar do mesmo jeito manual todo mês.

Você vai trabalhar lado a lado com Produto, Tecnologia, Operações e Contabilidade, com reporte direto ao Head de Produtos de Crédito — e com espaço real para desenhar como as coisas serão feitas daqui pra frente.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Conciliar os arquivos de escrituração e de pagamentos com a carteira de contratos, confrontando parcela devida, valor descontado e valor repassado.
  • Identificar, classificar e tratar divergências: descontos parciais, parcelas não descontadas, repasses não realizados, suspensões de desconto, verbas rescisórias e encargos.
  • Manter o controle de itens em aberto, conduzir a regularização com clientes e parceiros e garantir o encerramento dentro do mês de competência.
  • Apurar, conferir e acompanhar os repasses devidos a parceiros e demais contrapartes, conforme as regras contratuais.
  • Controlar o ciclo de faturamento de serviços e consultas
  • Monitorar o descasamento entre prazos de recebimento e de pagamento, sinalizando com antecedência qualquer risco de exposição de caixa.
  • Acompanhar inadimplência da carteira, acionamento de garantias e os prazos críticos associados.
  • Desenhar, documentar e implantar os processos e controles das rotinas de conciliação, repasse, faturamento e gestão de garantias.
  • Especificar relatórios e painéis junto a Produto e Tecnologia, apoiar homologação de sistemas e validação de novas rotinas.
  • Identificar trabalho manual recorrente e propor automações, priorizando por risco e por volume.
  • Dar retaguarda às rotinas financeiras da empresa (contas a pagar e receber, conciliação bancária, fechamento mensal) quando necessário.

O que buscamos (requisitos):


  • Formação:Ensino superior completo em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência:
    - Vivência com conciliação de alto volume — arquivos de retorno, movimentos financeiros ou transações.
    - Noções de contabilidade e rotinas da área financeira.
  • Ferramentas:
    -Excel e Google Planilhas em nível avançado (PROCV/ÍNDICE+CORRESP, SOMASES, tabelas dinâmicas, tratamento de bases): essencial.
    - Facilidade com dados: leitura e manipulação de arquivos CSV e layouts posicionais.
    - Google Drive e Notion.
    - Diferenciais: SQL e consumo de APIs.
  • Desejável (não eliminatório): -Vivência em crédito consignado, instituição financeira, securitizadora, FIDC ou fintech de crédito — backoffice, liquidação, cessão de carteira ou gestão de garantias.
    - Experiência documentando processos (fluxogramas, POPs, matrizes de controle).
  • Perfil que combina com a vaga:
    -Rigor com número: para você, diferença não explicada não é diferença aceita.
    - Ceticismo produtivo — questiona o dado antes de reportá-lo e não se acomoda com inconsistência recorrente.
    - Pensa em processo: enxerga a rotina como sistema e vai atrás da causa raiz, não só do ajuste do mês.
    - Autonomia e organização para conduzir rotinas com prazo rígido sem alguém cobrando.

Informações adicionais

Remuneração e benefícios (nosso ecossistema):

  • Remuneração: R$ 3.444,00
  • Caju (Cartão Flexível): R$ 1.145,50
  • Saúde Integral (Keiken): R$ 220,00 exclusivos para saúde física (academia) e mental (psicologia).
  • Saúde física e mental:acesso à plataforma Wellhub.
  • Plano de saúde:Unimed sem coparticipação.

Cultura e Liberdade:

  • Remote First:trabalhe de onde quiser.
  • Sem Dress Code:vista-se como for mais confortável.
  • Day Off:um dia de folga no mês do seu aniversário para celebrar.
  • Horário Semi-flexível

About EPIC iO Technologies

Turning Data Into Action, Anywhere

At EPIC iO, we use AI and IoT to transform data from the edge into real-time insights that help organizations protect what matters most. Whether safeguarding critical infrastructure or detecting risks before they escalate, our solutions deliver the intelligence teams need to act with confidence.

We’ve helped electric utilities, water districts, oil and gas operators, and municipalities gain greater visibility and control—without adding complexity. From remote monitoring and intelligent alerts to AI-enhanced video analytics, we empower frontline teams to make smarter decisions, faster.

With our robust wireless connectivity solutions, we ensure uninterrupted connections and seamless data backup—even for businesses operating in the most remote and challenging environments.

EPIC iO brings together insight, protection, and connectivity—so you can move from data to action, wherever you are.

The Customer Success Manager serves as a primary point of contact for assigned customers, helping customers realize value from EPIC iO products and solutions throughout the customer lifecycle. This role builds trusted relationships, manages customer goals, monitors customer health, supports renewals, identifies expansion opportunities, and partners cross-functionally to improve customer outcomes.

This role processes the primary portion of cancellation requests, including customer acknowledgement, potential retention, investigation, internal and external processing, and communication.

Responsibilities & Tasks

  • Own the customer relationship for assigned accounts by maintaining regular communication, documenting goals, and driving customer success plans.

  • Develop trusted advisor relationships with customer stakeholders and help customers adopt features, workflows, and solutions effectively.
  • Consult with customers to understand business goals, confirm success criteria, and connect EPIC iO solutions to measurable customer value.
  • Conduct regular check-ins and Quarterly Business Reviews to review goals, progress, risks, outcomes, and satisfaction.
  • Monitor customer health metrics and proactively coordinate actions to improve adoption, satisfaction, retention, and renewal readiness.
  • Advocate internally for customer needs while partnering with Sales, Support, Product, and Operations to resolve issues and improve the customer experience.
  • Identify upsell, cross-sell, and expansion opportunities and collaborate with Sales as needed to support appropriate growth conversations.
  • Own renewal readiness activities for assigned accounts, including tracking dates, risks, customer sentiment, and required follow-up.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience in Customer Success, account management, business development, or another customer-facing function.
  • Strong communication, relationship-building, organization, and follow-through skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple customers, priorities, tasks, and customer commitments with attention to detail.
  • Comfort working with CRM tools, customer success platforms, Microsoft Office, and customer-facing reporting.
  • Data-informed approach to customer health, retention risk, adoption, customer goals, and account planning.

Desired Qualifications

  • Salesforce, ChurnZero, HubSpot, or customer success platform experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or equivalent experience.
  • Experience working in SaaS, SCaaS, IoT, smart city, connectivity, or technology environments, wireless preferred.
  • Sales experience is beneficial.

Physical Requirements

  • Prolonged periods of sitting and working at a computer.
  • Ability to communicate effectively through email, phone, video, CRM, and collaboration tools.
  • Ability to travel as required for customer, sales, project, or business needs.
  • Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role.
  • Work schedule is a standard workday but dependent upon the customer base/territory ie. East, West, or Central; may support customers across time zones.

The Company does not discriminate on the basis of any status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. Reasonable accommodations may be available to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role.

raw.description:
Important Notice for Applicants:
At Bixal, we are committed to ensuring a transparent and secure application process. Official communication will only be sent from an email address ending in @bixal.com or from @bixal.na.teamtailor-mail.com. Any messages from other sources should be treated with caution.

About Bixal

Bixal is a mission-driven organization that partners with leading federal agencies to design and deliver people-centered digital solutions. We are a diverse group of strategists, designers, technologists, and data scientists who believe in using design and technology to make government services more accessible and effective for all.

Independent Consultant Opportunity

Opportunity Overview

Bixal supports a large, federally funded public information and communications program that serves families and professionals across the country. The program's digital ecosystem includes a high-traffic public website, mobile applications, an online professional community, and a customer support center, reaching millions of visitors each year. A significant share of the audience is Spanish-speaking, and the program is committed to delivering accurate, high-quality, and culturally responsive information in both English and Spanish across every channel.

Bixal is seeking a detail-oriented, culturally fluent Spanish Content Translator to support this program. This role is central to ensuring Spanish-speaking users receive the same high-quality, accurate, and accessible information as English-speaking users. This is a part-time position at 50% allocation, ideal for an experienced translator who wants steady, meaningful work supporting a high-visibility public-facing platform.

As a 1099 independent contractor, you will operate independently, provide your own tools, set your own hours, and invoice Bixal for completed work.

Compensation

The compensation for this role is $50 an hour. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Key Responsibilities

  • Produce high-quality Spanish translations of website content, including web pages, PDFs, video captions/subtitles, and learning modules, working within a translation management platform.

  • Maintain and continuously improve a glossary of terms to ensure consistent terminology and translation quality across all program digital properties.

  • Provide live simultaneous Spanish interpretation for webinars and webcasts throughout the year, with audiences ranging from the hundreds to several thousand participants.

  • Translate and review Spanish-language content for email campaigns, social media, and the customer service center's public-facing responses and knowledge base.

  • Partner with the UX research team to support usability testing, interviews, and surveys with Spanish-speaking users, ensuring translated materials are tested for clarity and cultural relevance.

  • Review translated content for compliance with plain-language standards and accessibility requirements.

  • Collaborate with content strategists, designers, and engineers to ensure translated materials are published accurately and on schedule.

  • Perform other duties as required.

Required Qualifications

  • Native or professional-level fluency in both Spanish and English (written and spoken), with demonstrated translation and interpretation experience.

  • Professional translation or interpretation certification preferred (e.g., ATA certification or equivalent).

  • Experience with translation management systems (e.g., Lingotek or similar) strongly preferred.

  • Prior experience providing live/simultaneous interpretation for webinars, conferences, or public events.

  • Strong writing skills with close attention to accuracy, tone, and cultural nuance.

  • Familiarity with plain-language and accessibility standards is a plus.

  • Experience translating content for a government or public-sector client is a plus.

  • Bachelor's degree in translation, linguistics, communications, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust determination in support of a federal government contract.

Important Notes

  • This is a 1099 consulting opportunity, not a full-time or part-time employment position.

  • Bixal does not provide benefits or equipment for independent contractors.

  • All applicants must reside in and be authorized to work in the United States.

raw.title: Content Translator
raw.excerpt: Important Notice for Applicants: At Bixal, we are committed to ensuring a transparent and secure application process.
raw.description:
Important Notice for Applicants:
At Bixal, we are committed to ensuring a transparent and secure application process. Official communication will only be sent from an email address ending in @bixal.com or from @bixal.na.teamtailor-mail.com. Any messages from other sources should be treated with caution.

About Bixal

Bixal is a mission-driven organization that partners with leading federal agencies to design and deliver people-centered digital solutions. We are a diverse group of strategists, designers, technologists, and data scientists who believe in using design and technology to make government services more accessible and effective for all.

Independent Consultant Opportunity

Opportunity Overview

Bixal supports a large, federally funded public information and communications program that serves families and professionals across the country. The program's digital ecosystem includes a high-traffic public website, mobile applications, an online professional community, and a customer support center, reaching millions of visitors each year. A significant share of the audience is Spanish-speaking, and the program is committed to delivering accurate, high-quality, and culturally responsive information in both English and Spanish across every channel.

Bixal is seeking a detail-oriented, culturally fluent Spanish Content Translator to support this program. This role is central to ensuring Spanish-speaking users receive the same high-quality, accurate, and accessible information as English-speaking users. This is a part-time position at 50% allocation, ideal for an experienced translator who wants steady, meaningful work supporting a high-visibility public-facing platform.

As a 1099 independent contractor, you will operate independently, provide your own tools, set your own hours, and invoice Bixal for completed work.

Compensation

The compensation for this role is $50 an hour. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Key Responsibilities

  • Produce high-quality Spanish translations of website content, including web pages, PDFs, video captions/subtitles, and learning modules, working within a translation management platform.

  • Maintain and continuously improve a glossary of terms to ensure consistent terminology and translation quality across all program digital properties.

  • Provide live simultaneous Spanish interpretation for webinars and webcasts throughout the year, with audiences ranging from the hundreds to several thousand participants.

  • Translate and review Spanish-language content for email campaigns, social media, and the customer service center's public-facing responses and knowledge base.

  • Partner with the UX research team to support usability testing, interviews, and surveys with Spanish-speaking users, ensuring translated materials are tested for clarity and cultural relevance.

  • Review translated content for compliance with plain-language standards and accessibility requirements.

  • Collaborate with content strategists, designers, and engineers to ensure translated materials are published accurately and on schedule.

  • Perform other duties as required.

Required Qualifications

  • Native or professional-level fluency in both Spanish and English (written and spoken), with demonstrated translation and interpretation experience.

  • Professional translation or interpretation certification preferred (e.g., ATA certification or equivalent).

  • Experience with translation management systems (e.g., Lingotek or similar) strongly preferred.

  • Prior experience providing live/simultaneous interpretation for webinars, conferences, or public events.

  • Strong writing skills with close attention to accuracy, tone, and cultural nuance.

  • Familiarity with plain-language and accessibility standards is a plus.

  • Experience translating content for a government or public-sector client is a plus.

  • Bachelor's degree in translation, linguistics, communications, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust determination in support of a federal government contract.

Important Notes

  • This is a 1099 consulting opportunity, not a full-time or part-time employment position.

  • Bixal does not provide benefits or equipment for independent contractors.

  • All applicants must reside in and be authorized to work in the United States.

Please reach out to us at and let us know how we can support you. You do not need to share personal details or disclose the nature of your request. You can expect a response from a team member within 24 hours during the regular work week and on the next operating day during the weekend or holidays.

Why Bixal?

Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

Our values:

  • People-First: Emphasizing the importance of people in all aspects of work.

  • Collaboration and Transparency: Valuing teamwork and open communication.

  • Growth Mindset: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement.

  • Creating Lasting Impact: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change.

About the role:

Bixal is seeking a Content Strategist / Information Architect for a project that supports a large-scale outreach and engagement effort, delivering strategic communications, content and creative services, digital strategy, and audience engagement across public-facing websites, applications, and social media platforms. The work is paired with the IT, cybersecurity, and data operations needed to keep that digital presence secure, reliable, and available around the clock. The program's mission is to ensure the intended audience receives timely, accurate, and accessible information about the programs, services, and policies that affect them — with content and platforms built to scale, adapt to changing needs, and hold up to federal compliance and security standards.

The Content Strategist / Information Architect shapes how content is planned, structured, and organized across the program's public-facing websites and applications so that users can find, understand, and act on information efficiently. This role guides content strategy across its full lifecycle, from audience research and planning through development, ongoing management, governance, and publishing, while contributing information-architecture expertise to usability testing, content governance, and search discoverability.

This is a full-time position contingent on contract award by our client, with a defined performance period of one year with two one-year option periods. This role offers you a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a project that aligns with Bixal’s mission of delivering innovative, human-centered solutions. While the role has a fixed duration, we are committed to transparency and collaboration, keeping you informed about contract updates and new opportunities. At Bixal, we support your professional journey, ensuring your experience reflects our inclusive, purpose-driven culture and prepares you for future success.

Location

This role can work remotely from anywhere in the USA. You must be legally authorized to work in the US.  Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $87,000 – $95,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Responsibilities:

  • Administer content strategy and information architecture across the full content lifecycle, from planning and development through management, governance, and publishing.

  • Develop and maintain user personas, user stories, and journey maps for key audience segments, identifying content needs, gaps, and opportunities to inform strategy.

  • Build and maintain content taxonomies, metadata schemas, and information architecture models that support findability, reuse, and consistent navigation across websites and applications.

  • Define content structure and organization standards (e.g., page templates, content types, metadata tagging conventions) for content authors and editors to follow, coordinating with SEO on structural elements that support discoverability at the point of creation.

  • Review content within the CMS for clarity, findability, accessibility, and usability, recommending structural, navigational, or governance improvements informed by data and user needs.

  • Establish and document information-architecture standards and permissions structures that support consistent content governance and auditability.

  • Ensure content structure and metadata remain consistent across distribution channels and rendering formats during publishing.

  • Design and participate in usability testing, contributing IA-specific test scenarios (e.g., card sorting, tree testing, navigation tasks) and translating findings into structural recommendations.

  • Partner with SEO and digital strategy teams on keyword-informed taxonomy and site-structure decisions that support both user experience and organic search performance.

  • Support development of journey maps tied to specific audience events or milestones to identify structural and content gaps.

  • Contribute content-structure findings and recommendations to required lifecycle and performance reporting.

  • Maintain awareness of accessibility requirements (Section 508, WCAG) as they inform content and navigation structure decisions.

  • Other relevant duties as qualified/trained to perform

Qualifications:

  • This position requires an active Secret Clearance.

  • BA in Communications, English, Information Science, Technical Communication, or UX Writing.

  • Minimum 6 years of experience in content strategy, information architecture, or UX-focused content work, ideally within a large public-facing website or application environment.

  • Demonstrated experience building taxonomies, sitemaps, content models, and/or metadata frameworks.

  • Experience developing personas, journey maps, and other user-research-informed strategy artifacts.

  • Familiarity with usability testing methods (e.g., card sorting, tree testing, moderated user testing) and translating findings into actionable structural recommendations.

  • Working knowledge of content management systems and accessibility standards (Section 508/WCAG).

Nice to Have Skills and Experience:

  • Experience supporting a DoD, federal, or other large-scale government-facing digital program.

  • Familiarity with tools such as Optimal Workshop, Figma, or similar IA/UX research tools.

  • Background in editorial or content operations in addition to information architecture.

How We Support Our Team:

  • Flex hours

  • 401K with matching incentive

  • Parental Leave

  • Medical/dental/vision benefits

  • Flex Spending Account

  • Company provided short-term disability and life insurance

  • Commuter benefits

  • Paid Time Off (PTO)

  • 11 Paid holidays

Our company is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all individuals and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local anti-discrimination laws. Employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

raw.excerpt: TFS HealthScience is a leading global mid-size Contract Research Organization (CRO) that partners with biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies throughout their entire clinical development journey.
raw.description:
TFS HealthScience is a leading global mid-size Contract Research Organization (CRO) that partners with biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies throughout their entire clinical development journey. Our expertise includes full service-capabilities, resourcing and Functional Service (FSP) solutions.

Join Our Team as a Director Business Development - Oncology, home based in Germany or Switzerland.

About this role

As part of our CDS Oncologyteam you will working alongside passionate and innovative professionals to ensure our customers achieve their goals.

The Director Business Development - Oncologyis responsible for the business development strategy and client retention in an allocated sales territory or with specified accounts. Responsible for the coordination of all activities delegated to business development staff.

If you have a a strong network within Oncology - I want to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities:

  • Initiate, coordinate and develop strategic plans and sales strategies within a specified territory or accounts.

  • Meet annual sales goals and objectives.

  • Identify new business sales opportunities for TFS and to work with the internal TFS team to respond appropriately to any enquiry, for example a Request for Information (RFI) or a Request for Proposal (RFP)

  • Facilitate the preparedness of the TFS team in attending any client meetings, for example General Capabilities Meetings or Bid Defense Meetings (BDM)

  • Coordinate and monitor any budget or contract negotiations, post award of any work to TFS within a specified territory or accounts.

  • Establish and maintain regular contact and an excellent rapport with future and current clients.

  • Organize and prepare for sponsor presentations.

  • Collect critical information for proposal preparation.

  • Understand the RFI/RFP process and provide detailed input and leadership of the RFI response / proposal generation process for each opportunity initiated.

  • Manage costs e.g. expenses appropriately and to submit claims in a timely manner.

  • Positively interact with TFS operations personnel, keeping track of study status for projects with sponsors and help coordinate change orders when notified of a change of scope by operations.

  • Monitor and track competitor CRO activities.

  • Plan and attend major industrial events and tradeshows, as budgeted and required.

  • Develop account strategies & implementation plans and expand through accounts.

  • Identify new markets and research new business opportunities, identifying likely sales points within a specified territory or accounts.

  • Coordinate and supervise all activities aiming to develop and retain clients.

  • Collect, compile, analyze and present data related to business development activity.

  • Record all activities and client contacts / interactions in the Customer Relationship Management system ()

  • Manage and/or mentor more junior members of the business development team (where appropriate)

  • Provide input and to actively support the Head of Business Development/ Vice President/ EVP Business Development in their role.

  • Encourage open and transparent communication throughout the business development department and the wider TFS organization.

  • Provide reports as required for senior management and demonstrate leadership in best reporting practices.

  • Perform all activities in compliance with the departmental SOPs and other quality documents (e.g., Job Specifications)

  • Assist the Heads of Business Units and Business Lines in the management of the P&L for the Site Management functional service line and in order to enable current and new business in any assigned country.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or highly relevant industry experience

  • Minimum of seven (7) years of clinical research and/or sales experience

  • Considerable sales experience of more than 5 years with strong negotiation and analytical skills

  • Excellent communication skills and team leadership capabilities consistent with influencing and driving multiple stakeholders towards meeting the customer’s needs.

  • Excellent organizational, planning and multitasking skills, as well as a predisposition to entrepreneurship, results and customer focus

  • Excellent knowledge of TFS / CRO business

  • Computer competency and familiarity with Microsoft Office

  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills

  • Awareness of trends and government policies and regulations in the clinical trials area of TFS Group countries

  • Ability to work independently and efficiently.

  • Good planning, organization and problem solving abilities

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills - English and German

  • Strong, and effective presentation skills; ability to convincingly present features and benefits of service to clients

  • Travel according to the needs of the business development strategy and to travel extensively within the sales territory and to company meetings as required

What We Offer

We provide a competitive compensation package, comprehensive benefits and the opportunity for personal and professional growth in a rewarding environment. You’ll be joining a team that values collaboration, innovation, and making a difference in the lives of patients

A Bit More About Us

Our journey began over 30 years ago in Sweden, in the city of Lund. As a full-service, global Contract Research Organization (CRO), we build solution-driven teams working towards a healthier future. Bringing together over 600 professionals, TFS delivers tailored clinical research services in more than 50 countries with flexible clinical development and strategic resourcing solutions across key therapeutic areas including Dermatology, Neuroscience, Oncology and Ophthalmology.

Our core values of Trust, Quality, Passion, Flexibility, and Sustainability are our guiding light serving as the framework for decision-making at all levels of the organization. They assist us in attracting and retaining valuable talent who share our sentiments, resulting in high employee engagement and satisfaction. By aligning on these fundamental values, we cultivate a unified force, geared towards innovation and excellence. This collective effort propels us towards our shared goal and fosters a culture of mutual respect and collaboration.

Together we make a difference.

  • Conduct regular SEO validation checks (e.g., broken links, HTTP errors, and other site performance issues), coordinating remediation with technical stakeholders.

  • Lead keyword research focused on user intent and long-tail search behavior; design and implement internal linking, schema markup, and site-speed optimizations to improve organic rankings and click-through rates.

  • Develop and execute link-building and content-promotion strategies (e.g., press releases, content syndication, partnerships) to build domain authority; extend SEO strategy to voice search and event-specific landing pages.

  • Incorporate audience research and communications planning insights into keyword targeting and content-priority decisions.

  • Contribute SEO-specific test scenarios and success metrics to usability testing efforts, translating findings into optimization recommendations.

  • Advise across content strategy and lifecycle management on how SEO considerations should be embedded in planning and governance.

  • Advise content and editorial teams during content development on SEO best practices, ensuring new and updated content is optimized for search at the point of creation.

  • Provide SEO and keyword input to paid and earned media planning to ensure messaging and campaigns are optimized for reach and relevance.

  • Ensure social media and community-facing content is optimized for searchability and discoverability across digital engagement channels.

  • Provide keyword and search-trend guidance to social media content planning, informing editorial calendars and content themes to maximize organic reach.

  • Deliver staff training and workshops on SEO best practices to build organizational SEO literacy.

  • Provide regular SEO reporting and present findings/recommendations to Government stakeholders.

  • Other relevant duties as qualified/trained to perform

Qualifications:

  • This position requires an active Secret Clearance.

  • BA/BS in Marketing, Digital Communications, Data Analytics, or a related field.

  • Minimum 10 years of hands-on SEO experience, including technical SEO, on-page optimization, and content-driven SEO strategy for large, high-traffic websites.

  • Demonstrated experience with SEO/analytics tooling (e.g., Google Search Console, Google Analytics, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, or equivalent).

  • Proven experience setting and tracking SEO KPIs and delivering data-driven performance reporting to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Working knowledge of schema markup/structured data, site speed optimization, and technical SEO diagnostics.

  • Experience developing keyword strategy grounded in user intent and long-tail search research.

Nice to Have Skills and Experience:

  • Experience supporting SEO for a DoD, federal, or other large government-facing digital presence.

  • Experience with voice-search optimization and FAQ/structured content strategy.

  • Relevant certifications (e.g., Google Analytics, HubSpot SEO, SEMrush certifications).

  • Experience mentoring junior SEO or content staff.

raw.excerpt: About UsTameson is a global e-commerce store helping small and medium businesses source industrial components online.
raw.description:
About Us

Tameson is a global e-commerce store helping small and medium businesses source industrial components online. We are looking for a Head of Technical Content to take end-to-end ownership of our technical presence.

About the Role

This is not a standard copywriting role or strategist role. We want someone with an engineering mind and a marketing insight, someone who figures things out, builds things, and ships them without waiting to be told. Someone who understands who our customers are: engineers and procurement teams at small and medium businesses sourcing industrial components, and what they need to make a confident purchase decision. If you are excited about building AI-driven content pipelines, that matters more than a long track record.

You will own technical content from strategy to publication, including its technical accuracy. Your output shapes how engineers find Tameson, how the site ranks, and whether visitors convert into buyers. You work closely with our Product and Operations teams to extract technical knowledge and turn it into content competitors cannot replicate.

A Flavor of What You’d Work On

  • Audit our solenoid valve categories, identify what is missing or underperforming, and decide whether the fix is a selection guide, a page restructure, JSON-LD, or additional supporting content. Build it and analyze performance.

  • Take our internal valve performance test data and turn it into a content series: articles, comparison tables, video scripts, email campaigns, social posts. Build assets from proprietary data that competitors cannot replicate.

  • Work with industry partners to reach their communities through forums, sponsored placements, or native articles on their platforms.

  • Analyze pages that get traffic but do not convert. Investigate whether it is a traffic quality, content quality, or conversion issue, implement a fix, and track the result against sales.

  • Get up to speed on a product you know little about, write a buyer guide, fact-check it against manufacturer datasheets, and publish it without a technical reviewer.

Key Outcomes & Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Ownership: You will identify gaps in our content, style, and approach. You own the solution from idea to publication. You do not wait for a task list. You analyze the site, find the opportunities, and execute the improvements that drive the biggest impact.

  • Strategic Content Architecture: You decide the format that converts. Sometimes an article is best, but often the customer needs a flow calculator, a comparison table, an upgraded category page, a tooltip, diagram, video, or a selection wizard. You will build the right content for the job to build our brand and convert users.

  • Technical Authority & Accuracy: You are responsible for the technical accuracy of all public-facing content. You must have high engineering knowledge to validate data, correct errors, and ensure our advice is sound. You are the filter that prevents AI hallucinations or inaccuracies from reaching the customer.

  • Build the Content Moat: You will create unique value that competitors and AI models cannot replicate. Go beyond text to produce proprietary assets like physical product benchmarks, expert interviews, and deep-dive technical diagrams or videos.

  • Optimize for the Audience: You will structure information to ensure our content ranks high for search engines, serves as a primary citation source for AI models, and provides clear, helpful guidance for humans (engineers, non-engineers, buyers, etc.).

  • Agile Adaptation: You will stay ahead of marketing trends and follow the data. If a content format stops working, you pivot. You track traffic and conversion metrics to continuously refine your strategy.

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

  • High Engineering Knowledge: You have a background in engineering, deep experience in technical industries, and can explain the physics of our products easily.

  • Builds With AI: You have designed and built content workflows using AI: research pipelines, structured drafting processes, automated publishing steps. You chose the tools, connected them, and own the quality of what comes out.

  • Outcome Owner: You are driven by results (traffic, conversion, revenue) rather than output (article or word count). You manage the roadmap and deliver end-to-end results.

  • Collaborative Investigator: You do not work in a silo. You actively partner with our Product and Operations teams to extract their internal expertise. You work with them and translate their knowledge into public-facing content that sets us apart from competitors.

  • Versatile Creator: You are comfortable switching formats and could work on writing a white paper, designing calculator logic, auditing category pages, and building dashboards to analyze results all in 1 week.

Why Choose Tameson?

  • Direct Business Impact: Your work directly correlates to sales. Publish the right guide and you can watch organic traffic and conversions move. There is a direct line between what you produce and company revenue.

  • Innovation: We are an aggressive, modern company. We want you to experiment with new formats, tools, and strategies.

  • Company culture: We value collaboration, professional growth, and fun. We regularly have company activities (online and offline) to stay connected and inspired.

  • Growth: We are scaling rapidly. As we expand, your professional opportunities grow.

Role Work Conditions

  • Employment type: Full time position (remote).

  • Working hours: Flexible work hours, with availability required Monday through Friday and a minimum overlap of 12:00–17:00 GMT+1.

  • Contract type: You will join as an independent contractor. To simplify hiring outside our registered countries, we engage global talent through freelance contracts.

Ready to define the future of industrial e-commerce?

If you have the technical mind to understand our products and the strategic mind to market them, apply today.

Highlights

Tameson seeks a remote Head of Technical Content to build authority, create expert content, and optimize for AI. Independent contractor role.
