raw.description:
At JC Davis Ventures, LLC dba JC Davis Power, we keep work moving with smart, reliable solutions that allow our people and our partners to stay safe, focused, and ahead. Powering a jobsite shouldn’t be a hassle. But too often, crews are left waiting, equipment breaks down, vendors go dark, and deadlines slip.

We started JC Davis Power to fix all of that. We’re a full-service jobsite operations partner, delivering and maintaining temporary power, climate control, and Related services. All with one reliable crew. No handoffs. No confusion.

We show up, solve problems, and do the work the right way. Whether you're supporting customers in the field, building systems behind the scenes, or helping drive the business forward, you'll be part of a team that values reliability, accountability, and getting the job done.

Simple - Reliable - Done Right

The Role

People rely on HR for the details that matter, and that's where you come in.

As our People Coordinator, you'll help keep the employee experience running smoothly by supporting onboarding, payroll, benefits, employee records, HR systems, and day-to-day HR operations. You'll work closely with the Manager, HR Operations to ensure HR processes are accurate, organized, and delivered with a high level of service.

This role is perfect for someone who enjoys organization, thrives behind the scenes, and takes pride in making sure nothing falls through the cracks.

This position is remote, but candidates must live in Texas

What You’ll Do

Support the Employee Journey

From a new hire's first day through promotions, transfers, and offboarding, you'll help ensure every employee transition is handled accurately and efficiently.

  • Process new hires and employee setup within HR systems

  • Process employee status changes, compensation changes, transfers, promotions, and organizational updates

  • Process employee separations and offboarding activities

  • Maintain employee personnel files and documentation

  • Keep employee information accurate across HR systems

Help Create a Great Onboarding Experience

First impressions matter. You'll help ensure every new employee has the tools, information, and support they need to get started successfully.

  • Coordinate onboarding activities and new hire communications

  • Distribute and collect required employment documentation

  • Track completion of onboarding requirements and training assignments

  • Coordinate offboarding activities and internal notifications

  • Partner with internal departments to support employee transitions

Keep HR Systems Organized

Reliable data keeps HR running efficiently.

  • Maintain employee information across HR systems and related platforms

  • Update employee records and organizational structures

  • Run routine reports and assist with data audits

  • Maintain HR documentation and records

  • Support system testing and data cleanup efforts

  • Provide backup support to payroll and benefits

Be a Trusted Resource

You'll help employees and managers find answers while supporting the daily operations of the HR team.

  • Coordinate employment verifications and routine HR requests

  • Monitor completion of required policy acknowledgements

  • Assist with HR projects and department initiatives

  • Provide timely, professional support to employees and managers

What Success Looks Like

  • Employee transactions are completed accurately and on time

  • HR systems and employee records remain organized and up to date

  • New hires have a seamless onboarding experience

  • Payroll and benefits support activities are completed accurately

  • HR documentation remains complete and compliant

  • Employees and managers receive responsive, professional support

What you Bring

  • 2+ years of experience in Human Resources or a related field preferred

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines

  • Experience with HRIS platforms, payroll systems, or other business systems preferred

  • Strong customer service and communication skills

  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information appropriately

  • Proficiency Google Workspace, or similar business applications

  • Strong Excel skills a big plus!

  • Located here in Texas

raw.description:
DLB Associates is a premier engineering and consulting firm specializing in innovative, mission-critical solutions across hyperscale data centers, advanced infrastructure, and high-performance building systems. With over four decades of expertise, we partner with some of the world’s most influential companies to design and optimize environments that demand precision, scalability, and resilience.

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title: Power Systems Study Engineer III

Position Location: Remote - work virtually from anywhere in the United States

Job Summary

This position in DLB’s Mission Critical Department focuses primarily on hyperscale data centers and related mission critical facilities.

The Power Systems Study Engineer III will have the opportunity to work with and collaborate with all design staff and further develop their power studies expertise. This person will work as part of the Engineering Team to complete short circuit coordination and arc flash studies on a wide variety of mission critical projects.

The Power Systems Study Engineer III will receive limited direction on day-to-day work and general instruction on new projects or assignments.  Will execute and assist project leadership on projects of complex scope.  Will work independently or under limited supervision.

The Power Systems Study Engineer III will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals and values, as well as departmental objectives.

Essential Functions

Guide and Direct Power Systems Studies (80%)

Independently perform Power System Studies for mission critical projects. Activities include but are not limited to the following:

  • Equipment Evaluation: Assess the capabilities, ratings, and condition of equipment such as transformers, circuit breakers, and capacitors to determine if they meet system requirements.
  • Load Flow Studies: Analyze current and future system load to ensure power delivery without overloading components.
  • Short Circuit Analysis: Evaluate potential fault conditions to determine the system's response and ensure that equipment ratings are not exceeded.
  • Protection Coordination: Study the settings of protective devices such as relays, circuit breakers, and fuses to ensure they coordinate correctly and provide optimal protection.
  • Arc Flash Analysis: Conduct studies to determine potential arc flash hazards, calculate incident energy, and recommend safety practices and protective equipment.
  • Transient Stability Analysis: Evaluate the power system's ability to maintain synchronism after large disturbances, such as faults or sudden changes in load, motor starting, etc.
  • Prepare incremental and final deliverables including breaker settings tables, TCC’s, arc flash labels, and final reports as required by the project scope.
  • Fluent in Power System Study software including one or more of the following:
    • SKM Powertools
    • EasyPower
    • ETAP

Project Management & Reporting (20%)

  • Assist with proposal development including project scope, schedule and budget
  • Timely and effective management of project deliverables including personal workload forecasting and coordination
  • Identify potential project scope changes and aid in development of strategies to minimize impact and control deviations from estimated costs and project deadlines
  • Perform QAQC peer reviews for projects where he or she is not the lead design engineer / power system study specialist.
  • Prepare project reports for internal and external stakeholders for projects which he or she is involved.

Technology, Digital Tools & AI-Enabled Efficiency

  • Leverage AI-enabled and digital tools to enhance efficiency, reduce manual effort, and support consistent, high-quality work output.
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes and demonstrate a continuous learning mindset, seeking out new technologies, skills, and methods that elevate individual and team performance.
  • Adapt to emerging technologies and evolving digital workflows, actively supporting the integration and adoption of innovative tools across the organization.

Completion of assigned tasks and deliverables on time and on budget

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

Position Requirements (INTERMEDIATE level for all the following)

  • Knowledge of electrical topologies associated with mission critical facilities.
  • Knowledge of the operation, types, and settings of protective devices like relays, circuit breakers, and fuses.
  • Understanding of the ratings, capabilities, and conditions of various power system equipment.
  • Knowledge of industry and safety standards related to power systems, especially concerning arc flash hazards and other safety-related matters.
  • Knowledge of the effects and requirements of connecting new generation or loads to existing systems.
  • Skill in using power system simulation software such as ETAP, PSS/E, SKM, Easy Power, etc.
  • Skilled at using MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams), along with exceptional organizational skills for file management
  • Skilled at reviewing design drawings and equipment submittals.
  • Skilled in performing code analysis including selection of equipment, wiring, etc. to meet code requirements
  • Skilled in performing code analysis and advanced knowledge of electrical codes
  • Skilled in completing assignments accurately and with attention to detail
  • Ability to work successfully in a remote environment thru effective communication and organizational skills, self-motivation, proactiveness and resourcefulness in a distraction free workspace
  • Ability to follow company and site safety requirements
  • Ability to analyze and prepare documents, reports and correspondence
  • Ability to communicate effectively in both oral and written form (technical and non-technical information)
  • Ability to communicate effectively directly with clients and at times serve as primary point of client contact
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet close deadlines
  • Ability to effectively plan and delegate the work of others
  • Organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously

Physical Demands

The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is

  • Frequently required to remain in a stationary position
  • Frequently moving through office, facility and other environments
  • On occasion the employee may move equipment weighing up to 25 pounds

Travel / Relocation Requirements

  • Up to 10%, this may include travel to any or all 50 US states
  • Travel is defined as physically leaving home on behalf of business activities including but not limited to client sites, meetings with other employees, meeting for business development purposes, running errands on behalf of the business, attending industry conferences, etc.

Education / Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering from ABET accredited institution

PLUS

  • Minimum of five years of electrical engineering experience

Benefits

DLB Associates offers a very competitive benefits package; highlights include

  • Choice of comprehensive medical plans (including two PPO-style plans and a HDHP w/ HSA option)
  • Flex spending accounts (FSA)
  • Dental and vision plans
  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits extended to spouse / domestic partner and dependent children up to age 26
  • 401k with company match and self-directed brokerage account option
  • PTO including additional paid time off during the last week of the year
  • Company paid life insurance coverage for employees and their eligible dependents
  • Short and long-term disability, AD&D coverage
  • Professional development opportunities, tuition reimbursement and professional licensing assistance
  • Paid parental leave after one year of employment

CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC residents only: In accordance with CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC law, the range provided is DLB's reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location.

DLB Associates is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and participates in the E-Verify program with the Department of Homeland Security. We encourage diversity in our workforce.

Are you ready to challenge yourself and redefine standards in the AEC industry? Apply now and join our award-winning team!​

DLB does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to DLB in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where DLB has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. Through operational support in finance, HR, marketing, technology, producer development, and M&A, we empower agencies to grow while preserving what makes them who they are — their client relationships and their role in the communities they serve. Guided by our trademarked commitment, "Trust, our most important policy," Keystone is building the insurance solution every family and business can count on. For more information, visit .

Operational Readiness Analyst

Position Summary:

The Operational Readiness Analyst role provides analytical, coordination, and documentation support to help ensure agencies are prepared to operate effectively within Keystone’s operating model. Reporting to the Director, Operational Readiness, this role supports readiness assessments, tracks gaps and action items, organizes data and reporting, and helps maintain the tools and materials needed to drive consistent operational readiness execution.

Key Responsibilities:

Readiness Assessment Support

  • Support the preparation, coordination, and documentation of agency readiness assessments.
  • Collect, organize, and validate agency data related to organizational structure, processes, training needs, system usage, and readiness indicators.
  • Maintain readiness trackers, gap logs, action item lists, and supporting documentation.

Operating Model & Process Support

  • Assist in comparing current-state agency practices against Keystone operating model expectations and standard workflows.
  • Document process observations, system-use considerations, and potential areas of misalignment for review by leadership.
  • Support the creation and maintenance of readiness tools, templates, checklists, and agency-facing materials.

Coordination, Reporting & Follow-Up

  • Track readiness milestones, open items, risks, decisions, and follow-ups across assigned agencies or workstreams.
  • Prepare status updates, dashboards, summaries, and meeting materials to support agency readiness discussions.
  • Coordinate with Operations, Training, Agency Support, and agency leadership to ensure timely completion of readiness activities.

Training & Adoption Support

  • Support identification and tracking of agency training needs, adoption risks, and reinforcement opportunities.
  • Partner with Training and Operations teams to ensure learning plans, job aids, and support materials are available and current.
  • Help capture feedback from agency users and summarize themes for continuous improvement.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • Minimum of 8 years of insurance industry experience, including a minimum of 5 years of experience in operations, project coordination, business analysis, agency support, training coordination, or related functions.
  • Experience in insurance, agency operations, brokerage operations, or a multi-site operating environment preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with Applied Epic required.
  • Comfort working with operational data, readiness dashboards, process documentation, and status reporting tools.
  • Strong organizational skills with ability to manage trackers, action items, timelines, and documentation across multiple priorities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with ability to summarize findings clearly for leaders and cross-functional partners.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to organize information, identify themes, and surface readiness gaps.
  • Excellent attention to detail and follow-through, particularly in maintaining trackers, action logs, timelines, and documentation.
  • Process-oriented mindset with the ability to understand workflows, document current-state practices, and support adoption of standard operating models.
  • Adaptability and professionalism in a fast-paced, evolving environment with frequent interaction across agencies and functional teams.
  • Comfort working across multiple locations, coordinating with remote teams, and supporting agencies in both virtual and in-person settings.
  • Approximately 50% travel will be required to support agency readiness assessments, onboarding activities, training reinforcement, leadership meetings, or operating model implementation work.
  • Ability to pass a criminal background check, as permitted by law.

Work Environment:This position offers remote work flexibility.

Salary Transparency Statement: In accordance with state and local pay transparency laws, we will provide the applicable salary range upon request to candidates who reside in jurisdictions where such disclosure is required.

  • Supplemental Insurance including Critical Illness, Accident, Legal, Pet Insurance

title: Helpline Contact Center Supervisor
description: Health Resources in Action, Inc.  (HRiA) is a non-profit organization working to improve and reimagine public health.

raw.title: Helpline Contact Center Supervisor
raw.excerpt: Health Resources in Action, Inc.  (HRiA) is a non-profit organization working to improve and reimagine public health.
raw.description:
Health Resources in Action, Inc. (HRiA) is a non-profit organization working to improve and reimagine public health. We connect, consult, and collaborate to solve complex challenges of access and equity in our health and social systems. Together with our partners, clients, and collaborators, we create actionable solutions so that all people can thrive.

In 1957, The Medical Foundation (TMF) was created to primarily fund biomedical research in Massachusetts. Since then, we’ve been on a journey of evolution. We changed our name to Health Resources in Action (HRiA) to reflect our impact in the field of public health. Today, HRiA works with individuals, organizations, and communities to drive a policy and systems change approach to advance health and racial equity.

HRiA seeks sustainable solutions for complex problems using an anti-racist approach. We aim to be adaptable and flexible in meeting clients and partners where they are, offering our decades of knowledge and resources to collectively realize our dream of equitable, sustainable health for all. The foundation of this work is centered on our values:

  • Health and racial equity by identifying and addressing the root causes of health inequities, intentionally working to shift narratives and power imbalances and disrupt all systems of oppression.
  • Leading with heart by demonstrating our passionate commitment to our work, continuously challenging ourselves with humility and vulnerability while pursuing and holding ourselves accountable to our mission.
  • Collaboration by intentionally and respectfully leading, partnering, and following to strengthen relationships, uplift different voices and build trust.
  • Innovation by driving toward new strategies, questioning norms, and continuously learning and evolving to support the needs of our clients and communities.

HRiA offers exciting, engaging, and challenging employment opportunities for facilitators, trainers, researchers, analysts, policy specialists, grant managers, and more. People come to HRiA because of our commitment to advancing health equity and inspiring work; they stay for our wonderful clients, partners, and dedicated and dynamic staff. With our growing portfolio of high-impact work, person-centered policies, and generous benefits, our team continually invests in making HRiA a great place to work. Our diverse staff of over 270 people hail from 30+ states, with a homebase in Boston’s Chinatown neighborhood.

As part of our Public Health Services, HRiA manages an extensive portfolio of behavioral health initiatives, including statewide substance use helplines in Vermont and Oregon and substance use and problem gambling helplines in Massachusetts and Illinois. The Illinois Helpline for Opioids and Other Substances (Illinois Department of Human Services, Division of Substance Use Prevention and Recovery) was launched in 2017, building upon our experience operating the MA Substance Use Helpline (Massachusetts Department of Public Health, Bureau of Substance Addiction Services) for over 23 years. HRiA launched the Vermont Helplink (Vermont Department of Health, Division of Substance Use Programs) in 2019. HRiA began operating the MA Problem Gambling Helpline (Massachusetts Department of Public Health, Office of Problem Gambling Services) in 2020 and the Illinois Problem Gambling Helpline (Illinois Department of Human Services, Division of Substance Use Prevention and Recovery) in 2022. In December 2023, HRiA launched the Oregon Recovery Center Hotline, now the Oregon Hopeline (Oregon Health Authority).

The Helpline contact center is the hub for the Helplines. Screening & Information Specialists (SIS) comprise most of the contact center team and respond to incoming Helpline inquiries. Four Contact Center Supervisors provide Helpline services and provide direct supervision to a portion of the SIS team. Three Masters-level Clinicians supervise a portion of the SIS, implement follow-up services, and provide additional coverage and support. Additional Helpline team members deliver and support program operations, marketing and communication, web management, and data analysis and management, supervision, and leadership. The larger team is overseen by the Managing Director, Behavioral Health.

To learn more about HRiA and our helplines, visit the following:

  • HRiA:
  • IL Problem Gambling Helpline:
  • MA Problem Gambling Helpline:
  • IL Helpline for Opioids and Other Substances:
  • VT Helplink: www.VTHelplink.org
  • MA Substance Use Helpline:
  • Oregon Hopeline:

Opportunity

We are seeking a full-time Helpline Contact Center Supervisor to join our team on the Oregon Recovery Center Hotline (Oregon Hopeline), Massachusetts Substance Use & Problem Gambling Helplines (MA Helpline), the Illinois Helpline for Opioids and Other Substances (IL Helpline), the Illinois Problem Gambling Helpline, and the Vermont Helplink (VT Helplink). This is an exciting opportunity to take on a newly developed position to support substance use treatment access across three states and supervise a diverse team of staff.

Position Description

We are seeking a full-time Helpline Contact Center Supervisor to join our team for the MA Helpines, the IL Helplines, and VT Helplink. We refer to these projects collectively as “the Helplines.” This is an exciting opportunity to support substance use treatment and problem gambling treatment access across three states and supervise a diverse team of staff.

The Contact Center Supervisors are responsible for handling incoming Helpline inquiries and providing supervisory support to the contact center team. A portion of their time is providing scheduled and as-needed Helpline coverage, in addition to our dedicated team of 22 Screening & Information Specialists (SIS). This includes responding to incoming calls, online chats, and SMS text messages from people seeking information about and help with accessing substance use and/or problem gambling services for themselves, a family member or friend, and/or a client. In this capacity, they assess Helpline users’ needs, determine the most appropriate substance use prevention, treatment, and/or recovery support service options, identify available options (through the Helplines’ databases), and refer callers to those services. They provide accurate information, education, support, and referrals in a non-judgmental, respectful, and culturally competent manner.

About half of their time, Contact Center Supervisors provide supervisory support to the SIS team. Each Supervisor acts as a shift supervisor for SIS while they are working. This includes monitoring SIS consumer interactions, consulting with SIS and intervening during difficult interactions, and addressing any urgent issues as well as supporting the social-emotional wellbeing of staff and fostering their skill-building and professional growth. The Contact Center Supervisor will provide on-going training to SIS through periodic in-service trainings on relevant topics and will assist in the onboarding of new SIS.

Each Supervisor also directly supervises up to six SIS team members. This includes providing bi-weekly supervision, processing timesheets, and assisting with schedule coordination. (SIS also receive regular, group-level supervision from one of our Clinicians.) Contact Center Supervisors are responsible for supporting contact center operations, including helping to coordinate a 24/7 coverage schedule, staffing, and technology needs. They are the liaisons between the contact center team and information technology (IT) support. The Contact Center Supervisor will also be called upon to contribute expertise to the development of policies, procedures, protocols, and curricula to support the Helplines, and may be engaged in providing this expertise to other HRiA teams and projects focused on substance use, problem gambling, and/or behavioral health equity.

This is a full-time, remote position with a salary range of $57,000 to $64,000 based on skills and experience. Supervisors will receive training to assess the needs of Helpline users, provide appropriate information and referrals to services, and engage with and motivate Helpline users to follow through on referrals. They will also receive training on Contact Center operations, supervision essentials, and addiction, screening, treatment services, and resources.

Benefits

HRiA offers strong benefits to its employees, including:

  • Competitive salaries
  • Health insurance
  • Retirement plan
  • Flexible summer hours
  • Vacation starting at four weeks
  • 13 paid holidays, and office closure at the end of December

Duties and Responsibilities

Management

  • Coordinate and implement projects related to contact center operations, including technology, equipment, onboarding & training, among others, as assigned.
  • Work with Helpline Management to coordinate Helpline staffing schedules to ensure continuous 24-hour staffing coverage.
  • Serve as liaison between SIS and other project and organizational teams, to ensure appropriate representation and facilitate team integration.
  • Supervise up to six SIS.
  • Participate in on-call rotation.

Project Work

  • Troubleshoot technical contact center issues, and serve as liaison to IT support.
  • Assist with coordination and implementation of onboarding and professional development activities.
  • Assess the needs of Helpline users by telephone, online chat, and SMS texting.
  • Provide appropriate information and referrals to substance use, problem gambling, and/or related services.
  • Engage and motivate Helpline users to follow through on referrals by using active listening and motivational interviewing techniques.
  • Obtain feedback on interactions with Helpline users.
  • Gather and record data from Helpline users in Helpline database.
  • Verify Helpline users’ insurance status, as applicable.
  • Escalate Helpline user interactions to Helpline Managers as needed.
  • Represent the Helpline at outreach events, meetings, and/or presentations as needed.

Thought Leadership

  • Continue to build and develop expertise in substance use disorders, problem gambling, and behavioral health equity.
  • Suggest ideas/improvements through participation in teams and committees.
  • Attend and actively participate in Helpline meetings and other activities to develop skills and make suggestions for project enhancements.

New Business Development

  • Maintain updated resume and bio for use in new business proposals.
  • Assist with technical components of new business proposals as needed.

Candidate Qualifications

  • Five years of related experience (lived or professional) in the fields of substance use, recovery, problem gambling, and/or harm reductions Services, and manage mentor bachelor’s degree in psychology, social work, human services, or related field in lieu of experience.
  • Certified Resource Specialist (through Inform USA) preferred or willingness to obtain certification (at HRiA expense) within one year of hire.
  • Demonstrated experience and ability to supervise staff, and provide appropriate guidance, feedback, mentorship, and support.
  • Experience in information and referral services, customer service, counseling, substance use, problem gambling, or human services required.
  • Ability to adapt to changes in work environment and expectations.
  • Customer/consumer focused with excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Good computer skills and experience and/or ability to use online systems and databases.
  • Openness to information that may be different from personal views.
  • Willingness to work with consumers who may be ambivalent, resistant, impaired or have psychological disorders.
  • Must be open to providing information about a variety of treatment options and paths to recovery based on a caller’s needs.
  • Must be respectful of cultural differences and value diversity of thought, backgrounds, and perspectives.
  • Must have high ethical standards and a willingness to comply with professional expectations.
  • Demonstrated history of dependability needed.
  • Two years of sobriety requested for people in recovery.
  • Fluency in a language other than English (e.g., Spanish, Portuguese, Mandarin) is a plus.

Hours for this position will be non-traditional, requiring either early morning or late evening and weekend availability. The position includes weekend or overnight on-call duties. The Helplines are open 24 hours/day, 7 days/week, 365 days a year.

This description is intended to indicate the kinds of work duties that will be required in this position. It is not intended to limit, or in any way modify, the rights of any supervisor to assign, direct, and contract work of staff under his/her supervision. The use of a particular illustration describing duties shall not be held to exclude other duties, not mentioned, that are of a similar level or difficulty.

Procedure for Candidacy

HRiA is actively seeking to build a diverse and experienced staff. The organization encourages multiple perspectives and experiences, supports a multicultural environment, and strives to hire and retain a diverse work force that reflects the populations we work with and the communities where we work. Diversity is a core value of HRiA resulting in culturally competent services, materials, resources, and programs. Our hiring and business practices appreciate the strengths offered through different backgrounds.

HRiA is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer and is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.

To apply, submit your cover letter and resume online at

Generally, our interviews take place between 9am-5pm ET. If you are contacted for an interview, please let us know if this timeframe is a challenge, so we can work with the interview team to find alternatives.

raw.description:
über nscon

Du automatisierst lieber Workflows, ziehst eigene Labs hoch und testest KI-Agenten, anstatt nur darüber zu lesen? Perfekt. Denn wir bei nscon glauben: Die Netzwerk-Experten der Zukunft werden nicht von der KI ersetzt – sondern von denen, die sie beherrschen.
Wir verbinden das Beste aus zwei Welten: High-End-Infrastruktur und die Tech-Stacks von morgen. Bei uns automatisierst du Netzwerke, baust Single Sources of Truth mit NetBox/Nautobot und Orchestration mit n8n.
Das Versprechen: Echter Impact, null Konzernpolitik, null Ego-Show. Dafür maximale Freiheit, neue Technologien produktiv einzusetzen und die IT-Zukunft aktiv mitzugestalten.

Network Automation Engineer / Consultant (m/w/d) - 100% HO | Automatisierung, SSoT & KI-Agenten

deine mission

???? Du willst nicht „einfach nur Projekte abarbeiten“?
Perfekt. Denn bei nscon suchen wir keine Ticket-Abarbeiter. Wir suchen Menschen, die Infrastruktur neu denken. Du steigst in anspruchsvolle Enterprise-Projekte ein und bewegst dich genau an der Schnittstelle von Netzwerk, Security, Automatisierung und KI. Dabei geht es nicht nur darum, bestehende Prozesse zu automatisieren. Es geht darum, neue Betriebsmodelle zu entwickeln.
Wie wird Infrastruktur zur Single Source of Truth?
Wie können KI-Agenten repetitive Aufgaben übernehmen?
Wie lassen sich Netzwerkplattformen, Dokumentation, Logging und Automatisierung intelligent miteinander verbinden?

deine aufgaben

???? Was dich erwartet:

  • Du arbeitest in Projekten mit echter Tiefe, beispielsweise:
  • Du automatisierst Netzwerk- und Security-Plattformen bei großen Enterprise-Kunden
  • DuentwickelstInfrastructure-as-Code-Lösungen mitAnsible, Terraform und modernen DevOps-Methoden
  • Du baust Single SourcesofTruth mitNetBoxoderNautobotauf und integrierst sie in bestehende Betriebsprozesse
  • Du orchestrierst Automatisierungs- und KI-Agenten mit Plattformen wie n8n
  • Du verbindest Netzwerk-, Security-,Logging- und Monitoring-Systeme über APIs und Event-Driven Workflows
  • Du entwickelst Automatisierungsplattformen für komplexe Infrastrukturumgebungen
  • Du evaluierst neue Technologien und bringst Innovationen produktiv in Kundenumgebungen
Deine Aufgaben:
  • Automatisierung von Netzwerk- und Security-Konfigurationen (Cisco,Check Point,Juniper, Palo Alto, Fortinet etc.)
  • Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung moderner Automatisierungsplattformen
  • InfrastructureasCode mitAnsible, Terraform und ähnlichen Technologien
  • Containerisierung mit Docker undKubernetes
  • Entwicklung und Automatisierung von CI/CD-Prozessen
  • Aufbau und Pflege von Single SourcesofTruth (NetBox,Nautobot)
  • Orchestrierung von KI-Agenten und Automatisierungsworkflows mit n8n
  • Integration von APIs, Datenquellen und Infrastrukturplattformen
  • Analyse, Troubleshooting und kontinuierliche Optimierung von Automatisierungslösungen
  • Technische Beratung rund um Netzwerkautomatisierung, Security und moderne Infrastrukturarchitekturen
  • (Teil-)Projektverantwortung – wenn du das möchtest

dein profil

???? Was du mitbringen solltest:

  • Du musst nicht alles perfekt beherrschen. Aber du solltest Spaß daran haben, Technologien auszuprobieren, zu hinterfragen und produktiv einzusetzen.
  • Besonders wichtig sind uns folgende Kenntnisse und Interessen:
  • Erfahrung im Bereich Netzwerk, Security, Automation oder DevOps
  • Netzwerkverständnis auf mindestens CCNA-Niveau
  • Python oder vergleichbare Skriptsprachen
  • Docker,Kubernetes,Gitund CI/CD-Pipelines
  • REST-APIs, JSON, YAML, YANG/NETCONF/RESTCONF, Postman/Bruno& Co.
  • InfrastructureasCode mitAnsible, Terraform oder vergleichbaren Technologien
  • Kritisches Denken im Umgang mit KI-Systemen:Du hinterfragst Ergebnisse, prüfst,ob ein Agent tatsächlich das getan hat, was er tun sollte, und übernimmst Verantwortung für die Outputs
  • Deutsch (mind. C1) und Englisch (mind. B1/B2)

Nice-to-haves:
  • Cisco AIBIZ, AITECH, DCAI oder ähnliche KI-Weiterbildungen
  • Erfahrungmit n8n oder vergleichbaren Automatisierungsplattformen
  • KenntnisseinNetBox,NautobotoderähnlichenSSoT/NSoT-Plattformen
  • Monitoring-,Logging- und SIEM-Lösungen wie Splunk, Prometheus/Grafana,GraylogoderQRadar
  • NetBoxCopiilotund KI-gestützte Infrastruktur-Workflows

Zertifikate? Fördern wir.
Neugier? Erwünscht.
Ego? Nicht nötig.

warum wir?

???? Was dich bei nscon wirklich erwartet:
???? Remote & Vertrauensarbeitszeit Du entscheidest, von wo du arbeitest, Hauptsache du bist im Projekt präsent.

???? 40 Stunden Weiterbildung im Jahr Plus zertifizierter Learncoach, Wunschzertifikate und echte Budgetfreiräume.

???? Extras, die du wirklich nutzt Von Rewe-Gutschein bis Firmenwagen (auch Bulli-fähig). Von Kitazuschuss bis Fitnesscoach.

???? Wunschprojekt & Arbeitsbereich? Deine Entscheidung! Du bist von Anfang an bei der Auswahl deines Wunsch-Projekts dabei und gestaltest deinen Arbeitsbereich aktiv mit.

???? Teamevents & Workation und ein starker Zusammenhalt Ob digital oder live: Wir feiern Erfolge, tauschen uns aus und bleiben verbunden, auch über große Entfernungen hinweg.

Kultur, die sich nicht nach Consulting anfühlt Kein Bullshit-Bingo. Keine Dresscodes. Dafür echte Menschen, Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe und ein Team, das zusammenhält, auch remote.

„Ich darf sein, wie ich bin – und das fühlt sich verdammt gut an.“ – kununu-Bewertung

Neugierig? Dann schreib uns – oder klick dich direkt rein:
????????‍♀️ Beatrice Fischer (Recruiting Manager)

???? +49 151 5377 7631

????
????


Let’s build the networks of tomorrow – together.

raw.description:
URGENT HIRING

Job Title: Operations Assistant

Location: Remote

Employment Type:Part-time (approx. 20 hours/week), with potential to scale

Work Hours:10AM-2PM (New South Wales Time)

Reports to: CEO

About the Role

We are currently hiring for one our client based in Australia, we’re looking for a highly organised, systems-driven Operations Assistant to work directly with the CEO of the company and coordinate the operational engine of their accounting practice.

This role sits firmly within the accounting domain. You must understand Australian bookkeeping and management accounting fundamentals. However, this is not a standalone client accountant role.

Your focus will be:

  • Operational execution
  • Workflow coordination
  • System management
  • Capacity oversight

This is an independent contributor role for someone who thrives in structured environments, respects systems, and knows how to improve efficiency without disrupting operational stability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate daily work across bookkeeping, payroll, reconciliations, and reporting.
  • Organise, assign, track, and monitor tasks through ClickUp.
  • Monitor team capacity and ensure work is delivered according to client agreements and deadlines.
  • Identify workflow bottlenecks and help resolve them proactively.
  • Maintain organised documentation and filing systems within Google Workspace.
  • Ensure existing SOPs and processes for Australian bookkeeping and management accounting are consistently followed.
  • Maintain and improve ClickUp dashboards, workflows, templates, and task visibility.
  • Support workflow automation and encourage consistent use of systems across the team.
  • Assist the CEO with operational planning, prioritisation, summaries, and internal initiatives.
  • Track action items and ensure tasks are followed through and completed.
  • Conduct preliminary quality checks on reconciliations, coding, and workpapers.
  • Monitor scope adherence and flag any out-of-scope work.
  • Assist with tracking aged receivables and other internal operational matters.
  • Step in and support hands-on when needed to keep important deadlines on track.
  • Manage licences, subscriptions, and system access.
  • Support the onboarding of new team members into company tools and workflows.
  • Maintain confidentiality and ensure the protection of client information and intellectual property

Must-Have Requirements

  • Experience in an accounting, bookkeeping or management accounting environment
  • Background in operations, practice management, admin VA or executive support within an accounting firm
  • Strong understanding of Australian bookkeeping fundamentals (GST, BAS, payroll, super, month-end)
  • Hands-on experience with ClickUp (dashboards, workflows, templates)
  • High proficiency in Google Workspace
  • Experience with Xero, QuickBooks Online and/or MYOB
  • Strong organisational and time management skills
  • Systems-oriented mindset with respect for existing frameworks
  • Ability to operate independently without close supervision
  • Openness to leveraging automation and AI tools where beneficial

Who This Role Suits

This role is ideal for someone within the accounting industry who enjoys operations, structure and execution more than purely technical accounting work, and wants to work closely with a CEO in a growing accounting practice.

If you enjoy building clarity, protecting systems, and ensuring operational discipline inside an accounting environment, this will feel like home.

raw.description:
ThePayments Team Lead owns the performance and service quality of Leadtech's payment ecosystem across two complementary functions: a Revenue Optimization team, focused on maximizing authorization rates and transaction profitability across PSPs and payment methods, and an Account Management team, which acts as the internal payments partner to Leadtech's business units, managing payment strategy on a B2B basis within the company.

This person must bring a very strong technical/analytical leadership (data-driven AR improvement, PSP economics, APM evaluation) together with internal stakeholder management (service quality, account ownership, cross-BU coordination), to successfully manage and develop the two direct sub-teams.

Key Responsibilities

1. Payment & Revenue Optimization

  • Monitor and optimize payment performance and transaction profitability across PSPs and business units.

  • Analyze Payment Authorization Rates (AR), decline reasons, traffic distribution and payment performance to identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Support the implementation of payment optimization initiatives, including 3DS, network tokens, retry logic, routing rules and data enrichment.

  • Evaluate new Alternative Payment Methods (APMs) and PSP optimization tools based on business impact, customer experience and ROI.

  • Work with internal stakeholders and external PSPs to identify and resolve payment performance issues.

  • Build and maintain dashboards and reporting to support day-to-day payment decision-making, including AR, decline reasons and PSP/MID performance.

2. Internal Account Management & Business Partnership

  • Own and proactively manage the payment strategy for each business unit

  • Act as a trusted payments partner for Leadtech's business units, understanding their payment needs and supporting them in achieving their business goals.

  • Provide recommendations on PSP and APM mix based on business requirements, traffic profiles and risk considerations.

  • Proactively communicate payment performance, incidents, opportunities and relevant roadmap initiatives to internal stakeholders.

  • Coordinate payment-related requirements for new business needs, including new MIDs, markets, PSPs and payment methods.

  • Establish effective communication and escalation processes with business units and relevant internal teams.

3. Team Leadership

  • Lead and support a Payments team across Revenue Optimization and Account Management activities.

  • Set priorities and coordinate workload based on business impact, urgency and team capacity.

  • Coach and develop team members, providing guidance, feedback and support to help them grow their capabilities.

  • Help establish team objectives and contribute to the achievement of Payments & Risk OKRs.

  • Act as a point of escalation between the team and other Payments & Risk functions, including Risk Analytics, Finance and Partnerships.

  • Report on team performance, key challenges and progress to the Payments & Risk Manager.

4. Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Partner with Risk & Compliance on payment-related risk and chargeback initiatives that may impact authorization rates and routing decisions.

  • Collaborate with external payment orchestration partners and PSP account managers on routing, enrichment, APM and other payment-related initiatives.

  • Work closely with Product, Engineering, Finance, Risk and business stakeholders to ensure payment initiatives are aligned with business priorities.

  • Ensure payment optimization initiatives are evaluated from both a performance and business-unit perspective before implementation.

Success Metrics / KPIs

  • Improvement in Payment Authorization Rate (AR), overall and by PSP/BU.

  • Checkout conversion improvement.

  • Revenue and performance impact from new APMs and PSP optimization initiatives.

  • Payment performance and issue resolution times.

  • Internal stakeholder satisfaction and adherence to agreed SLAs.

  • Adoption and effective use of payment analytics and reporting tools.

Required Skills
Experience

  • 5–8 years of overall professional experience, with 4–5 years in payments, fintech, e-commerce or a related environment.

  • 2–3 years of people management experience or demonstrated informal/team leadership experience, with the ability to coach, prioritize and support others.

  • Hands-on experience working with PSPs and payment performance, ideally with providers such as Stripe, Worldpay, Adyen, PayPal or similar.

  • Practical experience analyzing authorization rates, decline reasons and payment performance, and identifying optimization opportunities.

  • Experience working in a multi-PSP environment, with exposure to payment routing, orchestration and/or payment optimization.

  • Experience with Alternative Payment Methods (APMs) and an understanding of their role in payment performance and customer conversion.

  • Experience working with internal stakeholders, business units or account-management environments.

Skills

  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret payment performance data and identify actionable insights.

  • Good understanding of payment optimization concepts, including authorization rates, decline analysis, routing, retries, 3DS, tokenization and data enrichment.

  • Working knowledge of APMs and multi-PSP payment environments.

  • Working knowledge of data and reporting tools such as Excel/Google Sheets and BI tools (e.g. Qlik, Tableau, Power BI).

  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.

  • Excellent communication skills in English.

  • Ability to work hands-on while also coordinating and supporting a small team.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with payment orchestration platforms or advanced routing solutions.

  • Familiarity with card-scheme risk and compliance programs, including Mastercard/Visa chargeback monitoring.

  • Experience working with international markets and different payment methods.

  • Fluent Spanish.

Our Values & Expectations

It is essential to embody the core values transmitted by Leadtech, aligning and guiding our actions toward a shared vision:

  • Optimism: Viewing challenges as opportunities and inspiring the team so that we all work together with a positive mindset.

  • Passion: Enjoying the journey together to achieve our goals, ensuring everyone experiences a collaborative and rewarding teamwork environment.

  • Commitment & Reliability: Being able to count on your teammates and inspiring the trust necessary for the team to confidently count on you.

For this particular role, we look for key values that foster seamless and harmonious collaboration within the team:

  • Adaptability & Flexibility: In the face of unexpected changes or shifts in strategy, staying flexible by offering solutions and fresh perspectives to successfully meet new requirements.

  • Creativity: Maintaining a close understanding of our projects, contributing innovative ideas, and encouraging the team to develop them to meet and exceed our clients' needs.

  • Trust & Confidence: As a role that involves implementing practices, processes, and testing, you must be able to trust your colleagues and instill confidence in the decisions made across both technical and business strategies.

Benefits

Why leadtech

  • Diversified app portfolio with millions of active users in a high-growth non-gaming vertical.

  • Mature data infrastructure: BigQuery, Looker, AppsFlyer, and a proprietary analytics stack for fast decision-making.

  • Experimentation culture: real autonomy to propose and ship changes in production.

  • International team, dynamic environment, and the opportunity for direct P&L impact.

  • Competitive compensation package + benefits (flexible hours, health insurance, training).

Growth and career development

  • At Leadtech, we prioritize your growth. Enjoy a flexible career path with personalized internal training and an annual budget for external learning opportunities.

Work-Life balance

  • Benefit from a flexible schedule with flextime and the option of working full remote or from our Barcelona office. Enjoy free Friday afternoons with a 7-hour workday, plus a 35-hour workweek in July and August so you can savor summer!

Comprehensive benefits

  • Competitive salary, full-time permanent contract, and top-tier private health insurance (including dental and psychological services).

  • 25 days of vacation plus your birthday off, with flexible vacation options—no blackout days!

Unique Perks

  • If you wish to come, in our office in Barcelona you’ll find it complete with free coffee, fresh fruit, snacks, a game room, and a rooftop terrace with stunning Mediterranean views.

  • Additional benefits include ticket restaurant and nursery vouchers, paid directly from your gross salary.

  • Join us in an environment where you’re free to innovate, learn, and grow alongside passionate professionals. At Leadtech, you’ll tackle exciting challenges and be part of a vibrant team dedicated to delivering exceptional user experiences

Sounds good? Apply now! We’re looking forward to getting to know you.

Equal Employment Opportunity Employer:

Leadtech is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Employer, which means we encourage applications from people with different backgrounds, interests, and personal circumstances. Our team welcomes applicants regardless of their race, gender, age, religion, nationality, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expressión and/or disabilities. All we need is your high energy, skills, and willingness to be a part of a great project!

Location

You'll have the flexibility to choose whether you'd like to come to the office every day, from time to time, or work fully remote. We want you to find the best combination for you.

If you prefer to be surrounded with amazing people, our exceptional office is in Barcelona’s Blue Building, located right on the city's seafront. Besides our stunning views, you’ll enjoy our office perks such as free fruit, snacks, and coffee and you’ll also be able to take part in our Mario Kart and table tennis competitions.

The personal data you provide will be processed in order to manage your candidacy for the corporate selection processes that fit your profile. As a Delivery Director in a Computacenter Delivery Region, you will be accountable for leading a team of Delivery Managers aligned to Customer accounts in Computacenter’s core sales regions, United Kingdom, Germany, France, and U.S.A.

You will contribute to the functional strategy whilst establishing team-specific objectives and goals. You will create leadership and followership through leading and managing teams of people, both directly and through matrix management and will develop and motivate teams to ensure the delivery of both functional and business targets. You will implement and operate an effective governance model to ensure that the services are delivered to satisfy both the Customer’s and Computacenter’s required outcomes, including but not limited to aligning with the CC operating model, service levels, OLAs, customer satisfaction and financial targets as well as driving positive change in pursuit of service excellence.

You will establish productive relationships and networks at a Senior Executive level as well as acting as a point of escalation and guidance for major and or complex issues and campaigns. You will also play a key role in the Delivery Leadership senior team working together to grow Computacenter’s business.

You will have a role to play as a coach and mentor to other employees to ensure the continuous development of Computacenter and its people. You will also have a responsibility to engage and play a part as a senior manager in the wider organization, working within strategic change, cost optimization and ongoing transformational initiatives in our Group Delivery business.

What you'll be doing

  • Lead and drive the performance of internal and Third-Party delivery teams against agreed standards, service levels and polices in support of the above and to ensure optimized customer satisfaction
  • Lead and drive the continual improvement of both the efficiency & effectiveness of delivery processes and services, adding value that is relevant to the customer throughout the contract lifecycle, whilst also supporting Group Delivery strategies and objectives
  • Implement governance according to the policies and operating models defined by Computacenter. Employ and develop processes within Delivery Leadership to identify and manage risks in service delivery, assess commercial implications and take measures to eliminate and or avoid risks.
  • Support the delivery of Change Services (projects, programs, and professional services engagements)
  • Working alongside and supporting our Sales and Services colleagues in a matrix leadership role to support the achievement of contracted outcomes for both the Customer and Computacenter
  • In Account – Work with the key stakeholders to support, socialize and lead an account strategy and execution plan. Supporting the aspects related to Run in your delivery location whilst also supporting your Group Delivery operational colleagues to deliver service excellence.
  • You will develop and Implement a Communications Plan, covering your Group Delivery location & the extended Delivery Leadership teams, ensuring clear & consistent messaging both verbally & in written form across various media.
  • Take accountability for capacity planning to include all Computacenter ISPs and cross vendor with a view to optimization (i.e., reduced site occupancy, remote delivery of service and location strategy etc.)
  • Support our Group Services colleagues in the negotiation and agreement of new contracts within the Customer account
  • Lead the management of all agreed contracts in relation to delivery in your location and ensure compliance to contractual requirements, associated policies, internal and external.
  • Financial Management
  • Lead and manage the delivery of contracted Run Services in your region to ensure accurate forecasting and cost management to achieve or exceed the agreed baseline cost targets
  • Support our Group Services colleagues where appropriate, in the costing for services in Presales (if Group Delivery) if not part of a larger ‘service Design’
  • Work in partnership with the Group Delivery senior management in your location to ensure that we meet our Group Delivery objectives related to the operations in that region.
  • Work in partnership with the Delivery Leadership senior to ensure that we meet our Group Delivery objectives in a consistent way for our customers.
  • Perform all Line Management responsibilities for all Direct Reports. Ensure that your team, both direct and virtual, is appropriately motivated and engaged and that individual performance is managed.
  • Develop, maintain, and execute a People strategy, including succession planning, people and capability development and talent identification and retention
  • Lead the development and execution of an Employee Engagement and Enablement strategy. Proactively support the Employee Engagement strategies of other Managers with people or teams engaged in the Customer Account to maximise overall people engagement.
  • Develop, maintain, and execute a communications strategy in support of Delivery Leadership’s goals and the Employee Engagement strategy
  • Act as a Mentor, Coach and Leader within wider in-country Services and CC business.

What you have

  • Legally eligible to work in the United States
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology or related field, or equivalent experience
  • Experienced in the art of managing customers and operations in a multi-client MSP environment
  • You will know to inspire and develop your team to be their best
  • You will be talented at influencing senior colleagues to improve and grow our operations and services effectively
  • You will be an experienced practitioner in IT Service Management
  • You are likely trained in ITIL to Expert status.

What you can expect

There’s so much more to enjoy about being at Computacenter than just having a rewarding career. In addition to offering competitive compensation plans and long-term career opportunities, we provide an attractive mix of benefit plans to contribute to your good health, future financial security, and peace of mind.

About us

Computacenter is a leading independent technology partner, trusted by large corporate and public sector organizations. We help our world-renowned customers to source, transform, and manage their IT infrastructure to deliver digital transformation, enabling users and their business. We’re a public company quoted on the London FTSE 250 (CCC.L) and employ over 21,000 people worldwide. In the US, we support some of the country’s best-known businesses with regional hubs in San Francisco and Irvine, CA; Norcross, GA; Plano, TX; and New York City; and Integration Centers in Silicon Valley and Atlanta.

raw.description:
Join Rimkus and unlock your potential with endless opportunities for growth, learning, and making a difference!

Rimkus ( is a worldwide leader in Engineering and Technical Consulting. Rimkus experts specialize in building envelope, engineering, forensic consulting, dispute resolution, construction management services, and solutions built for the environment.

NOW IS THE TIME to join this growing and stable company! We offer our full-time employees a competitive salary, bonus opportunities and a full benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life, disability, employer-matching 401(k), and opportunities for advancement!

Overview:

Rimkus is seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Digital Forensic Examiner to conduct thorough and legally sound investigations of digital media. The Digital Forensic Examiner will be responsible for the acquisition, preservation, analysis, and reporting on digital evidence matters. The ideal candidate will possess a strong understanding of digital forensics principles, methodologies, and tools, along with excellent analytical and communication skills.

Requirements

Essential Job Functions

  • Perform forensic examinations of mobile devices (smartphones and tablets) running iOS and Android operating systems.
  • Conduct extractions of data from mobile devices using industry-standard hardware and software (e.g., Cellebrite, Magnet AXIOM).
  • Employ techniques to bypass or overcome device security features (where legally permissible and ethical) to access data.
  • Perform data recovery from damaged, locked, or malfunctioning mobile devices.
  • Analyze mobile device data, including but not limited to: call logs, SMS/MMS messages, contacts, photos, videos, email, application data, web history, location data, and social media activity.
  • Conduct SIM card and SD card analysis.
  • Document all findings, methodologies, and chain of custody in clear and concise reports.
  • Present technical findings related to mobile device evidence to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of current mobile forensic trends, tools, and techniques, as well as mobile operating system updates and security features.
  • Adhere to established forensic procedures, legal guidelines, and ethical standards related to mobile device evidence.
  • Collaborate effectively with other team members on investigations involving mobile devices.
  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally for cases as needed.

Required Education and Certifications:

  • Bachelor's degree is preferable but not required. Experience in Law Enforcement, Information Technology, or a related field. Equivalent experience and relevant certifications may be considered.
  • 3 + years of experience in digital forensics investigations, with a significant portion focused on mobile device forensics.

Required Skills and Abilities

  • Proven expertise in using mobile forensic tools such as Cellebrite UFED/Physical Analyzer, Magnet AXIOM, and others.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills, specifically applied to digital forensic investigations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate mobile forensic findings.
  • Understanding of legal and evidentiary procedures related to mobile device evidence.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Relevant certifications such as Cellebrite Certified Mobile Examiner (CCME), Magnet Certified Forensic Examiner (MCFE), International Association of Computer Investigative Specialists (CMDE), or similar.
  • Experience with scripting languages (e.g., Python) for mobile forensic tasks.
  • Experience in courtroom testimony and depositions.

At Rimkus, we value a diverse and inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued and respected. We are committed to creating a work environment that supports and celebrates the unique perspectives and experiences of all employees. If you share our commitment to diversity and inclusivity and are excited about joining a welcoming and supportive team, we encourage you to apply for our open positions.

Rimkus is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employee and will make all employment-related decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

THIS JOB DESCRIPTION IS SUBJECT TO CHANGE AND DOES NOT CONSTITUTE A CONTRACT FOR EMPLOYMENT OR A GUARANTEE OF CONTINUED EMPLOYMENT.

Benefits

  • Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
  • Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
  • Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
  • Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
  • Short Term & Long Term Disability
  • Training & Development
  • Work From Home

Unser Mandant ist ein dynamisch wachsendes Pharmaunternehmen mit einem nachhaltigen Geschäftsmodell und international ausgerichteten Strukturen.
In dieser verantwortungsvollen Führungsposition übernehmen Sie die ganzheitliche Qualitätsverantwortung für ein definiertes Produktportfolio und tragen unmittelbar zur Compliance, Produktverfügbarkeit und Patientensicherheit bei.

Senior Product Quality Leader (m/w/d)

  • Fachliche Führung sowie kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Mitarbeiter innerhalb des Quality Teams

  • Ausgeprägtes strategisches Denkvermögen sowie die Fähigkeit, Qualitätsaspekte wirksam in Produkt- und Portfolioentscheidungen einzubringen
  • Souveräner Umgang mit komplexen Eskalations- und Konfliktsituationen auf unterschiedlichen Hierarchieebenen
  • Hohe Entscheidungs- und Umsetzungsstärke verbunden mit einer strukturierten, lösungsorientierten und verantwortungsbewussten Arbeitsweise

  • Flexible Zusatzleistungen, beispielsweise für Altersvorsorge, Gesundheit, Fitness, Mobilität oder Verpflegung

raw.title: Software Engineer 6 - Ad Serving Platform
raw.excerpt: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world.
raw.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

We launched a new ad-supported tierin November 2022 to offer our members more choice in how they consume their content. Our new tier allows us to attract new members at a lower price point while also creating a compelling path for advertisers to reach deeply engaged audiences.

Our Team

The Ads Serving Platform engineering team sits within the Ad Serving & Decisioning org at Netflix Ads. We own the high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems that power real-time ad decisioning. Our work focuses on the core platform architectures supporting ranking and scoring, auction mechanics, budget and pacing systems, and goal-based delivery optimization. We care deeply about how systems work and building resilient systems at scale.

We are looking for a senior technical leader to own the technical direction of this platform pod, set the architectural bar, and drive execution on the hardest problems in high-throughput systems optimization at Netflix.

What You'll Do

  • Technical Direction:Help drive the overall technical direction of the ad-serving platform. Partner across engineering teams to ensure the ecosystem meets SLAs, SLOs, and uptime requirements.

  • Low-Latency Distributed Platform:Architect a concurrent platform optimized for high-throughput systems while monitoring, diagnosing, and mitigating tail latencies across core execution paths.

  • Networking & Performance Engineering:Work with I/O-bound and CPU-bound workloads. Profile and tune network and system layers, and build automated performance-benchmarking frameworks within the CI/CD pipeline to identify latency regressions.

  • Modular Platform Design:Build a modular architecture that enables other teams to build on top of the platform. Create entry points for external components like model-serving runtimes, budget/pacing systems, and programmatic demand engines that handle outbound networking and QPS management.

  • Operational Excellence & Resiliency:Architect a system that is straightforward to operate and maintain. Maintain a high standard for distributed systems design and resiliency, ensuring graceful degradation during traffic spikes or live events.

Skills & Experience We're Seeking

  • Distributed Systems Experience:10+ years of experience building distributed systems, core backend infrastructure, or high-throughput platforms.

  • Low-Latency Systems Engineering:Deep expertise writing clean, highly optimized code in systems languages (e.g., Java, Go, C++, or Rust) with a proven track record of handling high-transaction volumes.

  • Concurrency & Algorithmic Design:Practical experience with multi-threaded systems design, concurrent programming, and algorithmic design for highly concurrent workloads (including lock-free data structures or lock contention mitigation).

  • Networking & I/O Optimization:Understanding of distributed system fundamentals, specifically managing I/O-bound and CPU-bound workloads, network protocols, and data partitioning strategies.

  • Performance Measurement & Telemetry:Experience using profiling and diagnostic tools to measure system performance, analyze tail latencies, identify execution hotspots, and build telemetry or monitoring hooks.

  • Architecture & Collaboration:Ability to translate complex algorithmic requirements (such as business logic or data science models) into extensible platform components that support multiple teams.

  • Modern Development Tooling:Comfort using modern development tools and LLM assistance to accelerate implementation while maintaining architectural oversight and code quality.

Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $499,000.00 - $900,000.00.

Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here.

Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here.

Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service.

What We Do

We’re on a mission to empower animal healthcare professionals with opportunities to earn more and achieve greater flexibility in their careers and personal lives.

Powered by groundbreaking technology, Roo has built the industry-leading veterinary staffing platform, connecting Veterinarians, Technicians, and Assistants with animal hospitals for relief work and hiring opportunities. Roo empowers the largest network of over 20,000 veterinary professionals to help more than 9,000 animal hospitals provide quality care to more pets.
Together, we’ve provided more than 3 million hours of healthcare, helping Veterinarians earn more than $200 million.

About the Role

Roo is looking for a fantastic Client Support Specialist who will facilitate positive user experiences for all veterinarians, hospitals and technicians on our innovative veterinary staffing platform.

NOTE – This position requires working during client support hours – which can include early morning and early evening hours (Central time), AND weekend rotations.

Your Responsibilities

  • Be one of the point-of-contacts for customer inquiries coming through our online support channels – email, LiveChat, 1-833-Roo Vet, etc.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve any first line issues raised by our hospital/vet/tech users, providing accurate, complete, and supportive responses.
  • Coordinate second line/escalated issues with relevant regional BD/AMs and other departments as needed.
  • Facilitate and help to manage potential call outs with current processes in place.
  • Proactively document rainy day scenarios as encountered and share any key learnings with the team.
  • Maintain Hubspot to be sure all client communications & CS tickets are documented appropriately.
  • Coordinate with Finance, data, and other departments on rainy-day, shift, and payment reconciliation; generate reports as needed.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years experience in client/customer support, ideally in an early-stage start-up environment.
  • Vet technician/animal healthcare industry experience a plus
  • Proactive, organized and accurate in all internal and external company communications.
  • Excellent communication & organizational skills.
  • Familiar with customer support tools/software.
  • Timely and efficient in task accuracy and completions.
  • Flexible & agile, ability to pivot quickly.
  • Driven to improve processes/ communications.
  • Excited to join an ever growing team of professional diverse individuals.

While we are a remote first company, if you are based in San Francisco this will be a hybrid role.

Core Values

Our Core Values are what shape us as an organization and we're looking for people who exhibit the same values in their professional life; Bias to Urgency, Drive Measurable Impact, Seek Understanding, Solve Customer Problems and Have Fun!

What to expect from working at Roo!

For permanent, full time employees, we offer:

  • Stipends for home office setup, continuing education, and monthly wellness.
