raw.description:
Head of Security & Infrastructure

Location: Remote - United States only (must reside in the U.S.)

Team: Security & Infrastructure

Reports to: CTO (you'll work directly with the CTO)

About Rise

Rise is a global payments and payroll platform built for the way modern teams actually work - across borders, currencies, and rails. We make it possible for companies to pay full-time employees, contractors, and freelancers anywhere in the world, in either fiat or digital assets, with the compliance, tax, and identity infrastructure handled underneath.

Our stack runs on Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, BigQuery, Google SecOps), with MySQL, a Node.js / TypeScript application layer, and Cloudflare (including Cloudflare Pages) at the edge. Settlement for stablecoin payments runs on Ethereum and EVM-compatible networks through our own smart contracts and treasury wallets. Because we move money for real people, security and correctness are first-order concerns in everything we ship.

Our Culture

We're a lean, high-trust, high-ownership team. Because we move real money for real people, we hold a high bar for correctness, security, and accountability - the work is meaningful precisely because the stakes are real. We value:

  • Ownership over hand-offs. You'll own security and infrastructure end to end and have the autonomy that comes with that.

  • Security as a default, not a phase. Handling funds and personal data means security thinking is part of every decision, not a box checked at the end.

  • Directness and low ego. We give and receive candid feedback, write things down, and prefer clarity over politics.

  • AI-first in how work gets done. We use AI agents and assistants as a core part of daily work - writing and reviewing code and Terraform, triaging alerts, investigating logs, drafting runbooks and policies, and automating the toil that would otherwise eat the day. We expect everyone to work this way and to keep getting better at it.

  • Remote-first discipline. We're a globally distributed team spread across time zones around the world, and we communicate asynchronously with a bias toward documentation and reproducibility.

What You'll Do

Working directly with the CTO, you'll own security across Rise's cloud, edge, and on-chain surfaces, and the infrastructure operations that keep production healthy. You are the first dedicated security role at Rise, but you are not starting from zero: you inherit a working program - SOC 2 certification, Google SecOps, Terraform-managed GCP, Cloudflare at the edge, and established on-chain treasury controls - and your job is to own it, harden it, and take it further. Security is the center of gravity for the role, with infrastructure and reliability close behind, on a mostly serverless stack designed to keep operational overhead low.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will not manage people, but you are the security leader for the company: you set security direction, make the calls on risk, represent Rise to auditors, partners, and customers, and are the person engineering and leadership turn to when a security or infrastructure question needs an answer. It is a builder's seat, not an advisory one - you'll harden what exists, design what's missing, and ship it yourself.

Security operations (SecOps)

  • Own and run Rise's security operations: detection engineering, alert triage, investigation, and response across GCP, Cloudflare, GitHub, and Google Workspace.

  • Build and tune detections in Google SecOps (Chronicle) over Cloud Audit Logs, load-balancer and Cloud Run request logs, Cloudflare firewall logs, and application telemetry - covering anomalous traffic, abuse, credential misuse, insider risk, and scanning - and keep log ingestion and feed health reliable.

  • Establish and track behavioral baselines so new or escalated activity stands out from normal operations.

  • Own incident response: detection, containment, forensics, remediation, and blameless post-mortems - and build the tooling and runbooks so we respond faster next time.

  • Run tabletop exercises and game days so our response is proven, not assumed.

  • Build AI-driven security automation: agent-based log review, alert triage and enrichment, and scheduled investigation passes over GCP, Cloudflare, and GitHub activity, so a team of one can cover what used to take a SOC shift.

Security posture & architecture

  • Own Rise's security posture across cloud, edge, data, and on-chain surfaces.

  • Design and enforce a zero trust access model: identity-aware access to production and internal tools, device and context-based policy, no implicit trust based on network location.

  • Own secrets management and access governance: least-privilege IAM, separation of duties, network segmentation, and audit logging as enforced defaults across production systems.

  • Harden the GCP footprint (SecOps, Security Command Center, Cloud Run, IAM, VPC, BigQuery, Secret Manager) and Cloudflare edge configuration (WAF, DNS, rate limiting, bot management).

  • Protect sensitive customer, payroll, and identity data - classification, encryption, retention, and access controls.

Blockchain & treasury security

  • Own the security of Rise's Ethereum and EVM treasury layer: treasury and ramp wallets, multisig (Safe) owners and thresholds, admin roles on our access-control contracts, and signer and key custody. Smart contract development, auditing, and on-chain monitoring are owned by the blockchain team; you partner with them on controls and custody.

  • Secure the relayer and off-chain services that submit transactions, including key management and transaction signing controls.

Governance, risk & compliance

  • Own Rise's compliance program: maintain our SOC 2 certification and lead the path to ISO 27001 and PCI DSS - control ownership, evidence collection, gap assessment, and audit coordination - and represent security to auditors, partners, and customers.

  • Own security policy, vendor and third-party risk review, and access review cycles.

  • Run security awareness and secure-development enablement for the engineering team.

  • Own data privacy risk - data residency, subject-access and deletion requests, and GDPR / CCPA obligations across the platform.

Infrastructure operations & platform reliability

  • Own the infrastructure operations behind code releases: run and improve the deployment pipelines that ship our fleet of Cloud Run services to production, and be accountable for safe, repeatable releases (rollouts, rollbacks, and release hygiene).

  • Provide day-to-day operational support for our production infrastructure - keeping services healthy and available, responding to operational issues, and doing the maintenance, upgrades, and toil-reduction that keep the platform running.

  • Build and maintain CI/CD and Terraform-managed infrastructure on GCP, with security controls built into the pipeline rather than bolted on.

  • Improve observability - logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting - so we find problems before customers do.

  • Be accountable for reliability - capacity, backups, and on-call - for systems that move money, on a mostly serverless architecture designed to keep operational load and toil low.

  • Operate and continuously improve our disaster recovery capability. Own our RTO/RPO targets, manage database backup and point-in-time recovery for our managed MySQL databases, maintain and refine failover procedures and DR runbooks, and run regular restore drills and game days so recovery stays proven, not assumed.

  • Keep the infrastructure upgraded over time.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • Work authorization. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis and reside in the U.S. The company will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

  • Background check. Must pass a comprehensive 7-to-10 year background check, including criminal, credit, and employment verification.

  • Experience. 10+ years in security engineering and infrastructure, including at least 3 years owning a security program or function end to end, with the judgment to set direction as Rise's first dedicated security leader.

  • Google Cloud Platform. Substantial, hands-on GCP experience - IAM, VPC and networking, Cloud Audit Logs and monitoring, Security Command Center, Secret Manager, Cloud Run, BigQuery, and Google SecOps (Chronicle). This is a GCP role; you should already operate GCP in production.

  • Security operations and incident response. You've built and run detection, triage, and response as a day-to-day discipline in a SIEM (Google SecOps / Chronicle preferred), you can turn logs into signal and signal into alerts people act on, and you've been in the room when something was on fire and helped put it out.

  • Terraform. You manage cloud infrastructure as code in Terraform and are comfortable owning the modules, state, and pipelines that apply it.

  • Zero trust. You have designed and implemented zero trust access (identity-aware proxies, Cloudflare Access / BeyondCorp-style controls, device posture, context-aware policy) for production and internal systems.

  • Security fundamentals. IAM and least privilege, secrets/key management, network security, cryptography basics, and data protection.

  • Code literacy. Comfort reading and reasoning about code in a Node.js / TypeScript and MySQL environment (you don't need to be a full-time developer).

  • CI/CD. Hands-on experience owning deployment pipelines and embedding security controls into how we build and ship.

  • Production operations. Willingness to carry production operations and on-call for a small set of VMs and a mostly serverless GCP footprint alongside the security work.

  • AI-first workflow. You already use AI tools (Claude Code, Copilot, or similar) every day to write and review code, investigate incidents, draft documentation, and automate repetitive work - and you can show how it has multiplied your output. This is how work gets done at Rise; it is not optional.

  • Compliance. You have carried at least one of SOC 2, ISO 27001, or PCI DSS through certification and recurring audits as the control owner, and know what evidence collection actually costs. Experience taking a company from SOC 2 to ISO 27001 or PCI DSS is a strong plus.

Preferred

  • Google Cloud certifications. Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer, plus any of Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Cloud Network Engineer, or Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer.

  • Ethereum / EVM security. Wallets, keys, and signers; multisig (Safe) administration; and the threat landscape around stablecoin settlement.

  • Regulated industry. Experience in fintech, payments, or another regulated, funds-handling environment.

Nice to have

  • Security clearance. Active or previous U.S. Government security clearance.

  • Military service. U.S. military experience, particularly in cybersecurity, signals, or intelligence roles.

  • Additional certifications. CISSP, GCIH, GCFA, GCDA, CCSP, or similar.

  • Cloudflare depth. WAF rules, Workers, Zero Trust, and Logpush beyond the basics.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base salary: $230,000-$275,000, commensurate with experience.

  • Meaningful equity in a growing company.

  • Generous healthcare benefits - medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family.

  • Unlimited PTO and a flexible work schedule - we care about outcomes, not hours.

  • 401(k) with a 3% company grant - not a match. Rise contributes 3% of your salary to your 401(k) every pay period whether or not you contribute a dollar yourself. Add your own contributions on top and you keep both.

  • Fully remote within the United States.

Why Rise

You'll be the person who owns security operations and reliability for a platform that moves real money across borders and on-chain. It's a role with genuine scope, genuine autonomy, and genuine stakes - GCP security, SecOps, blockchain treasury security, compliance, and production ownership, all in one seat, with a direct line to the CTO.

You'll be the first dedicated security leader at Rise, inheriting a real program and the full authority to shape where it goes next.

raw.description:
Job Title: Director, Major Gifts

Organizational Unit: Development

Reports To: Chief Development Officer

Supervises: Mid-level Giving & Prospecting Officer

Location: Equality Now is a remote organization. This position may be based in Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Virginia, or Washington, D.C., with a strong preference for candidates based in New York.

MISSION OBJECTIVE:

The Director, Major Gifts plays a pivotal role in advancing Equality Now’s global mission by leading and growing a major gifts portfolio, including gala sponsorships, mid-level giving and donor engagement. In partnership with the Chief Development Officer and Chief Executive Officer, the Director translates Equality Now’s development strategy into actionable fundraising plans, strengthens donor pipelines and systems, and cultivates meaningful relationships with individuals, family foundations, and philanthropic networks.This role spans strategy, donor cultivation and stewardship, portfolio management, events, executive engagement, and team leadership, and collaborates closely with Annual Giving & Development Operations functions. It requires an experienced fundraising leader with sound judgment, strong relationship-management skills, cross-cultural fluency, and the ability to translate Equality Now’s complex legal and programmatic work into compelling opportunities for philanthropic investment.

The Director will have the opportunity to shape and strengthen Equality Now’s Individual and Major Giving program during an important period of organizational growth. The successful candidate must be comfortable building systems, navigating complexity, inspiring donors and colleagues, and building the capacity of supervisee(s) and other junior staff focused on securing sustainable revenue to advance legal and systemic change for women and girls worldwide.

MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

The following provides a general outline of the role. It is not exhaustive, and responsibilities may evolve at the discretion of the CDO based on organizational needs and priorities.

Purpose: Innovate for Mission Expansion

  • Serve as the senior lead for operationalizing the Individual & Major Giving strategy, translating our 2026-2030 development strategy into actionable plans, systems, and donor pathways across the full Individual Giving portfolio.
  • Drive the execution and refinement of Equality Now’s high-touch major donor growth strategy, including implementing a network-mapping approach, strengthening Advisory Board and Ambassador engagement, building individualized strategies for UHNW, and designing innovative donor/prospect engagement initiatives (eg-salons, donor cohorts, donor journeys, in-kind/volunteer opportunities for mission impact)
  • Partner with the CEO and CDO to support high-value donor/prospect cultivation and shape donor-facing opportunities aligned with organizational priorities, advising on donor motivations, portfolio insights, and potential engagement opportunities.
  • Provide strategic leadership to align all tiers of individual giving—major gifts, gala sponsorships, mid-level, and annual giving—ensuring cohesive messaging, clear donor journeys, and seamless handoffs between donor segments.
  • Lead maintenance and continuous improvement of pipeline development and tracking practices, including
    donor qualification, engagement strategies, moves management, and standardized systems that enhance efficiency, clarity, and visibility across the portfolio.
  • Lead/guide the development of donor-facing cases for support, investment opportunities, and strategic offerings, ensuring they reflect Equality Now’s mission, program vision, and funder-aligned messaging.

Engagement: Advocate

  • Manage a portfolio of high-value donors and prospects, cultivating deep, trust-based relationships with individuals and family foundations capable of $10,000–$250,000+ giving, while identifying opportunities and supporting leadership-level engagement.
  • Support CEO and CDO engagement with top-tier donors and prospects, preparing strategic briefings, donor intelligence, outreach recommendations, follow-up plans, and bespoke cultivation opportunities.
  • Oversee and elevate the mid-level donor program, ensuring a compelling donor journey that supports upgrades and helps to surface and convert major donor prospects.
  • Engage and activate Advisory Board members and other supporters and ambassadors, partnering with them to leverage networks, cultivate prospective donors, support events, and build community around Equality Now.
  • Serve as an external ambassador for Equality Now, representing the mission with fluency in global women’s rights and human rights–cultivating relationships and expanding networks in philanthropic and peer spaces.
  • Ensure donor experiences reflect mission-driven, community-centered engagement, including opportunities to meet international staff, join learning conversations, attend cultivation events, and participate in curated donor experiences.
  • Strengthen departmental and cross-departmental collaboration, to ensure donor messaging is programmatically accurate, compelling, and aligned with organizational impact narratives, and that the development program gains efficiencies and effectiveness through collaboration across corporate, institutional and individual giving.

Delivery: Define Project Cycle

  • Lead the operational management of the entire Major & Mid-levelGiving portfolio, overseeing processes, timelines, deliverables, and performance standards across major gifts, gala sponsorships, mid-level giving, and annual giving.
  • Implement and oversee strong systems for donor/prospect planning and tracking, including moves management, portfolio assignment, forecasting, and performance analytics, ensuring leadership always has clear visibility into pipeline health.
  • Partner with the Manager, Annual Fund & Development Operations, to ensure excellence in development operations, data integrity, analytics, and annual fund growth strategies.
  • Contribute to the planning and execution of high-impact donor events with Comms & Development colleagues, including the gala, cultivation salons, and community-building convenings, ensuring events advance the 2026-2030 development strategy and build momentum for donor/prospect engagement and pipeline development.
  • Develop individualized donor strategies and annual engagement plans, ensuring they are tailored to the donors’ interests, mission-centered, and coordinated with leadership involvement and organizational priorities and opportunities.
  • Produce high-quality donor communications and materials, partnering with Programs and Communications to prepare proposals, impact updates, donor briefings and reports, strategic correspondence, and leadership-level messaging.
  • Ensure accurate reporting, analytics, and revenue projections, synthesizing donor engagement metrics, portfolio movement, and pipeline health to support leadership decision-making and organizational planning.
  • Drive continuous learning and adaptive planning, integrating donor insights, event performance, campaign outcomes, and Strategic Plan benchmarks into ongoing improvements to Major Giving and Mid-level gift operations.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

This position supervises staff and is responsible for providing leadership, guidance, development, and performance management. Responsibilities may evolve based on organizational needs.

Leadership and Team Management

  • Provide clear direction, priorities, and performance expectations to direct reports.
  • Hold regular check-ins, monitor performance, provide timely feedback, and support professional growth.
  • Foster an inclusive, accountable, transparent, and high-performing team culture.
  • Address operational and personnel issues promptly, fairly, and in coordination with People & Culture when appropriate.

Performance and Development

  • Conduct performance reviews and identify individual and team development needs.
  • Coach and mentor staff to strengthen fundraising, leadership, and interpersonal skills.
  • Promote cross-functional learning and knowledge sharing.

Operations and Workflow

  • Manage workflows, priorities, workloads, leave, and coverage to maintain operational continuity.
  • Monitor progress, quality, and outcomes against agreed objectives.
  • Hold regular team meetings to communicate priorities, share updates, and address challenges.

Compliance and Collaboration

  • Ensure adherence to organizational policies, ethical standards, safeguarding requirements, and applicable laws.
  • Facilitate effective communication and collaboration across departments and leadership.
  • Model Equality Now’s values of integrity and accountability, inclusiveness, resilience, and empathy.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS & TARGET SKILLS PROFILE:
The Director will be thoroughly committed to Equality Now’s mission. The position requires deep subject-matter expertise, visionary leadership, and functional integration capacity. Specific requirements include:

Substantive Knowledge

  • Deep expertise in major gift fundraising, high-touch donor engagement strategies, and best practice moves management, ideally in a global nonprofit setting, with demonstrated success in securing 5–7 figure gifts from individuals and family foundations
  • Strong understanding or direct experience in event fundraising, high-touch donor engagement and strengthening development operations and workflows.
  • Familiarity with global human rights, women’s rights and gender equality funding landscapes (highly desirable). Understanding of legal, advocacy and movement building approaches is a plus.
  • Proven ability to manage, mentor and develop staff.


Communication Skills

  • Fluent in English; proficiency in Spanish, French, or Arabic is a plus.
  • Adept at fostering cross-cultural collaboration and cultivating trust-based relationships consistent with the mission and values of Equality Now.
  • Exceptional donor relationship management and communication skills, with a demonstrated aptitude for translating complex legal, financial, and programmatic concepts into compelling, polished, audience-specific decks, proposals and cases for support.
  • Strong listening, verbal and interpersonal skills to engage professionally and effectively with HNW donors, senior leadership, partners, and staff across geographies and cultures.
  • Adept at facilitating cross-functional collaboration, ensuring clarity, transparency, and strategic alignment between Development, Programs, and Finance, while fostering trust, accountability, and mutual respect across diverse and dispersed teams.


Execution Skills

  • Demonstrated leadership experience, with a focus on strategic delivery and operational excellence.
  • Proven ability to recruit, mentor, and manage staff, fellows, and consultants, fostering high-performing, accountable teams, while modeling inclusive leadership, ensuring all voices are heard, valued, and meaningfully integrated into decision-making processes.
  • Strategic and creative thinker with a record of translating vision into measurable outcomes.
  • Strong project management skills with a track record of meeting deadlines and producing high-quality deliverables in fast-paced environments.
  • Highly organized, results-oriented, and adaptable, with experience in database management (Raiser’s Edge NXT or equivalent).
  • Willingness and ability to travel internationally and domestically, sometimes on short notice, to support regional teams, engage with partners, and represent Equality Now.

Targeted Specialized Knowledge

  • Bachelor's degree required, Master’s degree, Continuing Education or significant professional experience in relevant fields is highly desired (e.g., International Relations, Nonprofit Management, Public Policy, Law, Human Rights, CFRE certification, etc)
  • 10+ years of progressively responsible fundraising experience, including substantial, independent donor-facing work and staff/program management responsibilities.

• Who are Evotix?

We're a growing global EHS SaaS company with a clear ambition: to combine world-class software, data and AI to help our customers operate smarter, safer and more efficiently. For exceptional talent, Evotix offers something rare-the pace of a growth company, the scale to make a real difference, and the opportunity to influence strategy, technology and outcomes at a global level.

At Evotix, we're creating the future of workplace health, safety and wellbeing—and we need ELITE people to help us do it. People who pursue Excellence, show Leadership, deliver Impact, earn Trust, and Empower those around them.

The Role

The expected salary for this role is $80,000-90,000 depending on location and experience.

The Project Manager is a key delivery lead within the Evotix Professional Services team, responsible for managing the successful implementation of client projects across the full delivery lifecycle. Balancing scope, time, budget and quality, the Project Manager ensures that projects meet defined objectives while delivering an exceptional client experience.

At Evotix, Project Managers operate with a high degree of autonomy, often leading multiple workstreams or overseeing mid-to-large-scale projects. They coordinate internal resources, manage external stakeholders and uphold project governance standards. This is a role for project professionals who combine structured delivery skills with a collaborative mindset and a passion for client success.

What You'll Do

Operational Responsibilities

  • Plan, manage and deliver implementation projects on time, within scope and within budget.
  • Lead all phases of the project lifecycle, including initiation, planning, execution, monitoring and closure.
  • Establish and maintain robust project governance, including RAID logs, status reports and steering updates.
  • Coordinate internal and client-facing resources to deliver against project timelines and requirements.
  • Proactively manage risks and issues, escalating where necessary to ensure delivery continuity.
  • Ensure adherence to PMO delivery methodologies, processes and toolsets.

Outcome: Projects are delivered against agreed objectives with clear governance, controlled risk and stakeholder visibility.

Client & Stakeholder Responsibilities

  • Build strong relationships with client stakeholders, acting as the main delivery contact throughout the project.
  • Facilitate workshops, status updates and key decision meetings with client and internal teams.
  • Manage expectations and drive alignment between client goals and delivery capabilities.
  • Partner with Consultants and Technical Leads to support solution feasibility and implementation plans.

Outcome: Clients and internal teams remain aligned, informed and confident throughout delivery.

What You Bring

Essential

  • Proven experience in project management roles, ideally in SaaS or software implementation environments.
  • Proven ability to manage cross-functional projects and multiple stakeholders across regions.
  • Strong understanding of project management methodologies, including Agile, Waterfall and hybrid approaches, and tools such as JIRA or Smartsheet.
  • Experience working with commercial statements of work, budgets and client timelines.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including stakeholder engagement and facilitation.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects concurrently.
  • Proven ability to anticipate and manage project-level risks and issues.
  • Professional credibility and ownership in high-visibility client and internal settings.

Desirable

  • PMP, PRINCE2 or an equivalent project management certification.
  • Experience in a PE-backed SaaS company.
  • Experience in a fast-paced, scaling organisation.

Please note that Evotix is unable to offer visa sponsorship. You must have the legal right to work in the country where the role is based at the time of application.

Interview Process

We aim to keep our interview process transparent, fair, and respectful of your time. While steps may vary slightly by role, you can typically expect:

  • Initial chat: A conversation with a member of our Talent team to learn more about your background, motivations, and answer any initial questions.
  • Hiring Manager interview: A role-focused discussion exploring your experience, skills, and how you approach real-world scenarios relevant to the role.
  • Key Stakeholder interview: A discussion with a senior leader of our Professional Services Team.
  • Final Panel interview: A conversation with key stakeholders to dive deeper into collaboration, alignment, and mutual fit. This stage may involve a Case Study or Presentation to allow you to show off your skills!
  • Offer: If successful, we’ll move quickly to share an offer and next steps.

We’re happy to make reasonable adjustments at any stage of the process — just let us know what you need.

Why join Evotix?

  • Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a competitive base salary and company-based performance bonus.
  • Time to Recharge: Unlimited Annual Leave because we trust you to balance your work and wellbeing.
  • Financial Future: Generous tiered 401k plan that increases over time.
  • Support for You: Access to our Employee Assistance Program, including mental health, legal, and financial guidance.
  • Growth Opportunities: Educational benefits to help you keep learning and growing.
  • Team Culture: Regular team events, an inclusive environment, and a shared commitment to making an impact.

Ready to Make a Difference?
If you’re a bold, results-driven leader who thrives on challenges, loves scaling success, and is passionate about making a difference—we want to hear from you!

Thank you for your interest. Please note, we are not seeking support from external recruitment agencies at this time. Direct applications from candidates are warmly welcomed.

raw.description:
Velotic is seeking a strategic and operationally focused IT Director, Business & Enterprise Applications to lead the vision, delivery, and governance of our enterprise application portfolio. This leader will oversee platforms that power our core business operations — with Oracle NetSuite as our ERP backbone spanning financials, procurement, revenue recognition, and fixed asset management, Salesforce as our CRM and customer engagement platform, Workday for HRIS, and a growing ecosystem of best-in-class SaaS tools across billing, compensation, tax, FP&A, and professional services.

A key priority in the first year will be supporting Velotic's exit from inherited Transition Service Agreements (TSAs), standing up independent application capabilities, and leading tool selection and implementation for categories where decisions are still being finalized.

Responsibilities

The IT Director, Business & Enterprise Applications, is expected to be a collaborative and delivery-oriented leader with deep command of enterprise platforms and a commitment to enabling Velotic's operational independence and growth.

  • Own the strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle management of Velotic's enterprise application portfolio, anchored by Oracle NetSuite (ERP) and Salesforce (CRM) and spanning the full business application ecosystem
  • Lead tool selection, implementation, and stabilization for application categories still under evaluation, including FP&A, tax, CLM/e-signature, compensation and commission, and professional services platforms
  • Lead the evaluation, implementation, and stabilization of applications required to exit TSA dependencies from prior parent companies or acquired entities
  • Manage and optimize Boomi as Velotic's integration layer, ensuring clean, scalable data flows across the application portfolio
  • Partner closely with Finance, Sales, HR, and Operations stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technology solutions
  • Lead and develop a high-performing team of application managers, business systems analysts, and integration engineers
  • Drive application governance frameworks including change management, vendor management, and system integration standards
  • Oversee system implementations, upgrades, and migrations, ensuring delivery on time, within scope, and within budget
  • Establish and monitor KPIs for application performance, uptime, and user adoption
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend investments that improve operational efficiency and business agility
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred
  • 8+ years of progressive IT experience, with at least 3 years in a leadership role overseeing enterprise applications
  • Hands-on expertise with Oracle NetSuite ERP is required across multiple functional areas (financials, billing, procurement, revenue recognition)
  • Experience with Salesforce (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, or Revenue Cloud) strongly preferred
  • Familiarity with HRIS platforms (Workday preferred), compensation and commission tools, FP&A platforms, and CLM or e-signature solutions
  • Demonstrated experience navigating TSA exits, carve-outs, spin-offs, or post-acquisition application integrations
  • Proven track record leading complex, cross-functional system implementations and integrations, including integration middleware platforms (experience with Boomi a plus)
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience with manufacturing logistics, managing vendor relationships, tool evaluations, and SaaS contract negotiations preferred

Why Join Velotic

Velotic is uniquely positioned at the intersection of industrial operations, advanced connectivity, and AI. Joining now means you can help shape:

Culture & Growth

  • Build foundational People Ops systems, processes, and culture from day one.
  • Work within a team defined by ambition, collaboration, authenticity, and speed.
  • Influence global operating models and employee experience at scale.

Work-Life Balance

  • Salary range for the base is $155,000 to $180,000
  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Discretionary Time Off (DTO)
  • Global paid parental leave
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP

Join Us

Learn more at:

WHO WE ARE

Velotic is a newly-formed independent software company with a pure-play focus on industrial operations. We unite two category-defining portfolios -- ThingWorx and Kepware (formerly part of PTC) and Proficy (formerly part of GE Vernova) -- to transform industrial manufacturing, at scale. With $350M in annual revenue, a global footprint across a range of industries, a legacy customer base, and our intelligent data connectivity systems and AI solutions, we are one of the world's largest independent software companies focused on industrial operations -- here to power the future of manufacturing.

OUR MISSION

Enabling the world's industrial producers to do the right things right—across every shift, every plant, every day. We help manufacturers prosper by equipping them with software-defined, data-driven production systems that elevate quality, accelerate cycle times, improve resilience, and enable sustainable profit growth.

WHY THIS IS A ONCE-IN-A-CAREER OPPORTUNITY

  • Lead in a market undergoing significant disruption and growth from cloud migration to edge intelligence to AI-powered industrial automation.
  • Join a culture defined by ambition, authenticity, speed, teamwork, and the belief that manufacturing can meaningfully improve the world.
  • Competitive benefits, compensation and long-term impact on how the world’s industrial companies operate, automate, and innovate.

Kurs iki seviyeden oluşur: Seviye 1 (8–9 yaş) ve Seviye 2 (10–12 yaş). Hangi seviyede ders vereceğiniz, işe alım sonrasında profilinize ve grup planlamasına göre belirlenir.

  • Temel 3D modelleme, üç boyutlu uzayda hareket, materyal ve doku kullanımı konularında öğrencileri yönlendirmek

  • Grafik tasarım projelerinde (logo, sticker, kartvizit, marka kitabı, sunum) öğrencilere destek olmak

  • Hikâye anlatımı, storyboard, çizgi roman ve kısa çizgi film üretim süreçlerinde öğrencilere rehberlik etmek

  • Teknik konuları öğrencilerin yaşına ve seviyesine uygun şekilde sade, anlaşılır ve ilgi çekici biçimde anlatmak

  • Grup derslerinde öğrencilerin aktif katılımını, yaratıcılığını ve özgün proje üretimini desteklemek

Size sunduklarımız:

raw.description:
¡Hola! Somos Cashea 👋 y nuestra misión es devolverle a los venezolanos la oportunidad de acceder al crédito a través de un modelo de negocio BNPL (buy now, pay later).

Desde nuestro lanzamiento en 2022, nos hemos dedicado a promover la inclusión financiera. Hoy contamos con más de 9 millones de usuarios activos, tanto consumidores como comercios, y nos hemos convertido en una marca de confianza en Venezuela, ganándonos el corazón y la mente de las personas.

Resumen del rol

Buscamos un Sr. Backend Engineer para diseñar y operar las integraciones entre nuestros servicios y sistemas ERP. Es un rol de backend: escribes código, tomas decisiones de arquitectura y respondes por cómo se comportan tus servicios en producción.
El rol es agnóstico al producto ERP. Vas a trabajar con distintos sistemas y a aislarlos detrás de contratos propios, de modo que cambiar de ERP no rompa el resto de la plataforma. Trabajas de cerca con Producto, Finanzas y Operaciones, y tu criterio técnico pesa en cómo crece la plataforma.

Responsabilidades

  • Diseñar y construir servicios backend e integraciones con sistemas ERP, con adaptadores que encapsulan las particularidades de cada producto.

  • Definir contratos y modelos de datos propios, independientes de cualquier ERP.

  • Construir para corrección financiera: idempotencia, conciliación, reintentos y estados de falla bien definidos.

  • Integrar según lo que ofrezca cada sistema: API REST, SOAP, XML-RPC o JSON-RPC, webhooks y carga de archivos.

  • Modelar y mantener datos relacionales, principalmente en PostgreSQL, cuidando rendimiento e integridad.

  • Traducir con Producto, Finanzas y Operaciones los procesos contables y operativos en soluciones técnicas.

  • Tomar decisiones de arquitectura y hacerte cargo de los trade-offs.

  • Operar tus servicios en producción: despliegues, monitoreo y respuesta a fallas.

  • Hacer code reviews, escribir tests y documentación técnica, y fijar estándares dentro del equipo.

  • Dar mentoría técnica a desarrolladores Juniors y Mid - Level

Requisitos

  • 5+ años de experiencia en desarrollo backend, con base sólida en node.js.

  • Experiencia integrando sistemas ERP o haber trabajado con ellos (por ejemplo Odoo, SAP, NetSuite o Microsoft Dynamics), o con software empresarial equivalente de finanzas, contabilidad, CRM o RR. HH.

  • Experiencia diseñando y operando APIs REST en producción, y consumiendo APIs de terceros con sus límites, errores y cambios de versión.

  • Conocimiento de PostgreSQL y modelado de datos.

  • Conocimiento de patrones de integración: idempotencia, reintentos, colas y conciliación.

  • Experiencia escribiendo tests unitarios y de integración.

  • Práctica con Git y flujos de trabajo colaborativos.

  • Capacidad para explicar temas técnicos complejos a perfiles técnicos y no técnicos.

Habilidades

  • Ownership sobre la calidad y los resultados de tus soluciones.

  • Liderazgo técnico y disposición a hacer mentoría.

  • Pensamiento analítico para problemas de negocio y de arquitectura.

  • Iniciativa para proponer mejoras sin que te las pidan.

Nice to have

  • Experiencia con Odoo: módulos contables, ORM y despliegues en u on-premise.

  • Conocimientos en python.

  • Conocimiento de localizaciones contables o fiscales.

  • Experiencia en fintech, pagos o crédito.

  • Experiencia con Google Cloud Platform.

  • Conocimiento de Docker y Kubernetes.

  • Experiencia con mensajería y colas: RabbitMQ, Kafka o Pub/Sub.

  • Experiencia en equipos distribuidos o remotos.

  • Español e inglés.

Por qué te encantará trabajar en Cashea

En Cashea tenemos una cultura de trabajo basada en la confianza y el propósito. Si quieres saber por qué somos el lugar ideal para ti, estos son nuestros valores fundamentales:

  • No trabajamos en piloto automático.Todo lo que hacemos y compartimos —dentro y fuera— es intencional. Nos apasiona crear ideas siendo plenamente conscientes del impacto que tienen en nuestros usuarios.

  • Tu creatividad y curiosidad son tus activos más importantes.

  • Tu voz importa.Escuchamos y abrimos espacio para las ideas y el feedback. Aquí todos pertenecen; lo que es importante para ti, lo es para nosotros.

  • Valoramos la transparencia.La claridad nos mantiene conectados y con los pies en la tierra.

  • Por último, pero no menos importante, nos enfocamos en el impacto real. Todo lo que hacemos está destinado a marcar la diferencia.

¿Te identificas?¡Postúlate ahora, nos encantaría conocerte!

You didn't get into this to manage one piece of a project. You got into it to change how the world gets built.

Position: Contra & Local Partnerships Specialist Position Type: Full time, Permanent (Existing Vacancy) Location: Toronto, ON (Remote)

The Company:

Postmedia is a Canadian news media company representing more than 110 brands across multiple print, online and mobile platforms. Award-winning journalists and innovative product development teams bring engaging content to millions of people every week whenever and wherever they want it. This exceptional content, reach and scope offers advertisers and marketers compelling solutions to effectively reach target audiences. We are always on the lookout for talented individuals to join our team.

The Opportunity:

We are looking for a Contra & Local Partnerships Specialist who will play a key role in bringing our contra and Local Community Transaction partnerships to life through strong execution, partner coordination, and operational follow-through. Working closely with the Manager, Promotion and Sponsorship, this role supports the successful activation of partnership agreements once they have been negotiated and approved. This position manages the day-to-day execution of contra and LCT commitments, including account setup, ad booking, creative collection, ticket management, on-site asset coordination, and tracking advertising delivery against contractual obligations. In addition, this role helps identify and pursue local partnership opportunities in smaller communities through contra and LCT arrangements that enhance our brand presence within the SMB community.

Our ideal candidate:

  • Builds strong working relationships with internal teams, external partners, and local community organizations.
  • Manages multiple partnership agreements, deadlines, deliverables, and partner expectations at the same time.
  • Coordinates the execution of advertising, sponsorship, promotional, and community partnership commitments.
  • Communicates clearly and professionally with partners to collect creative assets, confirm requirements, and drive timely execution.
  • Maintains accurate records, bookings, ticket allocations, and fulfillment details across internal systems.
  • Balances operational detail with proactive partner support and local market development.
  • Works cross-functionally with Promotion and Sponsorship, Sales, Ad Operations, Marketing, Finance, and external partners.
  • Identifies local contra and LCT opportunities that support brand visibility and community engagement in smaller markets.
  • Has experience with our current suite of tools, including: HubSpot, Naviga, Excel, and related advertising operations platforms

What you’ll do:

  • Manage the execution of contra and Local Community Transaction partnerships once agreements have been negotiated and approved.
  • Work closely with the Manager, Promotion and Sponsorship to review partnership agreements, Contra Approval Forms, deliverables, timelines, and contractual obligations.
  • Set up contra and LCT accounts in HubSpot.
  • Book contra advertising and related commitments in HubSpot and Naviga, ensuring information is accurate and aligned with the contract.
  • Coordinate with the Sales Rep and partners to collect creative assets required for contra and LCT advertising campaigns.
  • Follow up with partners on outstanding creative, campaign materials, event details, ticket requirements, and activation needs.
  • Manage tickets associated with partnership agreements, including sporting events, corporate events, charity events, tables, seats, and hospitality assets.
  • Coordinate on-site assets connected to partnership agreements, including signage, event materials, partner recognition, and other activation requirements.
  • Track advertising delivery against contract commitments and ensure all contra and LCT obligations are fulfilled accurately and on time.
  • Prepare regular updates and reporting on campaign delivery, outstanding creative, ticket usage, fulfilled commitments, and remaining contractual obligations.
  • Flag risks, delays, or fulfillment gaps to the Manager, Promotion and Sponsorship and support resolution where needed.
  • Maintain organized records of partner deliverables, booked inventory, creative materials, ticket allocations, and fulfillment status.
  • Support smooth handoff and coordination between Promotion and Sponsorship, Sales, Ad Operations, Finance, and other internal teams.
  • Pursue local partnerships in small communities through contra and LCT opportunities to strengthen local brand presence within the SMB market.
  • Build relationships with local businesses, community groups, events, charitable organizations, and other partners that align with local market objectives.

Who you are:

  • 2 to 4 years’ experience in partnerships, sponsorship, marketing, promotions, media, sales support, advertising operations, or a related field.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple projects, deadlines, and stakeholders.
  • Strong communicator with the ability to follow up professionally and persistently with partners and internal teams.
  • Comfortable working with contracts, deliverables, advertising schedules, creative deadlines, and fulfillment requirements.
  • Able to translate partnership agreements into clear execution plans and track progress through to completion.
  • Experienced in coordinating advertising campaigns, sponsorship activations, partner deliverables, event assets, or community partnerships.
  • Confident using CRM, advertising booking, or order management systems. Experience with HubSpot and Naviga is considered an asset.
  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.

Compensation:

Employment offers presented to the selected candidate are based on a combination of qualifications, experience, responsibilities of the role and the candidate's location. Base Salary: $45,000-$55,000

We thank in advance all applicants for their interest, however only those candidates under consideration will be contacted. Only candidates legally eligible to work in Canada will be considered. No phone calls or agencies please.

Postmedia Network Inc. is committed to providing accommodations for people with disabilities in all areas of the hiring process. If you require accommodation during the hiring process, please make your needs known in advance. Accommodation requests will be provided on an individual basis.

Postmedia Network Inc. is committed to employment equity and an inclusive barrier-free selection process and work environment. Postmedia Network Inc. encourages applications from women, indigenous peoples, persons with disabilities and members of visible minorities.

aufgaben

  • Du identifizierst Weiterentwicklungs- und Optimierungspotentiale auf nationaler und internationaler Ebene und evaluierst die Wirtschaftlichkeit und den Erfolg von Projekten anhand deiner eigens definierten KPIs

profil

benefits

  • This is who we are: Unsere dynamische Kultur kombiniert flache Hierarchien, Start-up-Mentalität, ein internationales Team aus über 65 Nationen und der Power der Schwarz Gruppe, um dir ein agiles und sicheres Arbeitsumfeld zu bieten

Agilent inspires and supports discoveries that advance the quality of life. We are looking for a Global Commercialization Manager to support our product introduction for the Agilent CrossLab Group (ACG).

The Commercialization Manager will drive consistent commercialization success across our new and existing portfolio within ACG. In this critical role, you will lead and execute the successful launch of our cutting-edge products, ensuring they meet market demands and drive business growth. Your expertise in project management, market analysis, and cross-functional collaboration will be pivotal in delivering innovative solutions to scientists and researchers worldwide.


In this role you will partner directly with key stakeholders across multiple functions including Product Management, Commercial Marketing, Sales Channels, Business Operations, Training & Enablement and Product Support.

Key Responsibilities include:

  • Develop and implement comprehensive commercialization plans for new life science products, ensuring alignment with Agilent's goals and market needs

raw.description:
We are looking for a US based Full Stack Developer
to help design, build, and scale our SaaS platform. You will work across the stack, from responsive front end interfaces to backend services, APIs, and data layers, collaborating closely with product, design, and other engineers to ship reliable, high-performance features used by our customers. This is a great role for someone who enjoys owning features end to end, reasoning about system design tradeoffs, and growing their skills across the entire technology stack.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain features across the full stack, from responsive UI components to backend services, APIs, and database schemas
  • Own features end to end, from technical design and estimation through implementation, testing, deployment, and monitoring
  • Design and implement RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs with attention to scalability, versioning, and query performance
  • Write efficient database queries and design normalized schemas; contribute to indexing and query optimization for relational and/or NoSQL data stores
  • Build and maintain integrations with third party systems and APIs, including authentication flows (OAuth2/SSO) and webhook-based event handling
  • Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests; maintain strong automated test coverage and participate in thorough code reviews
  • Contribute to system architecture decisions, including service boundaries, caching strategy, and data flow, as the platform scales
  • Improve application performance through profiling, load testing, and query/caching optimization
  • Instrument and monitor services using logging, metrics, and tracing tools; troubleshoot and resolve production incidents
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipeline improvements, infrastructure as code, and deployment automation
  • Apply secure coding practices (input validation, encryption in transit/at rest, dependency and vulnerability management)
  • Participate in agile ceremonies including sprint planning, standups, and retros

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of professional full stack development experience
  • Strong proficiency in a modern front end framework (Angular) and TypeScript/JavaScript, including component architecture and state management
  • Strong backend experience in Spring Framework building production services
  • Hands-on experience designing, building, and consuming RESTful APIs; familiarity with API versioning and documentation
  • Solid understanding of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) including schema design and query optimization, and/or NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB)
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure, including core compute, storage, and networking services
  • Proficiency with Git, code review workflows, and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, CircleCI)
  • Experience writing automated tests (unit, integration, e2e) using frameworks such as Jest, Mocha, Cypress, or Playwright
  • Strong understanding of web application security best practices (OWASP Top 10, authentication/authorization, encryption)
  • Solid grasp of data structures, algorithms, and system design fundamentals
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work cross functionally

Nice to Have

  • Experience with GraphQL schema design and resolvers
  • Familiarity with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes), and infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation)
  • Experience with microservices, event-driven architectures, and message queues/streaming (Kafka, SQS, RabbitMQ)
  • Experience with observability tooling (Datadog, Grafana, ELK, OpenTelemetry)
  • Familiarity with e-signature or document workflow tools and their APIs
  • Contributions to open-source projects

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and equity
  • Comprehensive benefits
  • Flexible PTO and remote friendly culture
  • Learning and development budget
  • Collaborative, high growth environment

About the Job

AOA is hiring a Senior Frontend Engineer to help build polished, high-performing web experiences for ambitious eCommerce and SaaS clients. You will turn thoughtful designs and product direction into production-ready interfaces, bringing the care, judgment, and craft that make digital products reliable and easy to love.

This is a senior role for someone who enjoys ownership, but not isolation. We keep specifications lean because we trust strong engineers to think deeply, ask good questions, and shape the technical path forward. You will break product-level goals into clear engineering work, make sound implementation decisions, and bring the details a great frontend needs.

You will work across a portfolio of client projects, partnering with designers, product leads, backend engineers, and client-facing teammates to move work forward with clarity and care. As an AI-native agency, we use modern AI coding tools and agents to increase speed, quality, and focus, while keeping strong human judgment at the center of the final product.

You may be a strong fit if you are a senior frontend engineer who takes pride in excellent user interfaces, enjoys turning ambiguity into thoughtful implementation, communicates clearly, and wants to do high-quality work with a close-knit team that cares deeply about client outcomes.

Role Details

  • Compensation: $5,000 USD per month
  • Engagement: Contract (independent contractor)
  • Location: Remote, based in Latin America
  • Schedule: Available during standard business hours in US Central Time, for strong overlap with the team
  • Reports to: Engineering Manager

About AOA

AOA is a growing digital design and development agency that creates high-impact websites, AI-native apps, and standout eCommerce experiences for ambitious modern brands.

We partner closely with eCommerce and SaaS companies to deliver thoughtful, polished work that drives meaningful results and lasting client success. Our work spans strategy, design, development, eCommerce, conversion optimization, and custom application development.

We are a close-knit team where every person has a direct, visible impact on our clients' success and the growth of the company. We value genuine relationships, high standards, ownership, clear communication, and a true commitment to client delight.

As an AI-native agency, we use modern tools to enhance the quality, speed, and clarity of our work, while keeping human judgment, creativity, and relationships at the center.

Responsibilities

  • Key Outcome: Deliver high-quality, high-performing frontend experiences that AOA is known for, with predictability, agentic-efficiency, and collaborative ownership.
  • Build production-grade frontend experiences for enterprise accounts in React and Next.js.
  • Write clear technical documentation, schemas, and architectural flows teammates can use.
  • Turn product-level objectives into clear, actionable engineering tasks and own the technical approach.
  • Translate Figma designs into reusable component libraries and design-system primitives that help the team ship faster.
  • Bring frontend craft from the start and build for performance by default.
  • Connect interfaces to backend and third-party APIs, handling loading, errors, empty states, and partial data.
  • Plan and sequence your work across multiple client projects, bringing recommendations rather than open-ended problems.
  • Proactively identify risks and gaps, and create spike tickets to de-risk them ahead of the work.
  • Write tested, maintainable TypeScript that follows each client codebase’s conventions.
  • Self-review your work and catch issues before QA.
  • Conduct code reviews and hold the bar on quality across the work you review.
  • Use AI coding tools and agents thoughtfully while keeping engineering judgment in control.
  • Self-manage and take ownership of your commitments and deliver what you planned for the cycle.
  • Communicate proactively across a remote team, sharing progress and surfacing risks early.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years building production frontend applications, with deep, current React expertise.
  • Strong experience on enterprise-grade accounts, products, or projects.
  • Prior experience working in an agency environment and as an independent contractor, with the ability to manage multiple clients or projects in parallel.
  • Excellent professional English, spoken and written.
  • A track record of owning frontend features end-to-end, from ambiguous requirements to production.
  • Strong frontend fundamentals: semantic HTML, modern CSS, responsive design, and browser behavior.
  • Experience translating Figma designs into accurate, responsive, accessible interfaces.
  • Experience integrating REST or GraphQL APIs and managing client and server state.
  • A strong quality discipline: typed, tested code and self-review before QA.
  • Ability to estimate your work, commit within a delivery cycle, and reliably deliver.
  • Strong written communication and proactive, independent work in a fully remote team.
  • Reliable overlap with standard US Central Time business hours.
  • Fluent, practical use of AI coding tools as part of your engineering workflow.
  • Based in Latin America and able to work as an independent contractor.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with headless or eCommerce frontends, such as Shopify Hydrogen or headless commerce, in addition to SaaS.
  • Experience building or maintaining a design system or component library used across multiple products.
  • Familiarity with frontend testing and CI tooling, such as Playwright, Vitest or Jest, and Testing Library.
  • Experience working in a points-based or sprint-based delivery model.
  • A portfolio, GitHub, or code samples you can share.

You do not need to check every single box to apply. We know strong engineers bring the right experience in different ways. If you build excellent frontends in React, take real ownership of your work, and want to do it at AI-native speed, we would love to hear from you.

We are seeking an experienced Private Equity Audit Partner to lead and expand our alternative investment audit practice. This individual will bring deep expertise in private equity fund audits and serve as a strategic leader responsible for client service, business development, and team growth. The ideal candidate is a recognized technical expert in private equity fund structures and investment company accounting, with a proven track record of leading complex audits, advising fund managers, and cultivating long-term relationships with General Partners (GPs), CFOs, administrators, and other industry stakeholders. This role will play a critical part in expanding the firm’s presence in the alternative asset space by helping build a scalable private equity practice while collaborating across audit, tax, and advisory service lines.

Key Responsibilities

Private Equity Audit Leadership
  • Lead complex private equity fund audits including multi-tier structures, SPVs, co-investment vehicles, and management companies.
  • Provide technical leadership in investment company accounting, fair value measurements, and fund economics.
  • Oversee audit engagements from planning through completion, ensuring high-quality deliverables and regulatory compliance.
  • Advise clients on valuation methodologies, fund structures, and accounting implications of investment transactions.
Technical Expertise & Quality Oversight
  • Maintain deep knowledge of GAAP, investment company accounting, and alternative asset fund reporting.
  • Provide guidance on:
    • Fair value measurements (ASC 820)
    • Capital account mechanics including waterfall allocations and carried interest
    • Management fee and expense structures

Practice Growth & Business Development

  • Transition and manage an existing book of business while cultivating new client relationships.

Client Relationship Management
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to General Partners, CFOs, and fund leadership teams.
  • Provide proactive insight into accounting developments, fund operations, and industry trends.
  • Strengthen the firm’s position as a trusted partner across the entire fund lifecycle.
Team Leadership & Development
  • Experience recruiting, developing, and mentoring a dedicated private equity fund audit team.
  • Foster a collaborative, entrepreneurial culture focused on excellence and innovation.
  • Support career development pathways for audit professionals interested in alternative investments.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • 10–20+ years of experience in public accounting with a focus on private equity or alternative investment funds.
  • CPA License required.
  • Significant experience leading complex private equity fund audits.
  • Demonstrated experience managing senior client relationships and engagement teams.
  • Deep technical expertise in private equity fund audits and alternative investment structures.
  • Strong understanding of fair value frameworks, valuation methodologies, and investment accounting.
  • Proven leadership capabilities with the ability to build and scale a practice area.
  • Excellent client relationship management and advisory skills.
  • Strong business development and networking abilities.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-growing, entrepreneurial firm environment.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex accounting concepts into clear business insights.
  • Collaborative mindset with the ability to partner across service lines.
  • Experience building or expanding a private equity or alternative investments practice.
  • Experience transitioning or managing a portable book of business.
  • Prior leadership experience at the Partner or Managing Director level.

This role offers a competitive base salary along with a comprehensive benefits package. Salary ranges for U.S.-based positions are determined by geographic location and fall into one of three pay zones, which reflect the cost of labor in that area. The anticipated salary ranges for this position are outlined below and are subject to change:
Compensation & Partnership Structure:
  • Base compensation: $300,000–$500,000+ annually
  • Revenue-based incentive compensation tied to individual and firm performance
  • Candidates who bring an established book of business will be considered for Equity Partner designation
When determining compensation, we consider a variety of factors such as a candidate’s professional experience, skills, and qualifications. Please note that final offer amounts may vary from the ranges listed above and may be adjusted over time.

If you're looking for an environment that offers you growth, success, and professionalism without compromising your family, passions, and life outside of work, apply today!

By combining real-world healthcare data with AI-powered insights, AcuityMD enables companies from pre-commercial to enterprise to understand where and how to sell faster to accelerate the adoption of medical technology. AcuityMD ranked No. 316 on the 2026 Inc. 5000 list of the fastest-growing private companies in America and was named toForbes’ 2025 “Next Billion-Dollar Startups” list – an elite group of 25 venture-backed U.S. companies identified as most likely to reach a $1 billion valuation.‍ AcuityMD is backed by Stepstone Group, Benchmark, Redpoint Ventures, ICONIQ, and Atreides Management.

We are a team of agentic builders who rely heavily on AI development practices to accelerate our ability to deliver value to our customers. We believe in extreme ownership and agency, where every engineer takes responsibility for working throughout the organization to land impact with customers. We're a close-knit team that enables high levels of autonomy by constantly communicating our intentions, sharing problems and learnings, and helping each other learn and grow.

We are currently looking for Software Engineers to join our growing Application Teams. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work on all aspects of the current product and future product development. You will work with other passionate engineers on complex projects that help bring cutting-edge technologies to patients. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work on all aspects of the current product and future product development. You will work with other passionate engineers on complex projects that help bring cutting-edge technologies to patients.

Team Mission

On the Application Team, we're not just engineering software – we're revolutionizing how medical technologies reach those who need them most.

Join AcuityMD's Application Engineering Team, driving the core of our product by empowering VPs, marketers, sales ops, and sales reps. We deliver top-tier solutions for MedTech sales teams to define their markets and identify high-potential opportunities to take their business to the next level. Help us shape the future of MedTech sales strategy and performance with data-driven insights and powerful tools.

You'll partner with PMs, Designers, and fellow engineers to build end-to-end features across web and mobile. While we focus on delivering great work, we are just as committed to building a fun, collaborative, and supportive team environment – because strong connections help us work even better together!

Level up your career while contributing to impactful projects across multiple tech stacks, including JS, React, TS, GraphQL, Node.js, Python, and SQL.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate and Lead: Team up with everyone, from customers, engineers, product managers, designers and more, shaping solutions to interesting real-world challenges.
  • Build What Matters: Develop key features and workflows for our products that will change the lives of patients waiting for the latest medical tech.
  • Data-Driven: Use data insights to identify product enhancements, smooth out performance issues, and discover new opportunities.
  • Influence Our Culture: Have a say in how we work. Help us streamline our processes and make our team even stronger.
  • Explore and Innovate: Use your experience to find new tools and technologies that make our scale better and faster.
  • Mentor and Inspire: Share your knowledge with up-and-coming engineers, helping them grow
  • AI: You instinctively build using agentic tools (Claude Code, Codex, etc) and are invested in pushing the boundaries of what is possible with agentic development.

Your Profile

  • 5+ years as Software engineer working on product domain
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. We believe great talent comes from many paths. We consider a combination of education, training and relevant professional experience when evaluating candidates.
  • Obsessed about customer needs working in a fast pace environment where driving impact is essential.
  • Full stack proficiency working with technologies like TS, React, NodeJs, GQL, Postgres or other relational DBs, BigQuery and other google cloud services, or equivalent technologies.
  • Curious mind and enjoy learning about and working with latest technologies and agentic tools.
  • Team player that leads with empathy and leads by example
  • Nice to have: experience building agentic experiences (tool use/function calling, multi-step reasoning, orchestration frameworks like LangGraph or similar).

You must have an eligible work permit in the USA to be considered for this position.

AcuityMD is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, market data and may vary from the range provided.

Salary Range: 155k-215k for Senior Software Engineer 1, 175k-250k for Senior Software Engineer 2

We Offer:

  • Ground floor opportunity: Join a high-growth startup, backed by world-class investors across Enterprise SaaS and Medical Devices (Benchmark, Redpoint Ventures, and Ajax Health).
  • Learning Budget: Reimbursements for relevant learning and up-skilling opportunities.
  • Remote work: AcuityMD is committed to supporting full-remote flexibility for employees in the US. We provide a work-from-home stipend for all employees.
  • Flexible PTO: Generous time off and flexible hours give you the freedom to do your best work.
  • Paid Health, Dental, and Vision Plans: We offer 100% paid health, dental, and vision plans for all employees and 75% paid for our employees' dependents.
  • Home Office Stipend: $1,000 to invest in remote office equipment and WiFi reimbursement.
  • Optional Team Retreats: We meet in-person multiple times per year for co-working and social gatherings.
  • Parental Leave: 8-16 weeks of fully-paid, flexible parental leave.
  • Competitive compensation with equity upside.

Who We Are:

The Company: We are builders, who are inspired by our mission to expand patient access to cutting-edge medical technologies. We value working collaboratively to solve hard problems for our customers with simple, innovative solutions. We push ourselves to learn with empathy. We foster an active culture of mentorship and inclusion, and we welcome new team members that share our values.

We're backed by Benchmark, Redpoint Ventures, Ajax Health, ICONIQ Growth and several other leading software and medical device investors. Since Acuity launched in 2020, we've brought on customers ranging from publicly traded Fortune 500 companies to innovative growth-stage companies and regional medical device distributors.

The Product:

AcuityMD uses data and software to help teams collaborate around the complex relationships they have with the users of medical technologies: doctors. Our platform empowers medical technology companies to see how their products are used, understand why outcomes vary, and identify opportunities where physicians or sites of care can better serve their patients.

How We Work:

AcuityMD is a remote-first company. We believe the best talent isn't confined to one zip code, so our team works from wherever they do their best work, across the U.S.

We also believe some of our best work happens face-to-face. Critical projects move faster, our products get better, and our community gets stronger when we're in the same room, so we bring the team together throughout the year for company-wide and team on-sites built around that work.

In practice: expect 4-5 in-person opportunities a year through company/team on-sites and in-person collaboration for critical projects. If you're based near our Boston hub, there's no set requirement for how often you come into the office, that's your call, based on what works best for you and your team.

AcuityMD is an Equal Opportunity Employer

AcuityMD is seeking to create a diverse work environment because all teams are stronger with different perspectives and life experiences. We strongly encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. All employees and contractors of AcuityMD are responsible for maintaining a work culture free from discrimination and harassment by treating others with kindness and respect.

Company Overview

Job Summary

We are seeking a VP, Utility Value Engineer to make the business case for Gigawatt as compelling as the technology itself. Working alongside Strategic Account Executives, you will help utility leaders understand where Gigawatt can create value, shape solutions around their operating reality, and quantify the financial and operational outcomes that justify investment.

This is a customer-facing role for someone who can move fluently between utility operations, enterprise technology, and financial analysis. You will lead discovery and value workshops; translate priorities into customer-specific solution narratives; build ROI, TCO, CapEx, and OpEx models; and equip executive sponsors with a credible case for change. You will support opportunities from early qualification through close and, on priority accounts, help establish how promised value will be measured after deployment. The role reports to GTM leadership and works closely across Gigawatt teams.

Key Responsibilities

Make the business case the product: Translate utility priorities into a quantified case for change tied to operating outcomes, customer impact, cost reduction, risk, rate cases, and capital plans – not simply a feature comparison.

Lead utility-specific discovery: Partner with Account Executives to uncover the customer’s operating model, strategic priorities, pain points, baseline performance, decision criteria, and sources of economic value across the buying committee.

Shape customer-specific solutions: Develop a strong command of the Gigawatt suite and work with technical and product teams to connect platform capabilities to each utility’s operating environment, integration landscape, and transformation roadmap.

Build rigorous value models: Develop transparent ROI, TCO, payback, CapEx, and OpEx analyses using customer data, defensible assumptions, industry benchmarks, and sensitivity scenarios. Clearly distinguish validated inputs from hypotheses.

Create executive narratives: Turn complex operational and technical findings into concise investment cases, executive presentations, and decision materials that withstand scrutiny from finance, procurement, technology, regulatory, and business leaders.

Navigate utility economics and regulation: Connect investment rationale to utility budgeting, rate cases, capital planning, cost recovery, regulatory commitments, reliability, affordability, customer outcomes, and other jurisdiction-specific considerations.

Design and facilitate value workshops: Lead structured working sessions with customer executives, operators, and subject-matter experts to align on problems, target outcomes, assumptions, solution scope, and measures of success.

Support the pursuit through close: Work as the AE’s value and utility-domain partner across demonstrations, proposals, RFIs and RFPs, business-case reviews, executive meetings, and commercial negotiations. Anticipate objections and give champions the evidence needed to build internal support.

Scale Gigawatt’s value practice: Build reusable benchmarks, value hypotheses, discovery tools, calculators, case studies, and module-specific value frameworks. Bring market insight back to Product and GTM teams to strengthen positioning and roadmap decisions.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in utility strategy, operations, transformation, solution consulting, value engineering, business-value consulting, or enterprise technology advisory.
  • Deep electric, gas, or water utility expertise, including how utilities plan investments, operate core functions, make technology decisions, and demonstrate value to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate operational challenges and technology/software capabilities into quantified financial and business outcomes.
  • Experience shaping complex solutions and partnering effectively across sales, product, engineering, services, and customer-success teams.
  • Technical curiosity and ability to develop fluency in an AI-native, data-intensive platform, its integrations, and its role within utility enterprise architecture.
  • Builder’s mindset with the ability to create methods, tools, and repeatable practices while remaining hands-on in an early-stage environment.
  • Strong executive presence and excellent written, presentation, and storytelling skills, including presenting investment cases to C-suite audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience in enterprise software, solution consulting, value engineering, or technology advisory supporting utility customers.
  • Experience developing ROI, TCO, CapEx/OpEx, business-case, or investment models.
  • Familiarity with utility regulatory processes, rate cases, capital planning, cost recovery, and/or grid modernization initiatives.
  • Experience supporting complex enterprise sales pursuits, including executive workshops, RFPs/RFIs, proposals, or commercial negotiations.
  • Experience in a high-growth, early-stage technology environment.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience; advanced degree in business, finance, engineering, economics, or a related field is a plus.

Location

  • Remote but Chicago, Austin, Nashville are preferred.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and equity package.
  • Opportunity to shape security for a transformative AI product in a vital industry working with a rock-star team.
  • Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, remote work flexibility, and 401k match.
  • Collaborative culture focused on innovation and impact.
  • If you are passionate about securing the future of AI in utilities, apply today!
