raw.description:
About Slang AI

Slang AI is redefining customer engagement through conversational AI, making every interaction seamless and efficient. Our mission is to transform the restaurant industry by providing the ultimate voice AI solution for consistently outstanding customer experiences.

At Slang AI, we believe how we build matters just as much as what we build. We foster a culture rooted in hospitality, ownership, and clarity, where every “Slangsta” feels valued, supported, and connected to the broader impact of our work in the AI-powered future of restaurants.

What your experience will be

As an Account Executive at Slang, you will play a pivotal role in driving our business forward. Collaborating closely with the Head of Sales and your manager, you will be integral to our rapid growth phase. You will work within the Sales department, engaging with various internal teams, such as Product and Customer Experience, to ensure a cohesive customer journey. Occasional travel may be required for attending conferences or company offsite meetings. Additionally, you will leverage sales technology to enhance productivity and connectivity with prospects and with your teammates.

Why You Belong Here and How You Will Grow

At Slang, you believe that trust is a foundational layer to any relationship starting internally as a Slangsta through your touch points with each prospect. We cultivate a culture where every Slangsta has a deep sense of pride in their achievements with humility. Our team is collaborative, supportive, and driven by shared goals fostering an abundance mindset in addition to belonging and inclusivity. We offer experiences and benefits designed to foster a sense of community both within and outside the organization. Learner Fervor represents our strongest attribute for growth, as we challenge each employee to take every opportunity to learn especially when it's hard. You will grow not only as a professional but also as an individual. We support and foster opportunities for learning and development, aligning with your career aspirations. From weekly team trainings to 1:1 coaching sessions with your manager or peers, company wide workshops, we will help your journey in finding purpose in your work and achieving your fullest potential.

What Success Looks Like

  • Hunting and Closing: Proactively prospecting and closing new business opportunities.
  • Value Based Discovery and Demos: Actively listening to expertly uncover business impact, quantify value, and position Slang as uniquely qualified to deliver those outcomes.
  • Growing Key Markets: Expanding both existing and new market segments strategically.
  • Pipeline Management: Managing your sales pipeline to ensure quality multi-threading with key stakeholders, driving urgency of purchase, and navigating the buying process to ensure a predictable and steady flow of closed deals.
  • Leverage AI to innovate and drive process efficiency and achieve business objectives.
  • Collaborative Support: Working closely with the Implementation and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth customer onboarding and expansion of existing accounts you have worked with.
  • Exceeding Targets: Consistently achieving and surpassing monthly sales quotas and weekly top-of-funnel metrics.

What You Will Bring

  • Experience: 3+ years of sales experience with a proven track record of exceeding targets.
  • Traits and Behaviors: Described by others as a self starter, hunter, closer, curious, resourceful, and resilient. You possess a growth mindset and hustle to achieve your very best.
  • Business Acumen: The ability to speak directly to a prospect’s business problems, understand the industry, and act as a consultant.
  • Grit: You give your very best in everything you do and take ownership of the outcomes. Adversity and challenges don’t deter you from your commitment to driving results.
  • Adaptability: Thrives in a fast-paced and ever-evolving startup environment and excels under pressure.
  • Coach-ability: Open to feedback, self-motivated, and innovative in your approach.
  • Communication Skills: Strong in both written and verbal communication, a good listener, assertive, persistent, and persuasive, with a high EQ.
  • Must have experience in SaaS or hospitality (hotels or restaurants) is REQUIRED

How Work effects my Life

At Slang AI, your role as an Account Executive will not only shape your professional trajectory but also enhance your personal well-being. We offer competitive compensation, including various rewards and benefits, to reflect your value to the company. By joining Slang AI, you’ll find your work meaningful and aligned with your personal goals, shaping a positive worldview and reinforcing your sense of worth by helping businesses more efficiently serve their customers and alleviate pain for their staff while developing your business and hospitality ai acumen and skills.

Compensation & Location

Compensation for this role is location-based and benchmarked against local market data aligned to the employee’s primary work location. Total compensation includes a mix of cash and equity and may vary by location, role level, and experience. Our range is therefore wide and not meant as a negotiation range.

Work Type: Remote, local to Chicago

Base Compensation: $85,000 – $110,000

Variable Compensation: 50/50 split ($85,000-$110,000)

On-Target Earnings (OTE): $170,000 – $220,000

Equity: Included in offer package

Our Vision

Calling a business shouldn’t feel like a robot-hostage situation, where you’re forced to listen to horrible music and can't reach a human, while enduring a soulless voice uttering "I'm sorry I didn't quite get that" on repeat for eternity. (shudder) That’s why we started Slang AI We use the latest AI and audio wizardry to make transacting via voice so enjoyable it’s more human than human. By 2030, we will save businesses and consumers 1 billion minutes of precious time while transforming voice channels into the preferred mode of communication (it's faster and easier than text).

We have backgrounds building product at companies like Spotify, Buzzfeed, the New York Times, and OpenTable —shipping experiences that have reached hundreds of millions of users. Now, we’re using our backgrounds to start a new culture, one that puts product and human-centered design above all else while fostering constant learning and growth. Sound like something you’d like to be part of? Get on board.

Our Values

Overachiever Fever. We’re overachievers (we don’t know any other way)

AI Native. We don't just sell AI. We are Al.

Humility Ability. We approach each other with curiosity and openness (know-it-alls not welcome!)

Be A Good Host. We build for hospitality. We should embody it.

raw.excerpt: DescriptionNous recrutons ! DiXiO s'est donné pour mission de simplifier et securiser le domaine de la messagerie financière.
raw.description:
Description

Nous recrutons !

DiXiO s'est donné pour mission de simplifier et securiser le domaine de la messagerie financière. Dans le cadre de la croissance de notre pipeline clients, nous recherchons un(e) développeur(se) full-stack pour concevoir des solutions innovantes au service de la réussite de nos partenaires.

Pourquoi vous allez aimer travailler avec nous :

Si vous recherchez une organisation qui investit réellement dans votre carrière, ne cherchez plus. Nous mettons à la disposition de nos experts les outils et les ressources nécessaires pour concrétiser leurs aspirations professionnelles. De plus, nous opérons en 100 % télétravail, vous offrant la liberté de travailler d'où vous le souhaitez tout en évitant les contraintes des trajets quotidiens. Afin de garantir un équilibre sain entre vie professionnelle et vie privée, notre équipe bénéficie également de jours de congés illimités.

À propos de DiXiO

DiXiO est une société d'experts SWIFT présente dans plus de 50 pays. Ces dernières années, DiXiO s'est imposée comme la référence dans le secteur de la messagerie financière et est officiellement agréée en tant qu'agent SWIFT. Aujourd'hui, DiXiO constitue le premier réseau mondial d'experts de confiance, rendant la messagerie financière simple et sécurisée grâce à des services spécialisés et des solutions cloud innovantes.

Requirements

1. Objectif du rôle

Renforcer la capacité de delivery technique de DIXIO pour absorber la croissance du pipeline clients. Le rôle consiste à produire de la valeur fonctionnelle (features complexes) tout en stabilisant le run quotidien. On cherche un ingénieur "product-minded" capable de challenger les specs, et non un simple exécutant technique.

2. Responsabilités principales

  • Développement de Features Transverses : Concevoir et implémenter des fonctionnalités de bout en bout, du Backend (Node/NestJS) au Frontend (Angular). Focus sur les chantiers lourds : formulaires dynamiques (MT/MX), workflows de validation multi-étapes (4-eyes) et dashboards de monitoring.
  • Maintien Opérationnel (Run) : Participer activement aux rotations de bug fix et au support de production pour garantir la stabilité de la plateforme.
  • Qualité & Robustesse : Garantir un code testé et documenté. Appliquer les principes de "Security by Design" pour répondre aux contraintes fortes de conformité (ISO 27001 / SWIFT).
  • Architecture & APIs : Faire évoluer les API existantes pour supporter de nouveaux flux financiers tout en maintenant la performance et la scalabilité.
  • Collaboration Technique : Travailler étroitement avec les DevOps pour les déploiements et la QA pour l'automatisation des tests sur les nouveaux développements.

3. Compétences attendues

  • Techniques : Maîtrise experte de la stack TypeScript (Node.js / NestJS en back, Angular en front). Bonne compréhension des architectures asynchrones (queues, batchs) et des environnements Cloud (AWS).
  • Approche : Capacité de réflexion avant codage, esprit critique sur les besoins métiers, et rigueur opérationnelle.
  • Contexte : Aisance dans un environnement de flux financiers complexes (messages MT/MX/JSON).

4. Plan de mission (30-60-90 jours)

  • 30 jours : Immersion dans la codebase, montée en compétence sur les flux financiers DIXIO et livraison d'une première feature mineure ou correction de bug complexe.
  • 60 jours : Autonomie sur des chantiers plus larges (ex: refacto de formulaires ou nouveau workflow), participation active aux code reviews.
  • 90 jours : Référent sur une partie du périmètre applicatif, force de proposition sur les évolutions d'architecture et pilier du delivery quotidien.

5. Ce que le rôle n'est PAS

  • Faire uniquement du Front ou uniquement du Back.
  • Exécuter des tickets sans comprendre l'impact métier ou financier.
  • Négliger les tests et la documentation sous prétexte de vitesse.

6. Pourquoi ce rôle est clé chez DiXiO

Avec le retrait progressif des profils historiques des rotations quotidiennes, ce rôle devient le moteur de la capacité de delivery. Dans une Fintech où le produit évolue vers des workflows de validation ultra-critiques, la qualité du développement est l'unique rempart contre l'erreur financière.

raw.excerpt: ProTrials is a women-owned, WBENC-certified Contract Research Organization (CRO) that has been a trusted partner in clinical research since 1996.
raw.description:
ProTrials is a women-owned, WBENC-certified Contract Research Organization (CRO) that has been a trusted partner in clinical research since 1996. Founded with a clear mission to deliver high-quality, experienced, and ethical services, we’ve supported research behind innovative treatments in the pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device industries.
Our people are the heart of everything we do. We believe great work happens when team members feel valued, supported, and empowered. At ProTrials, you’ll join a collaborative community committed to making a meaningful impact on global health.
We are excited to connect with skilled individuals who share our passion for advancing clinical research with care, integrity, and excellence.
ABOUT THE JOB
ProTrials is seeking a Contract Lead Clinical Research Associate to join our team.
The Contract Lead Clinical Research Associate (LCRA) is responsible for providing direction and leadership to the Clinical Research Associate (CRA) team and Clinical Trial Associate (CTA) assigned to studies. The Contract LCRA ensures accurate and timely initiation, enrollment, conduct, completion, and provides project management support. The Contract LCRA ensures adequate study monitoring resources are in place for the study. The Contract LCRA also identifies quality issues related to clinical monitoring activities, and along with the study team, establishes action plans to address them.

HERE IS WHAT YOU WILL DO:

  • Provide study oversight as the primary liaison between CRAs, internal staff, study site staff including investigators, coordinators, client personnel, and external vendors involved in all stages of the study
  • Ensure clinical monitoring activities of the study CRA team(s) are performed in accordance with applicable Standard Operating Procedures (SOP), regulations, good clinical practices, key performance indicators, and study-specific requirements
  • Develop, review, and manage clinical plans and guidelines, including the clinical monitoring plan and study timelines; ensure compliance with monitoring intervals according to project requirements, review data reports, CTMS, disseminate listings/reports to study CRAs, and work with CRAs and site staff to resolve data discrepancies
  • Create annotated visit report templates and other documents and strategies related to site management and monitoring
  • Support training and development of team members, ensure compliance with study specific training requirements, and ensure training is appropriately documented
  • Guide and support CRAs, CTAs, and external contract research organizations regarding monitoring, co-monitoring, training, and audit visits; review site visit reports and monitoring letters in accordance with study and SOP requirements
  • Manage oversight of the Trial Master File (TMF)/eTMF and assist with filing and quality control
  • Track serious adverse events, protocol deviations, enrollment, ICFs, study contacts, investigational supplies, and investigational product for assigned study and review with appropriate members of the study team
  • Perform qualification, initiation, interim, and close out visits and provide visit reports as per monitoring guidelines as needed

HERE IS WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE:

  • RN, Bachelor, or advanced degree in biological sciences or related field, or equivalent combination of relevant experience, education, and training
  • Previous CRA experience preferred
  • Proven excellence in professional skills including communication, organization, prioritization, presentation, discretion, and accuracy
  • Solutions-oriented approach to problem solving
  • Familiarity with medical and pharmaceutical industry, and related terminology and practices
  • Extensive knowledge of Food and Drug Administration regulations and their practical implementation
  • Willingness to travel and perform remote and on-site monitoring, if needed
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
Except as otherwise permitted or required by applicable law or regulatory requirements, ProTrials will retain the applicant’s personal information in accordance with its statutory obligations and internal policies and procedures.
Information collected during application completion may be retained for a reasonable period of time and in accordance with the company’s established retention policies. Applicants seeking more information may contact .
ProTrials is an equal opportunity employer. ProTrials is committed to providing a workplace free from discrimination and harassment. All qualified candidates will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, citizenship status, national origin, ancestry, gender (including gender identity and gender expression), pregnancy, and childbirth or related medical conditions (including genetic characteristics), genetic information, sexual orientation, age, religion, creed, physical or mental disability, medical condition, military or veteran status, marital status, political affiliation, or any other characteristic protected by state or federal law.

To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com

What you’ll be doing

As a Business Banking Analyst, you will join our Business Client Advice Centre (BCAC) reporting to the Team Leader, Business Banking. You’ll support our Business Banking clients and internal partners directly (Imperial Service and Personal Banking) on all after-sales related activities including account maintenance requests, day-to-day service inquiries, and ad hoc administrative activities. You’ll work closely with the client to understand their business requests and needs while taking responsibility for execution and providing relevant recommendations. You’ll work with internal partners in order to facilitate solutions that proactively meet clients’ needs and will be responsible for validating Digital Business Onboarding (DBO) applications for all Business Banking, Personal Banking and Imperial Service segments.

At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. You can effectively perform work activities remotely, and will only be required to be on-site on an occasional basis.

All employees are required to meet the Agent@Home program requirements and be able to attend your primary work location within two hours’ notice for any business-related purposes.

Agent@Home Program Requirements

  • Ability to work independently as an Agent @ Home with a secure workspace, in a room or office with a door that closes it off from noises and distractions.
  • Wired Internet connection, capable of continuously supporting excellent call quality and high-speed response rate (Internet connection can be connected to modem through hard cable (not wireless) with a minimum download speed of 15 mbps and upload speed of 10 mbps).
  • Satellite internet providers are prohibited and cannot be used due to the impact on call quality and the stability of service.

The Business Client Advice Centre (BCAC) is open Monday to Friday from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM EST and Saturday from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST. You must be able to work flexible hours on a rotating basis to accommodate client and branch schedules. Hours could change to accommodate future branch hours and to support branches nationally.

How you’ll succeed

Demonstrate service excellence by being knowledgeable, resourceful and professional during all client interactions and record servicing activities in appropriate tool(s) accurately. Offer solutions, resolve and/or escalate client issues and concerns to leadership and/or appropriate parties without delays. Support any non-sales calling campaigns and administrative activities including call-outs to existing clients in support of initiatives, projects, and AML remediations among others.

  • Partner Support - Support any non-sales calling campaigns and administrative activities including call-outs to existing clients in support of initiatives, projects, and AML remediations among others. Identify and recognize sales opportunities and refer them to the Business Advisor and/or appropriate internal partners.

Who you are

  • You can demonstrate well developed knowledge of business products and services (lending, cash management solutions, GICs and banking centre services).
  • You have 1-2 years’ experience in a professional, fast-paced sales and service environment preferably in a financial and client service industry or Client Contact Centre.

  • You love to learn. You're passionate about growing your knowledge. You have a strong sense of curiosity.
  • Values matter to you. You bring your real self to work and you live our values – trust, teamwork and accountability.
  • You're fluent in French and English to serve our clients in the community.

What CIBC Offers

At CIBC, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions as an employee and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career, rather than just a paycheck.

  • We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including a competitive salary, incentive pay, banking benefits, a benefits program*, defined benefit pension plan*, an employee share purchase plan, a vacation offering, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points-based recognition program.

Who We Are:

CompTIA is a leading voice and advocate for the $5 trillion global information technology ecosystem; and the estimated 75 million industry and tech professionals who design, implement, manage, and safeguard the technology that powers the world’s economy.

Through education, training, certifications, philanthropy and market research, CompTIA promotes industry growth; the development of a highly skilled workforce and a commitment to creating an environment where innovation happens, and the opportunities and benefits made possible through technology are available to all.

Scope Summary:

The Software Test Engineer II plays a vital role in ensuring that high-quality products are delivered on time, within budget and meet CompTIA standards. This work involves designing, developing, and maintaining automated testing frameworks and scripts for software applications and systems using a variety of testing tools and frameworks. The ideal candidate will have the ability to identify and log product issues based on execution of test cases and industry standard testing methodologies. Additionally, STE II will design and create test cases to ensure complete coverage of test plans while also maintaining and updating automated test scripts to ensure they remain accurate, relevant, and effective. While having excellent automation skills, the candidate will have excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills and willingness to participate in manual testing regularly.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for identifying and investigating issues found during testing and updating test cases based on discovered defects.
  • Works closely with software developers and software quality analysts to resolve issues.
  • Develop and maintain automated test scripts to reduce repetitive manual testing.
  • Participate in project-wide reviews of requirements, system architecture, and detailed design documents.
  • Define Test Strategy and End to End Scenarios.
  • Understands key daily reporting elements needed for stakeholders and partners.
  • Participate in continuous improvement efforts within the QA organization & Research and evaluate new testing technologies and tools.
  • Other relevant tasks, duties, or special projects as assigned.

Key Performance Indicators:

  • Keeping to date with industry trends and emerging testing technologies.
  • Communication of critical issues and status updates.
  • The ability to identify and log product issues.
  • The ability to create and maintain automated test scripts.
  • The ability to create, update and execute test cases.
  • The ability to maintain workflow velocities and meet deadlines.

Additional Expectations:

  • Employees are expected to model CompTIA's values and reflect them in how they work and collaborate.
  • Participate in required and role relevant training to maintain skills, ensure compliance, and support ongoing professional development.
  • May be required to travel based on role responsibilities and business needs.
  • Please note that this job description is not intended to provide an exhaustive listing of tasks, activities, or responsibilities required of the employee in this role. Tasks, responsibilities, and duties may change without notice.

Skills and Qualifications:

  • Moderate experience in software development processes and QA methodologies
  • Effective oral and written communication skills
  • Experience in industry standard test management tools
  • Experience testing in an Agile/Scrum methodology
  • Moderate experience developing automation scripts using Playwright, Typescript, and TestNG or equivalent tools and technologies.

Education and/or Experience:

  • Degree preferred but not required for the role.
  • 4+ years’ experience in a related field.

Why Join Us:

We're a team of driven, creative problem-solvers who are passionate about empowering people to realize their full potential. We foster a collaborative and inclusive culture where ideas are welcomed, growth is encouraged, and success is celebrated. We're not just looking for employees; we're looking for partners who share our vision and are eager to contribute to our purpose. If you're ready to unlock your potential and reach new heights, join us today.

Our team works hard and we recognize the importance of taking care of our own. We offer our employees a comprehensive suite of benefit offerings including:

  • Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance & FSA/HSA Plans
  • Performance bonus up to 10% of base salary
  • Unlimited PTO & 15 Paid Holidays
  • Flexible Schedules & Summer Hours
  • 12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave
  • Sponsored Costco or Sam’s Membership
  • 401K Retirement Plan with 6% company match
  • Spot Bonuses for going above & beyond
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Home Office Allowance
  • Wellness Reimbursement
  • Student Loan Repayment
  • Broadband Stipend
  • Expected compensation based on experience and qualifications – $84,000 – $97,000

raw.description:
At Arctic Wolf, you won’t just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve – you'll help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We’re proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Bartner Peer Insights and IDC MarketScape – but what matters most is the work behind it: delivering real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora Platform.


If you’re looking for a meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high-growth company that’s redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you!


Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for a Leave and Accommodations Administrator to be part of making that happen.  


The Leave and Accommodation Administrator is responsible for administering employee leave of absence, disability, and workplace accommodation programs across multiple countries and jurisdictions. This role serves as a key resource for employees, managers, People Business Partners, Payroll, Benefits, and external vendors by providing guidance on leave processes, eligibility requirements, documentation, pay implications, accommodations, and return-to-work planning.

As a member of the Global Benefits team, this position partners closely with third-party administrators, insurance carriers, accommodation vendors, payroll teams, and internal stakeholders to ensure timely, accurate, compliant, and employee-focused administration of leave and accommodation programs. The role also leverages technology, reporting, and AI-enabled tools to improve operational efficiency, enhance employee communications, and support a positive employee experience throughout the leave lifecycle.


Responsibilities:

  • Administer employee leave of absence programs, including medical, parental, family care, disability, military, statutory, and personal leaves across multiple countries.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for employees and managers regarding leave processes, eligibility requirements, documentation, pay impacts, and return-to-work expectations.
  • Coordinate leave cases with third-party leave administrators, disability carriers, payroll, HR partners, and other internal stakeholders.
  • Manage leave intake, case tracking, documentation review, approvals, status updates, and case closure activities.
  • Maintain accurate leave records, employee communications, and case documentation in HR systems and case management tools.
  • Monitor leave timelines and ensure employee, manager, payroll, and vendor actions are completed within required deadlines.
  • Assist with workplace accommodation processes and return-to-work planning in partnership with HR and relevant stakeholders.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies and applicable federal, state, provincial, and country-specific leave disability, accommodation and employment requirements.
  • Escalate complex leave, disability, accommodation, or compliance matters to senior team members as appropriate.
  • Support audits, reporting, and leave-related metrics by maintaining data accuracy and documentation standards.
  • Identify opportunities to improve leave administration processes, employee communications, and operational efficiency.
  • Provide support on leave-related projects, system enhancements, and process improvement initiatives.
  • Partner with Benefits, Payroll, and HR teams to ensure accurate pay, benefit administration and employee deductions throughout the leave lifecycle.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 3+ years of experience administering leave of absence, disability, accommodation, or related HR programs.
  • Experience administering leave and accommodation programs in a multi-jurisdictional environment.
  • Working knowledge of global leave, disability, accommodation, and return-to-work practices.
  • Experience using HR technology platforms and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Demonstrated expertise in administering leave of absence, disability, and workplace accommodation programs while ensuring compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and company policies.
  • Strong ability to manage employee cases from intake through return to work, balancing employee experience, operational requirements, and regulatory obligations.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to effectively partner with employees, managers, HR, Payroll, Benefits, vendors, and other key stakeholders.
  • Proven organizational and case management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, maintain accurate documentation, and meet critical deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, including the ability to assess complex situations, identify risks, and recommend practical solutions.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to data integrity when maintaining leave records, reporting, and case documentation.
  • Experience utilizing HR technology platforms, preferably Workday, case management systems, reporting tools, and Microsoft Office.
  • Ability to identify process improvement opportunities and leverage technology and AI-enabled tools to enhance operational efficiency, employee communications, and service delivery.
  • Demonstrated sound judgment, discretion, and professionalism when handling sensitive and confidential employee information.
  • Global mindset with the ability to navigate varying leave, disability, and accommodation practices across multiple countries and jurisdictions.

Preferred Skills and Experience:

  • Experience supporting global leave programs in the United States, Canada, EMEA, APAC, or LATAM regions.
  • Experience with Workday, ServiceNow, or similar HRIS and case management platforms.
  • Familiarity with disability management, workplace accommodations, and interactive process administration.
  • Experience developing reports, dashboards, and leave-related metrics.
  • Experience leveraging AI tools, including Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or other generative AI solutions to improve operational efficiency, reporting, process documentation, and employee communications.
  • CEBS, SHRM-CP, PHR, CHRP, or other relevant professional certification.

On-Camera Policy
To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.


About Arctic Wolf

At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace USA (2021-2024), Best Places to Work – USA (2021-2024), Great Place to Work – Canada (2021-2024), Great Place to Work – UK (2024), and Kununu Top Company – Germany (2024). Our commitment to bold growth and shaping the future of security operations is matched by our dedication to customer satisfaction, with over 7,000 customers worldwide and more than 2,000 channel partners globally. As we continue to expand globally and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains the most trusted name in the industry.


Our Values 

Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion and truly value the unique qualities and unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. And we appreciate that—by protecting people’s and organizations’ sensitive data and seeking to end cyber risk— we get to work in an industry that is fundamental to the greater good. 


We celebrate unique perspectives by creating a platform for all voices to be heard through our Pack Unity program. We encourage all employees to join or create a new alliance. See more about our Pack Unity here.  


We also believe and practice corporate responsibility, and have recently joined the Pledge 1% Movement, ensuring that we continue to give back to our community. We know that through our mission to End Cyber Risk we will continue to engage and give back to our communities. 


All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including: 

  • Equity for all employees
  • Flexible time off and paid volunteer days
  • RRSP and 401k match
  • Training and career development programs
  • Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical, mental health, dental, disability, life and AD&D, and value-added services
  • Robust Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with mental health services
  • Fertility support and paid parental leave

Arctic Wolf is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics, or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law. Arctic Wolf is committed to fostering a welcoming, accessible, respectful, and inclusive environment ensuring equal access and participation for people with disabilities. As such, we strive to make our entire employee experience as accessible as possible and provide accommodations as required for candidates and employees with disabilities and/or other specific needs where possible. Please let us know if you require any accommodations by emailing . 


Security Requirements 

  • Conducts duties and responsibilities in accordance with AWN’s Information Security policies, standards, processes, and controls to protect the confidentiality, integrity and availability of AWN business information (in accordance with our employee handbook and corporate policies). 
  • Background checks are required for this position.  
  • This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (“EAR”).  Please note that, if applicable, an offer for employment will be conditioned on authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export control laws and regulations.

raw.title: Client Services CFO - Consumer Products
raw.excerpt: Build a $3-5M Portfolio.  Lead 20-40 Companies.  Shape the Future of Finance.
raw.description:
Build a $3-5M Portfolio. Lead 20-40 Companies. Shape the Future of Finance.

This isn't a fractional CFO gig—it's an embedded one. You'll build and own a portfolio of venture-backed companies worth $3-5M in annual revenue, with FP&A leverage, operational infrastructure, and team support that makes managing 20-40 clients not just possible, but profitable.

Embedded means two things. First, you're embedded in your clients: attending leadership meetings, preparing for boards, earning the trust and access that traditional providers never achieve. Second, you're embedded in Propeller: working within our standards, leveraging our technology and data, contributing to a team that has your back and you have theirs. This isn't a job for lone wolves who want to do things their own way. It's a job for builders who want to be part of something bigger.

You'll embed yourself in client leadership teams—not as a vendor, but as the trusted advisor who shapes strategy. And you'll build this like an MD at a professional services firm: maintaining standards, leveraging infrastructure, developing talent, and operating within a system designed to scale.

This is an equity-track role for someone ready to build something that compounds. This is foundational work—and it's the future.

Who We Are

Nearly 17 years ago, we set out to find a better way to help the country's leading startups navigate the financial hazards that follow their first institutional funding.

Today, Propeller's 250+ full-time professionals across three continents serve as the embedded finance and accounting partner to some of the most iconic emerging companies in Consumer, Technology, Blockchain, and Business Services. Behind us: 1,300+ clients. Ahead of us: the transformation of professional services through AI-enabled intelligence.

Our embedded teams integrate seamlessly into client operations in multi-year partnerships. We attend weekly leadership meetings, participate in board prep, collaborate on strategic decisions, and have direct access to client CEOs and CFOs. This embedded positioning creates trust, access, and influence that traditional providers never achieve.

With our Financial Operating Platform—combining human judgment, precise accounting, data infrastructure, and AI-enabled insight through our Propeller Intelligence Engine (PIE)—we transform finance from a back-office function into the central nervous system of growth.

What Makes This Role Different

Most fractional CFOs are solo practitioners—they handle their own business development, do the FP&A work themselves, and are capped by their own bandwidth. They operate in isolation with their own methods, their own mistakes, their own ceiling.

At Propeller, you operate like an MD at a professional services firm: you own client relationships and strategic work while leveraging analysts, controllers, and accounting teams to handle execution. That's how 20-40 clients becomes manageable. That's how a $3-5M portfolio becomes realistic. But it only works if you're willing to work within a system—consistent standards, shared technology, collective intelligence, and mutual accountability.

This role demands excellence in three dimensions:

• Rainmaker: You own the full Consumer Products sales cycle—prospecting, pitching, negotiating, closing. No one hands you clients. You build your book.

• Strategic Partner: You serve as CFO-level advisor to sophisticated Consumer Products operators—providing financial insight, operational guidance, and strategic perspective that drives decisions.

• Team Leader: You build and lead engagement teams that deliver excellence—delegating work, developing talent, and ensuring quality that drives retention and referrals.

Most CFO roles emphasize one dimension. This role requires all three.

Key Responsibilities


This Role Requires

Sales DNA + Financial Credibility

You genuinely enjoy business development. You understand that exceptional work creates referrals, but building a portfolio requires proactive cultivation of relationships. If you view sales as beneath you or need someone to hand you clients, this isn't your role.

Executive Presence + Strategic Impact
You walk into boardrooms and command respect. You translate financial data into strategic insight. You ask questions that reveal blind spots. You deliver difficult messages with clarity and confidence. If you prefer staying behind the spreadsheet or avoid difficult conversations, this isn't your role.

Team Player Mentality + Standards Discipline
You're willing to work within Propeller's standards, technology, and systems—while pushing to improve them. You delegate work to analysts and controllers instead of doing it all yourself. You contribute to collective intelligence instead of hoarding knowledge. If you need complete autonomy or prefer solo practice, this isn't your role.
Leadership + Talent Development
You build teams that execute with excellence. You set clear expectations, delegate effectively, and hold people accountable. You develop talent through coaching and feedback. You celebrate wins and learn from losses. If you avoid personnel decisions or prefer individual contributor work, this isn't your role.

Builder Mentality + Portfolio Discipline
You're energized by building something from the ground up—a portfolio, a team, a reputation. You'll manage multiple client relationships simultaneously, each with different needs and stakeholders. Without systematic thinking and disciplined execution, quality suffers and relationships deteriorate. If you need immediate gratification or prefer maintaining existing operations, this isn't your role.

Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Portfolio Growth

• Own the full Consumer Products sales cycle—from initial outreach through signed engagement
• Build and maintain a robust pipeline through networking, referrals, and strategic outreach
• Develop compelling proposals that articulate Propeller's value to sophisticated buyers
• Collaborate with business development and leadership to pursue strategic opportunities
• Expand within existing accounts and generate referrals from satisfied clients
Strategic Advisory & Client Management

• Serve as primary relationship owner and CFO advisor for your portfolio of Consumer Products clients
• Transform monthly financial reviews from backward-looking reports into strategic conversations that drive decisions
• Participate in client leadership meetings and board prep—earning direct access to CEOs
• Provide financial insight, operational guidance, and business strategy support
• Identify opportunities for service expansion—deeper engagement, new offerings, lifecycle extension
• Build trust and credibility that positions Propeller as indispensable partner, not replaceable vendor

Team Leadership & Service Delivery

• Build and lead engagement teams across U.S. and international personnel
• Delegate FP&A, accounting, and controller work effectively—leveraging team capacity to scale your portfolio
• Set clear expectations, hold teams accountable for quality and timeliness
• Mentor and develop team members through coaching and feedback
• Ensure deliverables meet Propeller's standards and exceed client expectations
• Conduct regular portfolio reviews to identify improvement opportunities and share best practices

Portfolio P&L Management

• Own financial performance of your portfolio—optimizing margins, managing utilization, driving profitability
• Balance client satisfaction with economic efficiency—ensuring sustainable, profitable relationships
• Surface and address issues proactively before they impact results
• Make informed decisions about resource allocation, pricing, and engagement scope

Platform Intelligence & Continuous Improvement
• Leverage Propeller Intelligence Engine (PIE) and Data Lake (PDL) to deliver insights traditional CFOs cannot provide
• Document workflows and surface repeatable intelligence for systematization through PropellerOS
• Contribute to institutional knowledge—codifying what works and sharing insights across the organization
• Continuously improve service delivery quality, efficiency, and client impact

Required Experience

Must Haves

• CPA and/or MBA preferred
• 12+ years in finance/accounting with at least 5 years in CFO or senior financial leadership roles
• Proven business development track record—demonstrable ability to identify, cultivate, and close new client relationships
• Multi-client or consulting background strongly preferred (Big 4, boutique advisory, fractional CFO services, or similar)
• Experience serving Consumer Products companies generating $5M-$100M+ in revenue
• Track record of building and leading high-performing teams
• Strong executive presence—comfortable presenting to boards, CEOs, and sophisticated stakeholders
• Experience developing financial processes and systems in complex, growing organizations

Industry & Technical Expertise

Deep expertise in at least one of the following:
• Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) / E-commerce: Customer acquisition cost (CAC), lifetime value (LTV), channel economics, fulfillment and logistics cost management, Shopify/Amazon ecosystem fluency
• Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG): Trade spend management, retailer margin structures, inventory management, COGS optimization, promotional ROI analysis, retail partner negotiations
• Omnichannel Retail / Brand: Wholesale vs. DTC channel mix, inventory turns, sell-through rates, gross margin management, retail expansion planning, supply chain finance

Critical Mindsets

• Relationship-driven: You understand that great work creates opportunities, but growth requires proactive cultivation
• Systems thinking: Ability to see patterns, codify intelligence, and contribute to scalable processes
• Team player: Willing to work within shared standards while pushing to improve them
• Entrepreneurial: Comfort with ambiguity, willingness to build, and drive to create value
• Technical aptitude: Experience with modern tools and willingness to leverage AI-enabled platforms
• Continuous learner: Curiosity about new industries, business models, and emerging technologies

Job Benefits

Job Title: CFO, Consumer Products Practice
Reports To: Managing Director
Location: Remote-flexible with occasional travel

DEI Statement: At Propeller Industries, we encourage our employees and our clients to bring their true selves to the organization. We believe that a diverse team enables us to cultivate and improve upon our culture of inclusion and collaboration. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome the contributions that you can bring in terms of your education, opinions, culture, ethnicity, race, sex, gender identity and expression, nation of origin, age, languages spoken, veteran’s status, religion, disability, sexual orientation, and beliefs. So however you identify and whatever your background, we encourage you to apply for this role if you share our passion for helping great entrepreneurs build great companies. We look forward to meeting you!

Salary range: $240,000 - $300,000 plus bonus, benefits and 401k match

Current Benefits Offered: Generous Paid Time Off and Holiday pay, Comprehensive health benefits plus dental, vision, short and long-term disability, and life insurance. HSA contribution, Paid Family Leave, 401k match and Remote Work. We also help you grow in your professional life.

Established in 1996 and rebranded to Scout in 2024, we built our foundation on planning meetings for numerous organizations within the life sciences sector (Scout Meetings).  In response to emerging industry needs, we expanded our services to include Scout Clinical, one of the top providers of clinical trial patient reimbursements and travel.  

Scout is recognized as a leader in our field for innovation in service, attention to detail, our stellar team members, and making the complex easier.  If this interests you, we’d love to have you join our rapidly growing team!  

Position Summary:

The Manager of Site Strategy and Engagement is responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with clinical research sites, ensuring successful site engagement, and performance throughout the clinical trial lifecycle. This role involves collaborating with clinical operations teams, ensuring the utilization of the services scoped, and working to enhance site satisfaction and operational efficiency.

Responsibilities of this position include but are not limited to:
  • Site Engagement: Identify, assess, and engage with potential clinical research sites in studies contracted to use Scout services, ensuring they are aware of the service and have everything needed to optimize use of the portal.
  • Site Support: Provide guidance and direction to sites and operations team members to drive strategy for continued use of the portal.
  • Site/Study Utilization Monitoring: Monitor site utilization throughout the trial, ensuring portal use and proactively addressing any issues or concerns that may arise at the site level.
  • Collaboration & Communication: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including Project Managers, Patient Liaison, Site staff, and sponsors, to ensure alignment on site-related needs.
  • Site Relationship Management: Cultivate long-term, productive relationships with clinical sites. Regularly check in with sites to assess their needs, gather feedback, and improve site engagement strategies.
  • Problem Solving & Issue Resolution: Anticipate, identify, and resolve any issues or obstacles at the site level to ensure continued use of the portal.
  • Regional Client Support: Support client conversations with regional specific expertise. Gather local market insights including challenges and recommend how Scout can best support or solve them.
  • Marketing for the region: Support marketing with drafting messaging with an emphasis on local, cultural, economic and regulatory considerations.
  • Complete all required initial and ongoing training within a reasonable or provided timeframe.
The ideal candidate will have the following experience, skills, and knowledge:
  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Nursing, or related field, or equivalent experience
  • Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in clinical research or clinical trial management, with a focus on site management or clinical site engagement.
  • Strong understanding of clinical trial processes, regulations, and industry best practices.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to build rapport with diverse stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple sites and projects simultaneously, with strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Problem-solving mindset with a proactive, solution-oriented approach.

This is a remote position.

Наші продукти:

raw.description:
Reports to: Director of HR
Department: People & Culture
Location: This is a fully remote U.S.-based position. Candidates must reside and work in one of the following states due to tax and compliance requirements: AR, AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, ID, IL, LA, MD, MO, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OH, TX, VA, WA, WI, or WY.
FLSA Classification: Salaried, Exempt
Compensation: This position has geographic-based pay ranges. Final compensation and geographic tier placement are determined based on the candidate's primary work location, skills, experience, and qualifications.
Tier 1 (Higher Cost Markets): $84,000 - $99,000
Tier 2 (National Markets): $77,000 - $90,000
Tier 3 (Lower Cost Markets): $69,000 - $81,000

About the Company

Paleovalley and Wild Pastures were born from a simple but radical idea: real food can heal — people, animals, and the planet. When Paleovalley co-founders Autumn and Chas Smith saw how industrialized food was affecting human health and the health of the land, they refused to play along. Autumn’s own journey of healing through nutrient-dense foods lit a fire that became Paleovalley. From there, the mission grew roots, sprouted wings, and eventually expanded into Wild Pastures to bring regeneratively raised meats directly to families nationwide.

Today, Paleovalley crafts deeply nourishing snacks and supplements made with organic ingredients and honorable sourcing. Wild Pastures connects small American farmers practicing regenerative agriculture with customers who believe better food is worth fighting for. Every product, every partnership, and every decision is guided by a commitment to real ingredients, regenerative practices, and the belief that health is built from the soil up.

We’re a team of grounded doers, curious thinkers, bold builders, and warm humans who like to laugh while doing meaningful work. We're growing quickly, fueled by purpose and a shared desire to repair the food system one thoughtful choice at a time. If you feel energized by impact, drawn to mission, and ready to join a company rewriting the future of food, we’d love to meet you!

About the Opportunity

Paleovalley and Wild Pastures are looking for an experienced Senior Payroll & Compensation Specialist to own payroll operations and play a key role in administering and strengthening our evolving compensation programs. This role serves as our internal payroll subject-matter expert for a growing, multi-state workforce while partnering closely with the Director of HR to support market benchmarking, job leveling, salary structures, compensation cycles, and pay analysis.

This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role for someone with deep payroll expertise and meaningful experience supporting compensation processes. You don’t need to be a career compensation expert, but you should understand how compensation programs work, be comfortable benchmarking roles using market data and compensation tools, and be excited to deepen your expertise as we continue building a thoughtful, scalable compensation framework.

What You’ll Do

Payroll Operations & Compliance

  • Own and independently process regular, off-cycle, special, and final payrolls in Rippling for employees across 20+ states, ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant pay.
  • Audit payroll inputs and results, including employee changes, timekeeping, deductions, garnishments, reimbursements, bonuses, PTO payouts, and other payroll-impacting activity.
  • Manage international contractor setup and payments across multiple countries, including documentation, corrections, and issue resolution.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for payroll questions, independently researching and resolving pay, withholding, deduction, and other payroll issues.
  • Maintain current knowledge of federal, state, and local payroll requirements, including wage payment, final pay, payroll tax, deductions, garnishments, and recordkeeping.
  • Own payroll tax registrations and account maintenance across applicable jurisdictions, including agency notices, corrections, and quarter-end and year-end activities.
  • Serve as the internal Rippling Payroll subject-matter expert, maintaining payroll workflows, controls, documentation, and system configurations while driving process improvements.

Compensation Administration & Analysis

  • Partner with the Director of HR to administer and strengthen the company’s compensation framework, including job levels, salary ranges, geographic pay practices, and related processes.
  • Benchmark roles using Payscale and other market data, evaluating job scope, level, geography, and internal context to support consistent compensation recommendations.
  • Support job leveling and pricing by reviewing responsibilities, organizational scope, market benchmarks, and internal comparisons.
  • Maintain compensation data, salary ranges, market benchmarks, job-leveling records, and supporting documentation.
  • Support annual compensation planning and review cycles, including data preparation, market analysis, manager resources, system administration, reporting, and implementation.
  • Analyze compensation data to identify market positioning, internal equity considerations, pay trends, and potential inconsistencies to support HR decision-making.
  • Administer approved promotions, market adjustments, bonuses, and other compensation changes, ensuring accurate documentation, HRIS updates, and payroll execution.

Reporting, Controls & Partnership

  • Prepare payroll reconciliations, funding information, approval packages, journal entry support, compensation reports, and audit-ready documentation.
  • Identify recurring payroll or compensation errors, trends, and control gaps and implement practical improvements to strengthen accuracy and data integrity.
  • Partner across HR, Finance, Compliance, and business leaders to ensure payroll and compensation processes remain accurate, compliant, and scalable as the organization grows.

Requirements

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • 4+ years of hands-on, end-to-end payroll experience, including 2+ years of independent ownership of payroll for a complex, multi-state U.S. workforce.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • Meaningful experience supporting compensation processes such as market benchmarking, job pricing, salary ranges, compensation analysis, annual compensation cycles, or pay adjustments.
  • Experience using compensation benchmarking tools and market data to evaluate competitive pay; Payscale experience strongly preferred.
  • Working knowledge of compensation concepts including market positioning, job leveling, salary ranges, geographic differentials, internal equity, and benchmarking.
  • Strong knowledge of federal, state, and local payroll requirements, including wage payment, final pay, payroll taxes, deductions, garnishments, recordkeeping, and year-end reporting.
  • Experience supporting hourly and salaried populations, including timekeeping, variable pay, bonuses, and other payroll-related wage and hour considerations.
  • Strong analytical and spreadsheet skills with the ability to reconcile complex data, identify trends, and translate payroll and market data into useful insights.
  • Sound judgment and ability to independently resolve complex payroll issues, thoughtfully analyze compensation questions, and escalate strategic or higher-risk matters appropriately.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, organization, discretion, and communication when handling confidential payroll and compensation information.

Bonus Points

  • Fundamental Payroll Certification (FPC), Certified Payroll Professional (CPP), Certified Compensation Professional (CCP), or progress toward a relevant certification.
  • Hands-on Payscale experience with market pricing, compensation benchmarking, salary range analysis, or related compensation work.
  • Experience processing payroll for employees in California, with familiarity with California-specific payroll requirements and regulations.
  • Experience supporting the development or implementation of a compensation framework, job architecture, leveling structure, or salary range methodology.
  • Experience supporting annual merit or compensation review cycles, including analysis, data validation, manager tools, reporting, and implementation.
  • Experience processing payroll within Rippling, including experience with Global Contractors, Contractor of Record, global payroll, or multi-currency contractor payments.

Benefits

Our Commitment to You

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage with 100% employer-paid dental/vision and a small monthly medical premium for employees; dependents may be added at employee cost
  • Generous Paid time off to support balance and rest
  • Paid sick time for when you need it
  • Six (6) company-paid holidays each year & two (2) floating holidays
  • Paid parental leave after 6 months of service for eligible employees
  • 100% company-paid Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, and Life Insurance
  • Referral bonuses up to $1,500 when you refer great people who join our team
  • 401(k) or Roth Plans with up to a 4% company match after one year of service
  • $300 Paleovalley Monthly product stipend for for employees

Compliance & Employment Practices

Paleovalley and Wild Pastures are proud to be equal opportunity employers. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and we do not discriminate based on any status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We’re also committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process. If you need assistance or an accommodation at any point, please reach out to .

All applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. At this time, Paleovalley and Wild Pastures are unable to sponsor or assume sponsorship of employment visas, including but not limited to H-1B, TN, or OPT. Any offer of employment is contingent upon completion of Form I-9 and verification of work authorization. We participate in E-Verify to confirm eligibility to work in the U.S.

To support an efficient and consistent application review process, we may use technology-assisted tools to help organize and review applications; however, these tools do not make hiring decisions. All final hiring decisions are made by our team.

This role is open until filled.

raw.description:
Customer Success Manager

Scaled Success · India Development Center · Remote, India

ServiceChannel is the leading cloud-based service automation platform for facilities management. We offer a single platform to source, procure, manage, and pay for repair and maintenance services from commercial contractors. Well established yet still driven by the spirit of a startup even after 27 years, we are on a high-growth trajectory and committed to building a great product for our customers and an extraordinary work environment for our employees to succeed professionally and personally.

Position Summary

We are building a team of Customer Success Managers in our India Development Center to support our scaled customer segment through a one-to-many, digital-led success model. As part of a team of Customer Success Managers, you will help steward a shared portfolio of roughly 300 smaller customers (about 70 accounts each) and drive product adoption, retention, and measurable value at scale. The role blends the consultative instincts of a traditional Customer Success Manager with the efficiency of scaled and digital engagement: repeatable success plays, curated digital touchpoints, and data-informed outreach that reach many customers without sacrificing quality. It suits a strategic problem solver and an organized doer who thrives on a high-volume book, works well independently across time zones, and takes pride in helping customers get the most from their technology.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own a portfolio of roughly 70 smaller customers, driving adoption, retention, and value through a mix of one-to-one and one-to-many engagement, including digital campaigns, group webinars, office hours, in-app guidance, and curated success plays.

  • Proactively recommend ServiceChannel standard methodologies, processes, and configurations that align with each customer's business objectives and drive full adoption of ServiceChannel's product offering across the customer lifecycle.

  • Run repeatable, scalable success motions such as onboarding assists, adoption checkpoints, health reviews, and renewal-readiness outreach, tuned to the needs of a high-volume book.

  • Monitor customer health signals and product usage to identify churn risk and expansion opportunities, triaging at-risk accounts and escalating when needed.

  • Lead customer engagements ranging from digital check-ins to business reviews, delivering scorecard results and clear, data-informed recommendations appropriate to each customer's segment.

  • Respond quickly and efficiently to inbound requests, prioritizing and escalating critical issues to protect the customer experience.

  • Review customer data to surface trends and anomalies, make proactive improvement suggestions, and explain the business value of those recommendations.

  • Collect and communicate actionable customer feedback to drive ongoing product improvements.

  • Provide internal communications on customer configuration, usage, system satisfaction, and churn risk.

  • Act as a client advocate while keeping ServiceChannel's values and initiatives in mind.

  • Work cross-functionally with ServiceChannel teams across the US, EMEA and APAC to set and execute customer success strategies.

  • Achieve annual performance objectives tied to customer adoption, retention, engagement, and overall portfolio health.

  • Learn & maintain technical knowledge of ServiceChannel’s offerings.

Working Hours & Location

This is a remote role based in India and operating from our India Development Center. To support our US-based customers, the team works an evening and overnight shift aligned to US Eastern business hours, roughly 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM ET, which corresponds to approximately 6:30 PM to 3:30 AM IST (the exact window shifts by about an hour with US daylight saving time). The schedule is Monday through Friday, with no weekend work. A reliable high-speed internet connection and a quiet, professional work environment are required.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree.

  • Two or more years in customer success, customer support, account management, or a related client-facing role.

  • Excellent written and verbal English, with clear, neutral-accent spoken communication suited to live conversations with US customers.

  • Hands-on experience with a SaaS or CMMS platform, and a functional, systems-minded approach to solving complex customer problems.

  • Ability to learn and maintain working knowledge of SaaS offerings.

  • Strong analytical skills, including the ability to read customer data, apply simple statistical summaries, build meaningful visualizations, spot trends and anomalies, and communicate them clearly to varied audiences.

  • Solid project and time management, with the ability to multitask and prioritize across a large book of accounts.

  • Comfort scheduling, managing, and running presentations remotely with internal and external stakeholders, including senior leaders.

  • Strong attention to detail and disciplined documentation, accurately capturing information and recording it while following processes correctly.

  • Passion for building customer relationships, delivering great service, and resolving conflict with empathy.

  • Self-directed and reliable, comfortable working autonomously and collaborating with colleagues and customers across time zones.

  • Adaptive and responsive to feedback, and open to improving processes where needed.

  • A collaborative team player who supports peers through cross-training, shared best practices, and remote communication.

  • A genuine willingness to ask, learn, advance, and engage with teammates to achieve collective excellence.

  • Must be able to pass a Product Knowledge and Assessment at the completion of onboarding.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Outlook, Word, Power Point, and Excel.

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Experience within a scaled, digital, or tech-touch customer success model serving a high-volume portfolio.

  • Familiarity with CRM and customer success platforms such as Gainsight, Salesforce, Zendesk, or Pendo.

  • Prior experience supporting US or global customers from an offshore or global delivery center.

  • Facilities management or procurement and finance experience.

  • Experience with or familiarity with ServiceChannel.

Tools & Systems

In this role you will regularly work with the following tools and systems:

Tool / System

Purpose

ServiceChannel

Core service automation platform

Gainsight

Customer success and account health management

Salesforce

Sales system of record

Zendesk

Customer support ticketing

Slack

Internal communication

Microsoft Office

Internal and external communication, document prep, and analysis

JIRA

Internal collaboration

How Success Is Measured

Performance is measured against a balanced set of scaled-success metrics. Specific targets are set with Customer Success leadership and evolve as the program matures. Representative measures include:

  • Gross and net revenue retention across the assigned portfolio.

  • Customer (logo) retention within the scaled segment.

  • Product adoption and health-score coverage across the book.

  • Customer satisfaction (CSAT) and Net Promoter Score (NPS).

  • Response and resolution times against agreed service levels for inbound requests.

  • Engagement or coverage rate, meaning the share of the portfolio reached through proactive and digital touchpoints.

  • Timely completion of success plays, health checks, and scheduled business reviews.

Reporting & Team

This position is based in the India Development Center and reports to the local IDC team lead, with a dotted-line relationship to US-based Customer Success leadership. You will collaborate closely with US Customer Success Managers and with Support, Product, and other cross-functional partners as part of a close-knit team supporting the scaled customer segment.

About ServiceChannel & Fortive

ServiceChannel helps many of the world's best-known brands manage their brick-and-mortar facilities. Our customers are market leaders across the retail, restaurant, grocery, convenience store, fitness, banking, education, and health industries. The facilities and store-operations teams at CVS, Trader Joe's, Adidas, Louis Vuitton, and Chipotle, among 500 other brands in more than 70 countries, rely on ServiceChannel to deliver the best possible guest and employee experience. For more information, visit www.fortive.com.

Fortive: For you, for us, for growth.

ServiceChannel empowers many of your favorite brands to take care of their brick and mortar locations. raw.description:
Are you ready to lead the charge in shaping the future of energy solutions?

AECOM is seeking a visionary and dynamic Business Development Director - Thermal Generation to join our team. In this role, you will have the unique opportunity to work across AECOM’s expansive energy practice, building capabilities, driving growth, and delivering innovative solutions to some of the world’s most forward-thinking developers, utilities and high-tech clients.

This position is a REMOTE role based in the United States. .

You will play a pivotal role in delivering complex, fast-paced substation, Natural Gas Power Plant, and BESS projects that meet the critical energy needs of both grid capacity enhancement for utilities, and behind the meter solutions for data center developers, with a heavy focus on natural gas generation solutions. This is your chance to make a lasting impact in a rapidly growing sector while collaborating with industry-leading experts and leveraging AECOM’s global resources.

Roles and Responsibilities of this position include but are not limited to:

Lead and Inspire:

  • Collaborate across AECOM’s energy practice and other business lines to deliver integrated, cutting-edge solutions for thermal generation energy projects.
  • Inspire and monitor multidisciplinary teams to achieve excellence in project delivery and client satisfaction.
  • Serve as a thought leader in the energy sector, representing AECOM in industry forums and shaping the future of power delivery and generation for both utilities and data centers.

Drive Growth and Innovation:

  • Spearhead business development efforts by identifying opportunities, leading pursuits, and crafting winning proposals.
  • Build and nurture strong relationships with utilities, data center developers, high-tech clients, and other key stakeholders.
  • Develop and execute strategies to expand AECOM’s presence in the thermal power generation market, positioning us as the go-to partner for power needs.

Deliver Complex Projects:

  • Provide subject matter expertise for a project portfolio of design, development, and implementation of natural gas power plants and substations that meet the unique demands of a range of clientele, including utilities and data center developers.
  • Assist project teams when necessary in the delivery of fast-paced, high-stakes projects, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.
  • Assist project teams when necessary in addressing technical challenges with creativity and agility, leveraging AECOM’s global expertise to deliver exceptional results.

Collaborate and Build Capabilities:

  • Work across AECOM’s energy practice to strengthen our technical capabilities and drive continuous improvement.
  • Partner with other business lines, including Buildings + Places and Environment, to deliver holistic solutions that address the full spectrum of client needs.
  • Stay ahead of industry trends and emerging technologies, ensuring AECOM remains at the forefront of innovation in energy solutions.

Leadership and Collaboration:

  • Strong leadership skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate diverse teams.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a talent for building relationships across stakeholders.
  • Strategic thinker with a proactive, results-oriented mindset.
  • Manage a team of sales professionals, providing guidance, training, and performance evaluations

Business Acumen:

  • Experience in business development, including leading pursuits and proposals.
  • Ability to identify market opportunities and develop strategies to capitalize on them.
  • Strong understanding of financial metrics and project economics.
  • Develop and manage sales budgets, forecasts, and reports to track performance and identify areas for improvement

Why Join AECOM?

At AECOM, we’re not just delivering power—we’re shaping the future of how the world powers its most critical infrastructure. As the Power and Generation Project Development Manager, you’ll have the opportunity to:

  • Work with some of the most innovative data center developers and high-tech clients in the world.
  • Lead fast-paced, complex projects that push the boundaries of what’s possible.
  • Collaborate across AECOM’s global energy practice to build capabilities, drive growth, and deliver transformative solutions.
  • Be part of a team that values creativity, innovation, and making a real impact.

If you’re ready to take your career to the next level and make a difference in a rapidly evolving industry, we want to hear from you!

Minimum Requirements:

  • BA/BA and 10 years of relevant experience with focus on natural gas power plants or demonstrated equivalency of experience and /or education, including 2 years of leadership.
  • 10 years of experience and success in leading pursuits, managing client relationships, contract negotiations and driving business growth.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of the unique energy requirements for data centers, including reliability, scalability, and sustainability.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with industry standards, codes, and regulations.
  • Relocation assistance is not available for this role
  • Sponsorship for US Employment Authorization is not available for this position
  • THIS POSTING IS FOR A CURRENT VACANCY, AND AECOM INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY DECEMBER 7, 2026

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.
