Category: IT Services

Location: Jacksonville Florida United States


Principal Business Operations Transformation Lead - Remote with TravelPosition Summary

The Principal Lead for Operations Transformation will play a key role in the design and implementation of a future-state operating model for a multi-credit-union shared-services organization. This individual will serve as the Lead and primary bridge between business operations, technology, data, AI/automation teams, and project leadership. Previous Credit Union experience is a MUST HAVE. Understanding of regulatory and legal issues regarding US financial services and data security requirements affecting credit unions. In particular, please describe your ability to comply with: - Gramm-Leach-Bliley data security and privacy requirements; - SSAE 18, SOC 2 Type 2; 10 | Page - ISO 27001; - NCUA Regulation 748 A & B. Knowing specific software made for credit unions like "Keystone" is must have

The Senior Lead will have 12-15+ years experience and have led 2-3 previous projects in business transformation one of which must have been for a credit union. You will lead current-state discovery, process analysis, requirements definition, KPI baselining, future-state process design, and benefits validation, with an initial focus onDeposit Operations. The role will help identify opportunities to improve efficiency, service quality, scalability, control, and member experience through workflow orchestration, automation, artificial intelligence, and improved use of institutional knowledge.

The ideal candidate combines strong business analysis and process transformation capabilities with hands-on experience incredit unions, retail banking, or regulated financial-services operations.

Key Responsibilities

Current-State Assessment & Process Discovery

  • Lead structured discovery sessions with credit union and shared-services subject matter experts to understand current business processes, systems, controls, data flows, handoffs, exception paths, and manual activities.
  • Document end-to-end current-state processes using process maps, workflows, business rules, requirements, and supporting analysis.
  • Analyze processes across participating credit unions to identify common workflows as well as institution-specific policies, configurations, and exceptions.
  • Identify process bottlenecks, duplicate activities, manual workarounds, control gaps, rework, and opportunities for standardization or automation.
  • Facilitate interviews and workshops in a manner that encourages candid input from employees and stakeholders impacted by future process changes.

Deposit Operations Analysis

  • Lead detailed analysis of Deposit Operations processes, including areas such as:
    • ACH and share-draft exception processing
    • Returned deposits
    • ACH research and reclamations
    • Manual payroll processing
    • Card and member-account support processing
    • Remote/mobile deposit review
    • Exception and research workflows
  • Evaluate opportunities to automate, augment, or redesign activities using workflow orchestration, AI, document intelligence, robotic process automation, and related technologies.
  • Develop recommendations for prioritizing automation opportunities based on business value, implementation complexity, risk, volume, and readiness.
  • Ensure future-state workflows appropriately address exceptions, escalations, human review, and audit requirements.

Business Requirements & Future-State Design

  • Translate business needs into clear, testable business, functional, data, workflow, integration, reporting, and control requirements.
  • Develop user stories, acceptance criteria, business rules, process models, and requirements traceability documentation.
  • Partner with solution architects, developers, AI specialists, security teams, and business SMEs to ensure proposed solutions address operational requirements.
  • Support the design of configurable workflows capable of accommodating multiple credit unions, operating models, systems, policies, and approval structures.
  • Help distinguish requirements best addressed through commercial technology from capabilities that should be incorporated into the strategic orchestration layer.
  • Ensure business requirements consider scalability to additional business lines, including Lending and Collections, and to future participating credit unions.

KPI Baselining & Benefits Realization

  • Establish and validate baseline operating metrics for targeted business processes, including:
    • Transaction and work volumes
    • Manual effort and FTE utilization
    • Cycle time and throughput
    • Error and rework rates
    • Exception rates
    • Cost to serve
    • Service-level performance
  • Partner with business and project leadership to develop credible efficiency and business-benefit estimates.
  • Define measurable success criteria for proposed automation initiatives.
  • Develop a benefits-tracking framework comparing baseline results with post-implementation performance.
  • Analyze realized results and provide fact-based recommendations supporting implementation and expansion decision gates.

Stakeholder & Change Management

  • Serve as a trusted liaison among operations personnel, credit union leadership, technology teams, compliance stakeholders, and implementation teams.
  • Facilitate workshops to validate current-state findings, future-state workflows, requirements, and implementation assumptions.
  • Identify organizational impacts resulting from automation and process redesign.
  • Support change-readiness assessments, communications, training, knowledge transfer, and transition planning.
  • Ensure institutional knowledge and critical business rules currently held by individual employees are identified, documented, and incorporated into future-state processes where appropriate.
  • Maintain a member-service-oriented perspective when evaluating operational changes and automation opportunities.

Risk, Controls & Regulatory Considerations

  • Incorporate operational risk, compliance, privacy, security, and internal-control considerations into business requirements and future-state workflows.
  • Work with compliance and technical teams to ensure requirements appropriately address the regulated credit union environment, including considerations related to GLBA, NCUA expectations, data privacy, auditability, and third-party risk.
  • Identify requirements for human-in-the-loop review, approvals, exception handling, explainability, and audit trails associated with AI-enabled processes.
  • Assist in identifying and documenting operational, process, data, technology, adoption, and implementation risks and associated mitigation actions.

Testing, Implementation & Governance

  • Support solution validation through requirements reviews, prototypes, demonstrations, and user acceptance testing.
  • Develop or support test scenarios and acceptance criteria based on documented business requirements.
  • Coordinate with business stakeholders to validate that implemented workflows meet operational needs before production deployment.
  • Track requirements, assumptions, dependencies, decisions, issues, and scope changes throughout the engagement.
  • Prepare business-analysis deliverables supporting project governance and executive/Board decision gates.
  • Provide clear status, findings, risks, and recommendations to project leadership and client stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of progressively responsible business analysis, business process transformation, or operational improvement experience.
  • Demonstrated experience withincredit unions, retail banking, banking operations, financial-services shared services, or another highly regulated financial-services environment.
  • Experience analyzing complex operational processes involving multiple systems, business units, handoffs, controls, and exception scenarios.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead requirements gathering and process-discovery workshops with both business and technical stakeholders.
  • Strong experience developing:
    • Current- and future-state process maps
    • Business and functional requirements
    • User stories and acceptance criteria
    • Business rules and decision logic
    • KPI and benefits frameworks
    • Requirements traceability matrices
    • Process and data-flow documentation
  • Experience supporting workflow automation, intelligent automation, RPA, AI-enabled transformation, or digital process redesign initiatives.
  • Demonstrated ability to quantify operational improvement opportunities and measure realized business benefits.
  • Strong analytical skills and proficiency working with operational, financial, and performance data.
  • Excellent facilitation, interviewing, written communication, and executive presentation skills.
  • Ability to translate between business stakeholders and technical delivery teams.
  • Experience working within Agile, iterative, hybrid, or structured implementation methodologies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience withcredit union Deposit Operationsor comparable retail banking operations.
  • Experience with ACH, deposit exceptions, remote deposit capture, payments, card servicing, disputes, reconciliations, or account servicing.
  • Experience working with Credit Union Service Organizations (CUSOs), shared-service organizations, or multi-entity operating environments.
  • Familiarity with core banking, workflow, document-management, payment, and financial-services platforms.
  • Experience supporting AI, generative AI, machine learning, document intelligence, workflow orchestration, or automation implementations.
  • Familiarity with multi-tenant operating models and requirements for data and workflow segregation across financial institutions.
  • Understanding of financial-services regulatory and control frameworks, including GLBA and NCUA requirements.
  • Experience supporting technology implementations requiring model governance, human-in-the-loop controls, auditability, or explainability.
  • CBAP, CCBA, PMI-PBA, Lean Six Sigma, or comparable business-analysis/process-improvement certification preferred.

Key Deliverables

The Senior Business Analyst may be responsible for or contribute materially to the following engagement deliverables:

  • Current-state process inventory and process maps
  • Business capability and operational assessment
  • Deposit Operations process analysis
  • Process-volume, effort, cycle-time, error, and cost baseline
  • Automation opportunity assessment and prioritization
  • Future-state process designs
  • Business, functional, integration, data, reporting, and control requirements
  • Business rules and exception-handling requirements
  • User stories and acceptance criteria
  • Requirements traceability matrix
  • KPI and success-measurement framework
  • Benefits realization model
  • Operational risk and mitigation inputs
  • Organizational impact and change-readiness analysis
  • User acceptance testing scenarios and validation results
  • Decision-gate documentation and implementation recommendations

Success Profile

Success in this role requires an individual who can move comfortably between detailed operational analysis and executive-level business outcomes. The Senior Business Analyst must be able to understand how work is actually performed today, challenge processes constructively, translate operational knowledge into structured requirements, and identify where automation can deliver measurable value without compromising member service, regulatory compliance, or operational control.

The successful candidate will bring aclient-centered, evidence-based approach to transformation, helping the organization build confidence in new AI and automation capabilities while creating processes and requirements that can scale across additional credit unions and business lines.

Serving as Cepheid's primary trade compliance subject matter expert, this role partners across Corporate and Platform Trade Compliance, and key Cepheid teams to support business growth while ensuring compliance with Danaher standards and applicable global trade regulations.

The successful candidate will be a strategic and hands-on leader who can effectively sustain a mature trade compliance program, strengthen global partnerships, oversee compliance controls and audits, influence stakeholders across the organization, and identify opportunities to further enhance trade compliance capabilities in support of Cepheid's global operations.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • 12+ years of experience applying customs compliance requirements across multiple jurisdictions, including customs valuation, tariff classification, country of origin, free trade agreements, export controls, sanctions, and other global trade regulatory requirements

  • Experience within diagnostics, medical devices, life sciences, healthcare technology, or other highly regulated industries, including implementation of trade compliance technology, automation, and digital transformation initiatives

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.

We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

  • Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.

  • Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.

  • Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.

  • Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.

  • Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.

  • Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together.

We focus on the most complex trials, the studies where experience, judgement, and rigorous operational accountability make the biggest difference. We partner with small to midsize biotech companies to move promising therapies through early phase development, so they reach the patients sooner.

We choose complex work on purpose. Rare disease and oncology trials carry real operational risk, and our people are experts at reducing it, protecting timelines, data quality and the experience of sites and patients at the same time. It is demanding, meaningful work, and no one here forgets that patients cannot wait.

That is why culture matters to us as much as capability. We have built a collaborative, international team where people share ideas, grow their careers and are trusted to take ownership early. With colleagues across North America, South America, Europe, Asia and Australia, we value teamwork, flexibility and a real commitment to work-life balance, because good science comes from people who feel supported.

If you want work with purpose, the agility to make an impact and a team that cares about the people behind the work as much as the work itself, we would love to hear from you.

raw.excerpt: ABOUT US Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry.
raw.description:
ABOUT US

Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game.

For more information, visit .

ABOUT YOU

We are looking for a Middle/Senior Backend Engineer who is passionate about building secure, high-load identity systems to join our Xsolla ID team. The best candidate will be someone who thrives in a fast-paced, highly collaborative, and exceptionally dynamic setting and is excited to develop a next-generation IAM (Identity and Access Management) platform that serves as the foundation for all Xsolla B2C products.

Strong backend development skills in Go are essential, along with experience in building scalable distributed systems and working with authentication/authorization protocols. The ability to design and optimize high-availability services handling millions of users will be key to your success in this role.

If you're passionate about creating reliable, secure identity solutions and love working on strategic platforms that directly impact user experience across gaming ecosystem, we would love to hear from you!

About the project

    Xsolla ID is a strategic core service — the centralized identity provider for the entire Xsolla ecosystem. It is not just a login form; it's a comprehensive IAM platform enabling authentication and authorization across all B2C products, including Xsolla Wallet, Xsolla App, Web Shops, and partner integrations.

    Tech Stack:

    • Language: Go (idiomatic code, concurrency patterns, performance profiling)

    • Databases: PostgreSQL (schema design, query optimization, migrations at scale), MySQL, Redis

    • Distributed SQL: CockroachDB (multi-region deployments, clock skew handling, survivability trade-offs) for geo-distributed data residency

    • Message Streaming: NATS, Kafka (event-driven patterns, consumer groups, at-least-once delivery), RabbitMQ

    • Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, Nginx

    • Identity Stack: Ory ecosystem (Hydra for OAuth2/OIDC, Kratos for identity management) with a custom Auth API orchestrator and plugin architecture

    • Protocols: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC (authorization code + PKCE, client credentials, device flow, token introspection, refresh strategies), WebAuthn

    • Web Security: cookie security, CSRF, XSS protection, secure token storage, TLS, secure session management

    • Architecture: Microservices, High Availability design

      • Key Technical Challenges:

      • Building Web2 & Web3 authentication flows (OTP, passkeys, biometrics, wallet-based login)

      • Implementing custom auth methods without forking Ory

      • SSO without third-party cookies

      • Zero-downtime migration from legacy Xsolla Login with bidirectional identity sync

      • Geo-distributed data residency via CockroachDB

      • High availability and scaling for millions of concurrent users

      • SDK development and integration with multiple Xsolla products

Responsibilities

    • Develop and maintain backend services for the Xsolla ID platform using Go

    • Design and implement OAuth 2.0 / OIDC flows (authorization code + PKCE, client credentials, device flow), token introspection, and refresh strategies

    • Work with the Ory ecosystem (Hydra, Kratos) and extend the custom Auth API orchestrator and plugin architecture

    • Apply web security fundamentals: cookie security, CSRF/XSS protection, secure token storage, TLS, secure session management

    • Optimize database queries and ensure high performance under heavy loads (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, CockroachDB)

    • Build and maintain microservices architecture with focus on reliability and scalability

    • Contribute to zero-downtime migration from legacy Xsolla Login with bidirectional identity sync

    • Write clean, well-tested code with comprehensive unit and integration test coverage

    • Collaborate with frontend engineers on SDK and widget integration

    • Participate in code reviews and contribute to technical documentation

    • Support production systems and troubleshoot issues across the authentication stack

      • QUALIFICATIONS

      Required:

      • 2+ years of commercial experience with Go

      • Strong understanding of PostgreSQL and Redis (query optimization, indexing strategies)

      • Working knowledge of OAuth 2.0 / OIDC auth flows (authorization code, client credentials) or strong motivation to learn

      • Understanding of web security fundamentals: CSRF, XSS, cookie security, TLS

      • Experience with Docker and docker-compose

      • Proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows

      • Understanding of Nginx and web server configuration

      • Solid experience writing unit tests and maintaining high code quality

      • Good English reading skills (technical documentation)

        • Preferred:

        • Understanding of microservices architecture and distributed systems trade-offs (consistency, availability, failure modes)

        • Experience with REST API design and documentation (Swagger/OpenAPI)

        • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines

        • Familiarity with the Ory ecosystem (Hydra, Kratos, Keto) or similar identity management frameworks

        • Knowledge of PKCE, client credentials, device flow, token introspection, and refresh-token strategies

        • Experience with CockroachDB or other distributed SQL databases (multi-region deployments, clock skew handling)

        • Experience with NATS, Kafka, or RabbitMQ for event-driven / message-streaming patterns

        • Familiarity with Jira for project management

        • Understanding of Kubernetes and container orchestration

        • Familiarity with compliance requirements relevant to IAM: SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR data minimization, audit logging

        • Practical, up-to-date experience with modern AI tools (e.g. Claude, Copilot, Cursor) for code generation, review, and accelerating day-to-day engineering work

BENEFITS

We are passionate about fostering a supportive environment for our team, so we prioritize the physical, mental, and emotional well-being of our employees through a comprehensive Benefits Program. This includes:

  • Unlimited Flexible Time Off for work-life balance

  • Private health insurance (ДМС) with dental coverage for you and your family

  • Personalized career roadmap with clear growth paths (IC track or Leadership track)

  • Professional development through training and educational opportunities

  • Annual corporate events and team gatherings

  • Remote-first culture with flexible working hours (10:00–19:00)

  • Working at the cutting edge of the rapidly growing gaming and Web3 industry

  • Knowledge sharing culture with experienced engineers across the organization

Together, we're not just building a business; we're cultivating a community that values creativity, collaboration, and the transformative power of play.

raw.excerpt: For People is a team of skilled technologists improving government digital services for disadvantaged and vulnerable populations.
raw.description:
For People is a team of skilled technologists improving government digital services for disadvantaged and vulnerable populations. We embed directly in government agencies to modernize software, systems, and platforms so that they better serve people.

Your Impact

A parent applies for Medicaid and waits to hear whether their child is covered. A state analyst tries to answer a basic question about a program serving millions of people and finds the data three years out of date. Each of those moments runs through a government system, and too many of those systems are outdated or hard to use.

For People builds and modernizes those systems at federal and state agencies.

Once we decide to pursue an opportunity, you will be the single point of accountability for winning it, from the first conversation with a program office through submission. You'll build the relationships, set the win strategy, and lead the bid, with our proposal team working alongside you. Every pursuit you win puts our engineers, designers, and researchers on a system that millions of people depend on.

Our Culture

For People is a team of humans. We place a significant amount of emphasis on positive work-life balance, setting healthy expectations, and making sure our loved ones are taken care of first. That means picking a child up from school during the day or going for a mid-day walk is okay!

This position is 100% remote, however, preference will be given to those local to the DC, Maryland, and Virginia area. Travel will be required across the country to client locations, partner offices, and industry events.

This position's published base salary range is between $130,000 - $185,000 annually. Additional incentives are available for successful wins. All positions include generous benefits (e.g., For People pays 100% of Gold-tier employee health insurance premiums) and annual company profit sharing.

Your Opportunities

As our Senior Capture Manager, you will:

  • Own pursuits once we decide to pursue them, across federal and state agencies.
  • Build and work a call plan for each pursuit, meeting with program offices, contracting officers, and potential partners to understand mission, budget, incumbents, and pain points.
  • Turn customer and competitor intelligence into a win strategy, win themes, and the discriminators that set us apart.
  • Engage the customer where it is appropriate and ethical, through RFIs, sources-sought responses, capability statements, and demos.
  • Identify and bring on teaming partners and subcontractors that fill capability or past-performance gaps.
  • Lead the bid by running go/no-go and gate reviews, directing the proposal team through color-team reviews to submission, and working with leadership on pricing and price-to-win.
  • Keep several pursuits moving at once, help leadership scan agency forecasts for opportunities worth a closer look, and capture lessons learned after every decision, win or lose.

You Bring

  • A humble and caring attitude aligning with For People's values: passion, fun, curiosity, sustainability, humility, and respect.
  • 5+ years in government capture, business development, or a closely related role. We're open to unconventional paths, like a product or program leader who has run large, stakeholder-facing government work and wants to move into capture.
  • Experience owning a pursuit or bid response from qualification through submission, including win strategy, color-team reviews, and pricing.
  • Comfort working directly with government stakeholders and partners, including building relationships at agencies where we don't have them yet.
  • A hands-on approach and an eagerness to learn how we work.
  • The ability to juggle several pursuits at once and stay calm when the deadlines stack up.
  • Strong writing, enough technical literacy to hold a conversation about software modernization and data platforms, and comfort using AI tools for research and first drafts.

It Would Be Great If You Also Have

  • Experience at CMS, HHS, or the broader federal health community.
  • Experience capturing work at agencies that address the social determinants of health, such as housing, nutrition, economic mobility, education, and social services.
  • Familiarity with contract vehicles like GWACs, IDIQs, and agency BPAs, and a track record on small-business, 8(a), or full-and-open pursuits.

Additional Details

Our work sits on United States government platforms, and our clients have a few basic requirements for contractors like ourselves. All work must be physically performed within the United States at all times. In addition, you must be a United States citizen and be able to pass a government-performed public trust background check.

For People is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, and/or veteran status.

raw.title: Database Reliability Engineer
raw.excerpt: We are hiring a Senior Database Reliability Engineer to join the Infrastructure DBA cell.
raw.description:
We are hiring a Senior Database Reliability Engineer to join the Infrastructure DBA cell. This is a hands-on production ownership role, not a narrow ticket-processing DBA position. You will keep critical database services reliable, automate repeated work, support engineering teams, and reduce single-person dependency in our PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, MongoDB, and Redis operations.

PostgreSQL is the main requirement. ClickHouse experience is a strong plus, but it is not a day-one blocker. We need a senior engineer with enough database, Linux, automation, and incident-response depth to learn our ClickHouse environment quickly and operate it safely.

Your Responsibilities:

Own production PostgreSQL reliability: HA design, Patroni, PgBouncer, replication, failover, upgrades, vacuum/bloat control, query tuning, locks, indexes, capacity, backups, PITR, and restore validation. Improve disaster recovery and operational evidence: tested restores, documented recovery paths, measurable RTO/RPO targets, runbooks, and safe maintenance plans. Support the wider database estate: ClickHouse, MongoDB, and Redis. You will troubleshoot incidents, review access and data-safety changes, improve monitoring, and learn the production ClickHouse patterns already in use. Automate DBA workflows with Ansible, Terraform/OpenTofu, GitLab CI/CD, scripts, and reproducible runbooks for provisioning, grants, backups, restores, health checks, and ownership metadata. Help build DBaaS-style self-service capabilities so engineering teams can request databases, access, credentials, and operational checks with less manual DBA intervention. Improve observability and incident response through Grafana, metrics, logs, SLOs, alert rules, Opsgenie routing, and clear communication during production issues.

What Success Looks Like:

PostgreSQL clusters have tested backup and restore paths, useful dashboards, clear ownership, and documented failover procedures.
Repeated DBA tickets become automation or self-service workflows.
ClickHouse operational knowledge is no longer a single-person dependency.
Database incidents have owners, runbooks, evidence, and measurable recovery paths.
Product and engineering teams get database help faster without sacrificing safety, auditability, or reliability.

Why Us?

You will work on real production infrastructure used across products.
You will have a direct impact on reliability, incident response, developer experience, and operational resilience.
You will also work in an AI-assisted engineering culture where automation, documentation, Claude, Codex, and careful human verification are part of the daily operating model.

Requirements

What We Expect From You:

Deep hands-on PostgreSQL experience in business-critical production environments, typically 5+ years or equivalent depth.
Strong understanding of PostgreSQL internals and operations: MVCC, WAL, transactions, locks, indexes, query planning, replication, autovacuum, bloat, major upgrades, backups, PITR, and restore testing.
Proven experience with highly available databases and the ability to reason about quorum, split-brain risk, failover, rollback, and recovery.
Strong Linux and infrastructure fundamentals: systemd, networking, storage, filesystems, CPU/memory/disk bottlenecks, TLS, DNS, firewalls, and root-cause troubleshooting.
Automation skills with Ansible and scripting. Terraform/OpenTofu, GitLab CI/CD, and merge-request based delivery are strong advantages.
Ability to support more than one database engine. You do not need to be a ClickHouse expert on day one, but you must be ready to learn it quickly and take responsibility for it.
Practical use of AI engineering assistants such as Claude and Codex. We expect you to use them to improve speed and quality, while personally verifying generated SQL, commands, scripts, and operational conclusions.
English - upper-intermediate or higher - to ensure clear communication of progress within the teams.

Nice to Have:

ClickHouse operations: replication, Keeper/ZooKeeper, MergeTree engines, distributed DDL, grants, row policies, backups, query troubleshooting, and cluster recovery.
MongoDB replica sets and Percona Backup for MongoDB.
Redis/Sentinel and broker/cache failure modes.
Database observability, SLOs, golden signals, alert tuning, and executable incident runbooks.
Building internal platforms, self-service portals, or DBaaS workflows for engineering teams.

Benefits

A focus on professional development.

Interesting and challenging projects.

Fully remote work with flexible working hours, which allows you to schedule your day and work from any location worldwide.
Paid 24 days of vacation per year, 10 days of national holidays, and unlimited sick leaves.
Compensation for private medical insurance.
Co-working and gym/sports reimbursement.
Budget for education.
The opportunity to receive a reward for the most innovative idea that the company can patent.

Progressive Automations is one of the top manufacturers and distributors of linear actuators and home/office automation. We have over a decade of experience in the industry and are quickly growing. Our goal is to lead the industry in innovation while bringing you premium quality products at an affordable price. Our creative, energetic and innovative team has the experience of working together with different customers, from automation enthusiasts, hobbyists to large scale partners. We are constantly developing our skills and knowledge of the industry while we also make sure to have a bit of fun in life!

100% remote · Full-time (40 hrs/week) · Pacific Time hours

Progressive Automations builds linear actuators and motion systems for everyone from weekend hobbyists to large OEM partners. We've been at it for over a decade and we're growing fast.

We're hiring an engineer who genuinely likes helping people figure things out. You'll be the person customers reach when an actuator isn't behaving, a control board is wired wrong, or they're not sure which product fits their build. You'll also field plenty of general questions — order status, specs, "which one do I need?" Some questions are simple, some are genuinely interesting engineering puzzles, and you'll handle the full range.

What you'll actually do

  • Answer both technical problems and general inquiries — troubleshooting, specs, order questions, and "which product is right for me?" — over tickets, email, chat, and phone calls
  • Diagnose issues with actuators, control systems, DC motors, and wiring — and explain the fix in plain language
  • Make sure customers end up with everything they need to succeed — asking the right questions ("How are you controlling this?", "Do you have a power supply for that?") so they're not missing a piece
  • Flag bad datasheets, broken website info, and recurring product issues so we can fix them at the source
  • Hit our response-time targets without making customers feel rushed

You'll report to and learn from our B2C Technical Lead, so you're not figuring it out alone.

What you need

  • A diploma or degree in Electronics, Mechanical, or Mechatronics Engineering (or equivalent experience)

raw.description:
Key Account Manager Residential Buildings

Responsibilities

The Key Account Manager Residential Buildings plays a crucial role within the Sales Team of the Residential Buildings Business Unit and is responsible for strategically managing, developing and expanding customer relationships and contracts. The role focuses on achieving sustainable revenue and profit growth and strengthening IMI’s market position within the Residential Buildings market.

The Key Account Manager maintains and deepens existing customer relationships while simultaneously focusing actively on developing new business. Based on a strong understanding of the market, customer needs and relevant market developments, the Key Account Manager identifies commercial opportunities and translates these into concrete sales and growth plans. This includes actively pursuing acquisition, cross-selling, deep-selling and up-selling opportunities across the full IMI portfolio, with the objective of further increasing both revenue and margin as well as IMI’s market share.

The role focuses explicitly on Key Accounts within the relevant customer groups rather than on a predetermined number of customers or exclusively on wholesalers. Within the so-called push strategy, the focus is on wholesalers, purchasing organisations and installers. Within the pull strategy, the Key Account Manager focuses, among others, on housing associations and related organisations, as well as energy consultants. By actively building and maintaining relationships throughout the entire value chain, the Key Account Manager creates a strong network in which different stakeholders are connected and commercial opportunities can be leveraged effectively.

In addition to commercial responsibility, the Key Account Manager plays an important role in the development and execution of market-oriented marketing activities. The Key Account Manager initiates, coordinates and supports activities that contribute to further strengthening IMI’s market position. These activities include organising customer events, training sessions and webinars, supporting market introductions, setting up joint marketing campaigns with partners, and developing value propositions that respond to current market developments and customer needs. This not only strengthens relationships with existing customers but also creates new market opportunities.

The Key Account Manager operates based on a strategic regional plan. This plan integrates relevant customers, commercial objectives, growth opportunities, customer needs, market developments, marketing initiatives and the corresponding IMI solutions. The regional plan therefore forms the basis for determining priorities and deploying targeted commercial and marketing activities towards Key Accounts and other strategically relevant customers.

An important part of the role is continuously monitoring and analysing developments within the market, including customer needs, technological developments, trends and relevant legislation and regulations. The Key Account Manager translates these developments into concrete commercial opportunities and ensures that IMI can respond to them in a timely and targeted manner. This requires close cooperation with internal teams and external partners to ensure that propositions, solutions and activities are optimally aligned with the market.

Key Result Areas

The Key Account Manager focuses on:

  • Achieving revenue and margin targets within the assigned market segment.
  • Developing and expanding existing customer relationships and actively acquiring new customers.
  • Increasing IMI’s market share within the Residential Buildings market.
  • Preparing, executing and periodically adjusting account and growth plans.
  • Developing and executing commercial, marketing and market development activities.
  • Identifying and leveraging market trends, relevant legislation and regulations, and commercial opportunities.
  • Driving cross-selling, deep-selling and up-selling across the full IMI portfolio.
  • Building and maintaining a strong network throughout the entire value chain, from wholesalers and installers to consultants and housing associations.
  • Strengthening IMI’s market position and visibility through targeted customer and market activities, including events, training sessions, webinars, market introductions and collaborations with partners.
  • Translating market and customer developments into relevant propositions and solutions that meet the needs of the Residential Buildings market.

The position operates within the Residential Buildings Business Unit and reports directly to the Head of Sales. The Key Account Manager actively contributes to achieving the organisation’s overall financial objectives.

Responsibilities / Tasks

  • Initiate and coordinate commercial activities across the different customer groups, both within the push strategy (wholesalers, purchasing organisations and installers) and within the pull strategy (housing associations, aligned organisations and energy consultants).
  • Identify commercial opportunities and develop an appropriate customer approach for each region and each strategically relevant customer.
  • Drive sales of the three brands by actively pursuing cross-selling opportunities for Heimeier, TA and Pneumatex.
  • Provide professional product training and guidance to potential customers interested in our products.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of and feel for the HVAC market by regularly attending seminars, networking events, receptions and trade fairs.
  • Monitor and maintain existing contracts and establish new contracts where relevant.
  • Prepare for and conduct negotiations with wholesalers, OEMs, purchasing organisations and other strategically relevant customers.
  • Ensure that all relevant sales activities, customer interactions and commercial agreements are recorded in the CRM system.
  • Proactively respond to market conditions, competitive activities, general economic developments, changes in legislation and government policy.
  • Onboard new colleagues in cooperation with the other members of the Business Unit and Team Netherlands as a whole.
  • Analyse own results and, where deviations from the plan occur, initiate and implement timely corrective actions.
  • Periodically evaluate the regional plan and, where necessary, adjust the customer approach, priorities and commercial activities.
  • Contribute to a safe and healthy working environment for oneself and colleagues.

Authorities

  • Independently decide on additional discounts in price quotations, up to an additional discount of <5% on top of the standard discount (A&L overview).
  • Independently make project and/or customer purchases in accordance with the applicable guidelines (see A&L October 2024).
  • Conclude agreements with customers within IMI’s commercial and legal frameworks and within the applicable thresholds and authorisation limits.
  • Participate in international working groups initiated by IMI HQ or on their own initiative, subject to relevance and alignment with the organisation.

This position emphasises the importance of strategic customer management, operational execution, contract management and market development within Residential Buildings.

The Key Account Manager works with a customer- and region-focused approach and connects the push and pull strategies. The role actively seeks synergies between the different customer groups and between the Residential Sales Team and the Commercial Sales Team.

About RUM Group Inc.

RUM Group Inc. is an AI infrastructure and video company. Its Quake AI business delivers AI compute as a service, operating AI data centers including GPU and CPU compute, storage, and networking at scale. Rumble, RUM Group's video business and the original tenant of Quake AI, provides creators and enterprises a full suite of video technologies, unlocking reach, scale, and monetization. RUM Group is building the rails of the agentic-first enterprise: the AI compute, cloud infrastructure, and trust layer for the agentic AI future, advancing RUM Group's mission to maximize the power of human imagination. For more information visit www.rum.group.

RUM Group Inc. is seeking a Director, Tax & Treasury to lead the Company’s tax strategy, tax compliance and reporting, cash management, banking relationships, liquidity planning, and treasury operations. This role will partner closely with the Chief Financial Officer, Finance leadership, Accounting, FP&A, Legal, Human Resources, and external advisors to protect the Company’s financial position, maintain compliance across relevant jurisdictions, optimize cash deployment, and support strategic initiatives including acquisitions, financing activities, and international expansion.

This is a senior finance leadership role for a commercially minded professional who can combine strong technical tax and treasury expertise with disciplined risk management and practical business judgment. You will lead the planning and execution of tax and treasury activities across a growing, multi-entity business, translating complex issues involving tax exposure, liquidity, debt, banking, foreign exchange, and capital deployment into clear recommendations for executive leadership. The role reports to the Chief Financial Officer and may lead tax and/or treasury team members as the function grows.

The ideal candidate brings experience in corporate tax, treasury, public accounting, corporate finance, or a combination of related disciplines. You should be comfortable working across a complex operating environment, managing external advisors and banking partners, improving financial processes and controls, and balancing compliance requirements with the Company’s growth, financing, infrastructure, and international business priorities. Treasury leaders commonly own cash positioning, liquidity forecasting, working-capital optimization, banking relationships, and financial risk management; this role combines those responsibilities with company-wide tax leadership.

Responsibilities

Lead RUM Group’s tax strategy, tax compliance, tax reporting, and tax-planning activities across applicable U.S. and international jurisdictions. Oversee the quarterly and annual income-tax provision process, tax filings, estimated payments, tax elections, documentation, internal controls, audits, examinations, notices, and tax controversy matters. Monitor changes in tax laws and regulatory requirements, assess business impact, and recommend practical actions that support compliance, manage risk, and improve tax efficiency.

Lead treasury operations, including cash positioning, liquidity monitoring, cash-flow forecasting, banking administration, payment controls, short-term investments, and working-capital optimization. Manage banking relationships, debt facilities, letters of credit, guarantees, covenant compliance, and related lender reporting. Establish and maintain treasury policies, controls, delegations of authority, and processes that protect Company assets, improve cash visibility, and reduce financial and fraud risk.

Serve as a strategic advisor to the CFO and executive leadership on tax exposure, liquidity, financing, capital deployment, financial risk, and other high-impact decisions. Partner with Accounting, FP&A, Legal, HR, Payroll, and external advisors on tax reporting, transaction structuring, acquisitions, financing activities, international operations, equity compensation, and cross-border matters. Lead and develop tax and/or treasury team members, manage external advisors and banking partners, and provide clear reporting to executive leadership, the Board, and Audit Committee as needed.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in corporate tax, treasury, public accounting, corporate finance, or a combination of related disciplines.
  • Demonstrated experience leading tax compliance, tax provision, tax planning, treasury operations, cash management, banking relationships, debt administration, or a combination of these areas.
  • Strong knowledge of applicable tax principles, financial-reporting requirements, internal controls, cash-management practices, and treasury best practices.
  • Experience managing tax compliance and reporting requirements across multiple entities, jurisdictions, or business lines.
  • Experience developing cash-flow forecasts, liquidity plans, working-capital strategies, and executive reporting.
  • Experience managing banking partners, external tax advisors, lenders, consultants, or other critical third-party relationships.
  • Experience with ERP, treasury-management, tax-provision, and financial-planning systems, along with advanced Excel and financial-modeling skills.
  • Strong analytical judgment and attention to detail, particularly in complex, high-impact financial matters.
  • Ability to distill technical tax, treasury, financing, and financial-risk matters into clear, practical recommendations for executive stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to manage complex cross-functional projects, prioritize competing deadlines, and deliver reliable results in a fast-moving environment.
  • High integrity, discretion, and sound judgment when handling confidential financial, legal, and employee-related information.

Preferred Qualifications

  • CPA, CA, CMA, CFA, CTP, or an advanced degree in Taxation, Accounting, Finance, or Business Administration. The CTP designation is administered by the Association for Financial Professionals and covers corporate cash and treasury-management competencies.[165][166][169]
  • Experience in a multi-entity, multi-jurisdictional, or international business environment.
  • Experience supporting mergers and acquisitions, financing transactions, corporate restructuring, purchase accounting, or rapid-growth environments.
  • Experience evaluating tax implications related to international expansion, cross-border financing, intercompany funding, foreign exchange, or global cash-management structures.
  • Experience supporting public-company financial reporting, Audit Committee materials, debt compliance, or investor-facing financial processes.
  • Experience identifying and implementing scalable controls, systems, automation, workflows, or reporting improvements across tax and treasury functions.

Leadership

Lead, develop, and mentor tax and/or treasury team members, creating clear accountability, strong technical capability, and a service-oriented operating culture. Manage external advisors, banking partners, consultants, and other third parties to ensure effective delivery, cost discipline, and alignment with organizational priorities. Work collaboratively across Finance, Legal, Human Resources, Operations, and executive leadership to build scalable, well-controlled tax and treasury capabilities that support the Company’s continued growth.

Annual Compensation Range:

$225,000-$270,000 USD base + benefits + equity

Note: The salary range listed for this position is a good faith estimate based on experience, qualifications, and internal compensation structure. The actual salary offered varies depending on the candidate's skill level and experience. This posting refers to an active vacancy within the organization.

Why Our Team Loves Working Here:

  • We are making a significant financial impact for our video creator community; we’re proud of their success stories
  • We enjoy challenging the status quo and going head-to-head against Big Tech
  • We aren’t afraid to try new things; we act fast and want to win
  • We pay competitive salaries and provide great benefits

RUM Group Inc. is an equal opportunity employer.  We promote an equal playing field where everyone has the same opportunities regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law. RUM Group Inc. is an active participant in the e-verify program.

Physical demands of the position:
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit for prolonged periods of time while using a computer and/or keyboard. The employee is required to communicate verbally and hear. The employee may be required to walk, reach with hands and arms, balance, and stoop or kneel. Summary

The Provider Field Representative Lead provides functional leadership and support to Provider Field Representatives serving California’s Medi-Cal provider community.

This role supports team escalations, provider outreach, claims research, provider billing support, and the development and delivery of virtual and in-person training. The Lead also serves as a liaison between providers, provider associations, internal departments, and the client to help ensure consistent service delivery and compliance with Medi-Cal program requirements.

Your role in our mission

  • Provide functional leadership and direction to Provider Field Representatives, serving as a resource for team escalations, complex provider inquiries, billing questions, claims issues, and program requirements.
  • Support provider billing activities, including one-on-one billing assistance, claims research and analysis, reimbursement questions, and resolution of provider billing issues.
  • Support and help direct provider education and outreach, including workshops, seminars, program-specific events, one-on-one training, and provider association activities.
  • Serve as a liaison between providers, internal departments, and the client to resolve issues and support Medi-Cal programs and initiatives.
  • Apply established policies and procedures while exercising independent judgment to resolve complex provider issues, identify areas of concern, and recommend appropriate solutions or escalation.
  • Contribute to shared knowledge resources, document complex issue resolution, and help ensure consistent and accurate information is provided across the team.
  • Support the development and mentoring of Provider Field Representatives while identifying opportunities to improve provider service, team processes, and overall operational effectiveness.

What we're looking for

  • Three or more years of business process outsourcing, consulting, systems implementation, provider relations, provider services, or related healthcare operations experience.
  • Experience supporting healthcare providers with billing, claims research, billing issues, and reimbursement-related questions.
  • Experience serving as a functional lead, subject matter expert, mentor, trainer, or escalation point for a team.
  • Experience developing and/or delivering training to healthcare providers virtually and in person.
  • Strong provider relations, analytical, problem-solving, communication, presentation, facilitation, and functional leadership skills.
  • Experience working with business processes, assessing provider or client needs, and identifying opportunities for improvement.
  • Medi-Cal or Medicaid experience preferred.
  • Willingness and ability to travel throughout California.

What you should expect in this role

  • Remote position; must reside in California.
  • Travel throughout California is required to support provider training, outreach, events, and other business needs.
  • Occasional overnight travel and onsite attendance may be required.
  • Reliable high-speed internet connectivity is required.

This is a pipeline requisition designed to build a pool of qualified candidates for current and future opportunities as positions become available.

The pay range for this position is $70,000 - $80,000 per year, however, the base pay offered may vary depending on geographic region, internal equity, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. Put your passion to work at Gainwell. You’ll have the opportunity to grow your career in a company that values work flexibility, learning, and career development. All salaried, full-time candidates are eligible for our generous, flexible vacation policy, a 401(k) employer match, comprehensive health benefits, and educational assistance. We also have a variety of leadership and technical development academies to help build your skills and capabilities.

We believe nothing is impossible when you bring together people who care deeply about making healthcare work better for everyone. Build your career with Gainwell, an industry leader. You’ll be joining a company where collaboration, innovation, and inclusion fuel our growth. Learn more about Gainwell at our company website and visit our Careers site for all available job role openings.

raw.excerpt: Journey Clinical is on a mission to transform the growing mental health crisis by accelerating the adoption of frontier treatments that lead to lasting improvements in clinical outcomes.
raw.description:
Journey Clinical is on a mission to transform the growing mental health crisis by accelerating the adoption of frontier treatments that lead to lasting improvements in clinical outcomes. We have built a turnkey healthtech platform to safely and effectively expand access to a powerful modality known as Psychedelic-Assisted Psychotherapy, starting with Ketamine-Assisted Psychotherapy (KAP). In our patient-centered collaborative care model, licensed psychotherapists in the network take on the psychotherapy, while Journey Clinical's in-house medical team takes on patient eligibility, treatment plan and outcome monitoring. Our platform gives psychotherapists passionate about PAP the infrastructure and support required to become empowered KAP providers, while enabling higher standards of patient care and enhanced clinical outcomes.
We have recently closed a successful Series A round led by Union Square Ventures, and are backed by a number of top-tier investors including AlleyCorp, Fifty Years, Able Partners, Gaingels, Palo Santo, PsyMed Ventures, Coalition Operators, Christina Sass co-founder of Andela, ​​Edvard Engesæth, MD co-founder of Nurx and, Hans Gangeskar co-founder of Nurx.
We are building an open-minded and inclusive workplace where you will have the opportunity to grow and collaborate with a diverse team of high performing individuals. Our team combines extensive experience in business and healthcare.
We are mission driven and strive to make the workplace stimulating, ethical, rewarding, and fun. Together, we will be working at the cutting edge of a groundbreaking field that is reshaping mental health and we will make a direct impact on people’s lives.

Responsibilities:

  • Conduct patient intake and follow up consultations to evaluate ketamine-assisted psychotherapy (KAP) eligibility, prescribe, and monitor patient outcomes via telemedicine
  • Suggest treatment plan changes based on patient response to medication and treatment outcomes
  • Engage in collaborative care with Journey Clinical member psychotherapists
  • Work with Journey Clinical care coordinator to streamline your workflow
  • Continuously and promptly give honest feedback on the Journey Clinical care management system to improve our services
  • Report directly to the Lead Clinician and collaborate with the leadership team and the co-founders

Profile:

  • Licensed to practice in Oklahoma
  • Preferred: 1 year psych experience as a PMHNP
  • Minimum 1 year psych related experience + post boards
  • DEA registration
  • Comfortable prescribing controlled substances when medically appropriate
  • Comfortable prescribing for anxiety and depression
  • Ability to quickly synthesize medical and psychiatric information about the patient to formulate effective and evidence-based clinical recommendations
  • Patient-first mindset, deep work ethic and dedication to the highest level of patient care
  • Willing to use a few simple tools to make your life easier (Slack, G Suite, Zoom, etc.)
  • Comfortable working remotely in a Telehealth fast-paced startup environment
  • Interest for the field of psychedelic-assisted psychotherapy to transform mental health

What we offer:

  • Competitive hourly rate
  • Flexible working hours
  • Ketamine-assisted psychotherapy (KAP) prescriber training and mentorship given by leading industry experts
  • Work with a team of industry leading experts, who are highly collaborative, disciplined, and who have fun working together
  • The opportunity to change the way we approach mental health by advancing the mainstream adoption of psychedelic assisted psychotherapy and make a positive impact on the lives of 100M+ people who are suffering from depression and anxiety in the US today!
If you feel discouraged by the job description because your skills don’t exactly match please apply anyway. We likely missed something and are open to expanding our understanding of the role.
